attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Business phone number of the primary corporate contact. Used for urgent communications regarding reservations, billing disputes, and contract negotiations.

attributes.name: rate_program_type
attributes.description: Type of negotiated rate program governing this corporate account. LRA (Last Room Availability) guarantees rate access even at high occupancy. NRR (Non-Refundable Rate) offers deeper discounts with cancellation restrictions. Drives Revenue Management System (RMS) displacement analysis.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Rate Program Configuration; AHLA Rate Standards

attributes.name: tax_exempt_status
attributes.description: Tax exemption classification for this corporate account. Government and qualifying non-profit accounts may be fully or partially exempt from occupancy and sales taxes. Drives tax posting rules in OPERA PMS and SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Tax Configuration; USALI; IFRS/GAAP; Local Tax Regulations

attributes.name: tax_exemption_certificate
attributes.description: Official tax exemption certificate number issued by the relevant tax authority for this corporate account. Required for audit compliance when applying tax-exempt billing. Stored for SOX and USALI audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Tax Module; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); USALI; Local Tax Authority Requirements

attributes.name: trading_name
attributes.description: Doing-business-as (DBA) or brand name of the corporate client if different from the legal registered company name. Used for correspondence and guest-facing communications.

attributes.name: vip_tier
attributes.description: VIP tier classification assigned to this corporate account based on production volume, strategic importance, and revenue contribution. Drives service recovery priority, amenity entitlements, and account manager assignment level.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Segmentation; AHLA VIP Program Standards; Medallia Guest Experience

products.name: guest_group_block
products.description: Group guest block master representing organized group travel parties (tour groups, corporate meetings, wedding parties, sports teams, airline crew). Captures group name, group type classification, group leader/contact profile reference, contracted room block size, pickup rate tracking, group code, cut-off date, billing master folio instructions, rooming list status, group coordinator assignment, and wash/attrition percentage thresholds. Distinct from MICE event management in the event domain — this focuses on room block allocation, guest-facing group identity, and rooming list management. Sourced from OPERA PMS Group Blocks and Delphi/Salesforce.

attributes.name: guest_group_block_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the guest group block record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key. Entity role: MASTER_AGREEMENT — represents a contracted room block allocation binding the property to a group organizer for a defined stay window.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Group Blocks Module

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Group blocks are frequently generated by marketing campaigns (wedding packages, conference promotions, corporate incentive programs). Group sales teams track campaign attribution for ROI measurement,

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the accounts receivable (AR) master account or corporate billing account to which the group master folio charges are posted. Sourced from OPERA PMS AR module.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS AR; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: group_leader_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the guest profile of the primary group leader or organizer responsible for the block. Sourced from OPERA PMS guest profile or Salesforce CRM contact.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profiles; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: master_ar_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ar_invoice. Business justification: Group blocks generate master folios for group billing in MICE operations. Sales managers need to track which AR invoice represents the master account for group charges, deposits, and attrition billing

attributes.name: primary_guest_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal hotel employee or sales coordinator assigned to manage this group block from the property side.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; Oracle HCM Cloud

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property at which the group room block is contracted. Links to the property master in the property domain.

attributes.name: accessible_rooms_requested
attributes.description: Number of ADA-compliant accessible rooms requested within the group block. Tracked for ADA compliance and pre-assignment planning.
attributes.references: ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act); Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: arrival_date
attributes.description: The first date of the contracted room block period — the date the group is scheduled to begin checking in. Serves as EFFECTIVE_FROM for this agreement.

attributes.name: attrition_pct
attributes.description: Contractual minimum pickup percentage the group must achieve to avoid attrition penalties. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 80.00 means the group must pick up at least 80% of contracted rooms). Aligns with revenue.wash_factor domain.
attributes.references: AHLA Group Contract Standards; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: billing_master_folio_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text instructions governing how charges are routed and settled for the group block master folio (e.g., 'Room and tax to master; incidentals to individual guest folio', 'All F&B charges to master account'). Sourced from OPERA PMS cashiering module.

attributes.name: block_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the group room block. 'Tentative' indicates a hold pending contract execution; 'Definite' indicates a signed/confirmed block; 'Cancelled' indicates the block was released; 'Closed' indicates the group has departed and the block is reconciled. Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this MASTER_AGREEMENT entity.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Group Blocks; AHLA

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the group block was cancelled, if applicable. Null for active or closed blocks. Used for attrition penalty calculation and revenue recovery tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Group Blocks; AHLA Group Contract Standards

attributes.name: cancellation_policy_code
attributes.description: Code referencing the cancellation and penalty policy applicable to this group block contract. Governs financial penalties if the group cancels after the cutoff date.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; AHLA Group Contract Standards

attributes.name: complimentary_rooms_contracted
attributes.description: Number of complimentary (comp) rooms included in the group block contract, typically awarded on a ratio basis (e.g., 1 comp per 40 paid rooms). Tracked separately for revenue accounting under USALI.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Group Blocks; USALI; AHLA

attributes.name: contracted_date
attributes.description: The date on which the group block contract was formally executed and the block status moved to 'Definite'. Represents the BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP for the agreement lifecycle.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Group Blocks; AHLA Group Contract Standards

attributes.name: contracted_rate_amount
attributes.description: Negotiated room rate per night per room agreed in the group block contract. Expressed in the property's operating currency. Confidential commercial term.
attributes.references: AHLA Group Contract Standards; USALI; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: contracted_room_nights
attributes.description: Total number of room nights committed in the group block contract across all room types and all nights of the block period. Primary quantitative measure of block size.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Group Blocks; USALI

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the group block record was first created in the source system (OPERA PMS or Delphi). Serves as RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED for this entity.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; GDPR Article 5 (data accuracy); SOX

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary values on this group block record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: cutoff_date
attributes.description: The contractual deadline by which individual reservations must be made against the block at the contracted group rate. Rooms not picked up by this date are released back to general inventory per the attrition policy.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Group Blocks; AHLA Group Contract Standards

attributes.name: delphi_opportunity_reference
attributes.description: Source system identifier from Delphi by Amadeus event sales platform linking this group block to the originating sales opportunity or group proposal. Enables cross-system traceability.

attributes.name: departure_date
attributes.description: The last date of the contracted room block period — the date the group is scheduled to check out. Serves as EFFECTIVE_UNTIL for this agreement.

attributes.name: deposit_due_date
attributes.description: Contractual deadline by which the group deposit must be received to maintain the block in 'Definite' status.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; AHLA Group Contract Standards

attributes.name: deposit_received_amount
attributes.description: Actual deposit amount received from the group organizer to date. Compared against deposit_required_amount to determine outstanding deposit balance.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Cashiering; SAP S/4HANA Finance; USALI

attributes.name: deposit_required_amount
attributes.description: Contractual deposit amount required from the group to confirm the block. Expressed in the currency defined by currency_code.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Cashiering; AHLA Group Contract Standards; USALI

attributes.name: group_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code used to identify the group block across systems (OPERA PMS, CRS, OTA channels). Used by guests and agents to associate individual reservations to the block. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this agreement.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Group Blocks; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: group_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the group (e.g., 'Smith Wedding Party', 'Acme Corp Q3 Sales Conference', 'Chicago Bulls Away Team'). Displayed on folios, rooming lists, and internal reports.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Group Blocks; Delphi by Amadeus

attributes.name: group_notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes and special instructions for the group block (e.g., VIP handling requirements, early check-in requests, amenity preferences, security arrangements). Sourced from OPERA PMS group block notes field.

attributes.name: group_rate_code
attributes.description: Rate plan code applied to individual reservations made under this group block. Links to the negotiated group rate in the revenue rate plan. Sourced from OPERA PMS and distributed via SynXis CRS.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; revenue.revenue_negotiated_rate

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the group travel party type. Drives billing rules, rate eligibility, and operational handling. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tour|corporate|wedding|sports_team|airline_crew|government|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AHLA Group Business Standards; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the group block record in the source system. Serves as RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED for this entity. Used for incremental ETL processing.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; GDPR Article 5; SOX

attributes.name: market_segment_code
attributes.description: Revenue management market segment classification assigned to this group block (e.g., GRP-CORP, GRP-LEISURE, GRP-CREW). Used for USALI-compliant revenue reporting and STR benchmarking segmentation.

attributes.name: opera_block_reference
attributes.description: Native block identifier from Oracle OPERA PMS Group Blocks module. Used for reconciliation and lineage tracing between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational source system.

attributes.name: peak_block_rooms
attributes.description: Maximum number of rooms blocked on any single night within the group block period. Used for capacity planning, displacement analysis, and revenue management evaluation.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; IDeaS G3 RMS Group Evaluation

attributes.name: repeat_group_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this group has stayed at the property in a prior year or period. Used for loyalty recognition, preferential rate negotiation, and retention analytics.

attributes.name: rooming_list_due_date
attributes.description: Contractual deadline by which the group organizer must submit the complete rooming list with individual guest names and room type preferences.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Group Blocks; AHLA Group Contract Standards

attributes.name: rooming_list_status
attributes.description: Current status of the rooming list submission for this group block. Tracks whether the group organizer has provided individual guest names and room assignments required for pre-arrival processing.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Group Blocks; AHLA

attributes.name: rooms_picked_up
attributes.description: Current count of individual reservations made against the group block (actual pickup). Compared against contracted_room_nights to calculate pickup rate and attrition exposure.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Group Blocks; revenue.pickup_report

attributes.name: source_of_business_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the channel or origin through which the group business was sourced (e.g., direct sales, GDS, OTA, travel agent, repeat group). Used for channel contribution analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; revenue.channel_contribution

attributes.name: suite_block_rooms
attributes.description: Number of suite-category rooms included in the contracted block. Tracked separately from standard rooms for inventory management and upsell reporting.

attributes.name: vip_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this group block has been designated as VIP, triggering elevated service protocols, dedicated concierge assignment, and executive-level attention.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; Salesforce CRM; AHLA Guest Experience Standards

attributes.name: wash_pct
attributes.description: Estimated percentage of contracted rooms expected to be released back to general inventory based on historical pickup patterns for this group type. Used by revenue management for net block sizing and forecasting.

products.name: vip_designation
products.description: VIP classification and designation records for high-value guests requiring elevated service protocols. Captures VIP level/tier (VIP1 through VIP5, Celebrity, Royalty, Owner, Board Member), designation reason (revenue threshold, corporate relationship, public figure status), assigned property host or butler, special handling instructions (amenity setup, GM greeting, airport transfer), amenity entitlements per tier, privacy flags (do-not-disturb, incognito check-in, no-photo policy), and designation validity period. One guest may hold multiple concurrent designations (e.g., VIP3 at brand level + Celebrity at property level). Sourced from OPERA PMS VIP codes and Salesforce CRM. Drives pre-arrival preparation checklists, room assignment priority, upgrade eligibility, and service recovery escalation paths.

attributes.name: vip_designation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each VIP designation record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for the vip_designation data product. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS VIP code assignments and Salesforce CRM VIP profile records.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profile Module

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the corporate account record when the VIP designation is granted based on a corporate relationship (e.g., key account executive, contracted corporate partner). Null for individual leisure VIP guests. Sourced from Salesforce CRM account object.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Object; Oracle OPERA PMS Company Profile

attributes.name: loyalty_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty program membership record associated with this VIP guest. Links VIP designation entitlements with loyalty tier benefits to ensure non-duplication and correct benefit stacking. Sourced from Salesforce CRM loyalty management module.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Loyalty Management; AHLA Loyalty Program Standards

attributes.name: primary_vip_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the workforce employee record for the dedicated property host, butler, or guest relations manager assigned to personally manage this VIP guest's experience. Drives pre-arrival communication and on-property service coordination.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profile Host Assignment; Oracle HCM Cloud Employee Record

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the guest profile record for whom this VIP designation is assigned. Links to the master guest profile in the guest domain. A single guest may hold multiple concurrent VIP designations across brand and property levels.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profile Module; Salesforce CRM Guest Object

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property at which this VIP designation applies. A designation may be property-specific (e.g., Celebrity at a single resort) or brand-wide (null indicates brand-level designation). Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS property configuration.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Property Configuration; AHLA Property Standards

attributes.name: quaternary_vip_assigned_host_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Quaternary Vip Assigned Host Employee Id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.employee

tag_set.value: Quaternary Vip Assigned Host Employee Id

attributes.name: tertiary_vip_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee record of the senior leader (e.g., General Manager, Regional VP) who provided final approval for this VIP designation. May differ from designated_by_employee_id when a two-step approval workflow is required for high-tier designations.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud Employee Record; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: airport_transfer_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a complimentary or arranged airport transfer service is required for this VIP guest as part of their designation entitlements. Triggers coordination with the concierge and transportation team during pre-arrival preparation.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Pre-Arrival Checklist; AHLA Concierge Service Standards

attributes.name: alias_name
attributes.description: Pseudonym or alias name used for incognito check-in and reservation bookings to protect the identity of high-profile guests. Used in place of the guest's legal name on folios, room assignments, and staff communications when incognito_checkin is true.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; CCPA Section 1798.100; Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profile Privacy Fields

attributes.name: amenity_tier_code
attributes.description: Code referencing the amenity entitlement package associated with this VIP level. Determines the standard amenity setup (e.g., welcome fruit basket, champagne, floral arrangement, personalized stationery) to be prepared prior to guest arrival. Sourced from OPERA PMS amenity configuration.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Amenity Configuration; AHLA Guest Experience Standards

attributes.name: concurrent_designation_count
attributes.description: Number of active VIP designations currently held by this guest across all scopes (brand and property level). Supports operational awareness that a guest may hold multiple concurrent designations (e.g., VIP3 at brand level and Celebrity at property level) and ensures all applicable protocols are honored.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS VIP Code Table; AHLA Guest Experience Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this VIP designation record was first created in the silver layer lakehouse. Represents the audit trail creation event. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX per platform conventions.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (data accountability); SOX Section 404 (audit trail); ISO 27001

attributes.name: designation_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code identifying this VIP designation record, as assigned in Oracle OPERA PMS VIP code table (e.g., VIP1, VIP3, CELEB, ROYAL, OWNER). Used for cross-system reference and pre-arrival checklist triggers.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS VIP Code Table; HTNG Guest Profile Standards

attributes.name: designation_notes
attributes.description: Internal narrative notes providing additional context about the VIP designation, such as the relationship history, specific events that triggered the designation, or instructions for the guest relations team. Visible only to authorized staff. Sourced from Salesforce CRM case notes.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Management; GDPR Article 5; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: designation_reason
attributes.description: Business rationale for granting the VIP designation. Revenue threshold indicates the guest meets a minimum annual spend threshold. Corporate relationship indicates a key account or contracted corporate partner. Public figure, diplomatic, and celebrity reasons trigger additional privacy protocols. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: revenue_threshold|corporate_relationship|public_figure|loyalty_elite|owner|board_member|celebrity|diplomatic|media|government — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM VIP Classification; AHLA Guest Experience Standards; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: designation_scope
attributes.description: Indicates whether the VIP designation applies across the entire brand portfolio, is restricted to a specific property, or applies to a regional cluster of properties. Drives which properties must honor the designation during pre-arrival preparation.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS VIP Code Table; HTNG Guest Profile Standards

attributes.name: designation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the VIP designation record. Active designations drive pre-arrival checklists and upgrade eligibility. Suspended designations are temporarily paused. Revoked designations have been withdrawn due to policy violation or relationship change.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS VIP Code Table; Salesforce CRM VIP Status Field

attributes.name: do_not_disturb
attributes.description: Indicates that the guest has a standing do-not-disturb preference that must be honored by housekeeping, engineering, and all operational departments unless a safety emergency arises. Overrides standard housekeeping scheduling in Oracle OPERA PMS.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Housekeeping Configuration; OSHA Safety Standards

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the VIP designation becomes active and service protocols are triggered. Used to schedule pre-arrival preparation and amenity entitlements. Aligns with OPERA PMS VIP code validity start date.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS VIP Code Validity; HTNG Guest Profile Standards

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the VIP designation expires and service protocols are deactivated. Null indicates an open-ended designation with no planned expiry. Annual review cycles typically reset this date. Aligns with OPERA PMS VIP code validity end date.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS VIP Code Validity; HTNG Guest Profile Standards

attributes.name: gm_greeting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the General Manager (GM) or designated senior property leader is required to personally greet this VIP guest upon arrival. Triggers a GM greeting task in the pre-arrival preparation checklist within Oracle OPERA PMS.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Pre-Arrival Checklist; AHLA Guest Experience Standards

attributes.name: incognito_checkin
attributes.description: Indicates that the guest requires a discreet, incognito check-in process to protect their identity and privacy. When true, the front desk must use a private check-in area, suppress the guest name from public-facing displays, and limit staff awareness of the guest's presence. Critical for celebrity and diplomatic guests.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Privacy Flags; GDPR Article 5; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: last_stay_date
attributes.description: Date of the guest's most recent completed stay at any property under this VIP designation's scope. Used during annual VIP review cycles to assess continued eligibility based on recency of engagement. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS reservation history.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Reservation History; AHLA Guest Loyalty Standards

attributes.name: media_blackout
attributes.description: Indicates that all media inquiries, press requests, and social media references related to this guest's stay must be suppressed and escalated to the Director of Communications. Distinct from no_photo_policy as it governs external communications rather than on-property photography.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; CCPA Section 1798.100; AHLA Communications Standards

attributes.name: no_photo_policy
attributes.description: Indicates that the guest has explicitly prohibited photography, video recording, or any visual documentation of their presence on property. Staff must be briefed on this restriction during pre-arrival preparation. Applies to celebrity, royalty, and diplomatic designations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 9; CCPA Section 1798.100; AHLA Guest Privacy Standards

attributes.name: pre_arrival_checklist_template
attributes.description: Code identifying the standardized pre-arrival preparation checklist template to be activated for this VIP designation. Templates define the sequence of tasks (amenity setup, room inspection, GM briefing, transportation coordination) required before the guest's arrival.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Pre-Arrival Task Management; AHLA Guest Experience Standards

attributes.name: revenue_threshold_amount
attributes.description: Minimum annual revenue contribution (in USD) that qualified this guest for the VIP designation based on the revenue threshold reason. Used for annual VIP eligibility reviews and LTV (Lifetime Value) analysis. Sourced from OPERA PMS revenue history and SAP S/4HANA financial records.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance GL; USALI Revenue Classification; AHLA Revenue Standards

attributes.name: revenue_threshold_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the revenue_threshold_amount field. Ensures correct currency context for multi-currency properties and international guests. Defaults to USD for US-based properties.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA Multi-Currency Configuration

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this VIP designation to confirm continued eligibility based on revenue thresholds, relationship status, or public figure standing. Supports annual VIP audit processes managed by the guest relations team.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM VIP Review Workflow; AHLA Guest Experience Standards

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why a VIP designation was revoked or suspended. Populated only when designation_status is revoked or suspended. Supports audit trail requirements and VIP eligibility governance reviews. Sourced from Salesforce CRM case closure reason.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Management; SOX Internal Controls; AHLA Guest Relations Governance

attributes.name: room_assignment_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority rank (lower value = higher priority) used by the front desk and revenue management systems to sequence room assignment and upgrade eligibility for this VIP guest relative to other arriving guests. Integrates with IDeaS G3 RMS inventory controls.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Room Assignment; IDeaS G3 RMS Inventory Controls

attributes.name: security_escort_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a dedicated security escort or personal protection detail coordination is required for this VIP guest during their stay. Triggers security briefing and coordination protocols with the property security team and any external protection services.
attributes.references: AHLA Safety and Security Standards; OSHA Workplace Safety

attributes.name: service_recovery_escalation_level
attributes.description: Defines the escalation path and response urgency for service recovery incidents involving this VIP guest. Immediate_gm requires the General Manager to be notified within minutes of any complaint. Drives Medallia case routing and Salesforce CRM service recovery workflows.
attributes.references: Medallia Service Recovery Module; Salesforce CRM Case Management; AHLA Guest Satisfaction Standards

attributes.name: source_system_vip_code
attributes.description: The native VIP code or identifier as stored in the originating source system (Oracle OPERA PMS or Salesforce CRM). Retained for traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational system of record.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS VIP Code Table; Salesforce CRM VIP Field; HTNG Data Exchange Standards

attributes.name: special_handling_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing bespoke service instructions specific to this VIP designation, such as preferred room temperature, dietary restrictions for amenity setup, security escort requirements, or specific staff interaction protocols. Sourced from Salesforce CRM case notes and OPERA PMS profile remarks.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Profile Remarks; Salesforce CRM Case Management; AHLA Guest Experience Standards

attributes.name: total_stays_in_period
attributes.description: Count of completed stays by the guest within the current designation validity period (effective_from to effective_until). Used to validate continued VIP eligibility at review date and to support LTV (Lifetime Value) reporting. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS stay history.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Stay History; USALI Guest Statistics; AHLA Loyalty Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this VIP designation record in the silver layer lakehouse. Tracks changes to designation status, special handling instructions, privacy flags, or host assignments. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX per platform conventions.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (data accountability); SOX Section 404 (audit trail); ISO 27001

attributes.name: upgrade_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this VIP designation entitles the guest to complimentary room category upgrades subject to availability at check-in. When true, the front desk system surfaces upgrade options during the check-in workflow in Oracle OPERA PMS.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Upgrade Rules; AHLA Guest Experience Standards

attributes.name: vip_level
attributes.description: Tiered classification of the VIP designation indicating the service protocol level assigned to the guest. VIP1 is entry-level recognition; VIP5 is the highest standard tier. Celebrity, Royalty, Owner, and Board Member are special-class designations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: VIP1|VIP2|VIP3|VIP4|VIP5|Celebrity|Royalty|Owner|Board Member — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS VIP Code Table; AHLA Guest Experience Standards

products.name: stay_history
products.description: Consolidated historical record of all completed guest stays across all properties and brands. Captures arrival date, departure date, property, room type, room number, rate plan, ADR, total revenue (rooms + F&B + ancillary), LOS, number of guests, booking channel, and stay outcome (completed, early departure, extended). Sourced from OPERA PMS post-checkout records. Foundational for LTV calculation, segmentation, and personalization. Distinct from active reservations managed in the reservation domain.

attributes.name: stay_history_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each completed guest stay record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for the stay_history data product. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS post-checkout records.

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the corporate account associated with this stay, applicable when guest_type is 'corporate'. Links to negotiated rate agreements and corporate travel program tracking. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS accounts receivable module.

attributes.name: guest_group_block_id
attributes.description: Reference to the group block associated with this stay, applicable when guest_type is 'group'. Links to group contract, pickup tracking, and group revenue attribution. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS group module.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; Delphi by Amadeus

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the guest profile record representing the primary registered guest for this stay. Supports Lifetime Value (LTV) calculation, segmentation, and personalization across all properties.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property where the stay occurred. Enables property-level performance analytics including ADR, RevPAR, and OCC reporting per USALI standards.

attributes.name: reservation_booking_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating reservation record from which this stay history was created upon checkout. Links stay history back to the reservation domain for full booking-to-stay traceability.

attributes.name: adr
attributes.description: Average Daily Rate (ADR) for the stay, calculated as total room revenue divided by the number of occupied room nights. A primary KPI per USALI and STR STAR Report standards. Expressed in the property's local currency. Used for RevPAR computation and competitive benchmarking via STR.
attributes.references: USALI; STR STAR Report; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: ancillary_revenue
attributes.description: Total ancillary charges posted to the guest folio during the stay, including spa, parking, laundry, telephone, and other non-room, non-F&B charges. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS. Contributes to TRevPAR and GOPPAR calculations per USALI.

attributes.name: arrival_date
attributes.description: Actual date the guest checked in to the property (yyyy-MM-dd). May differ from the originally reserved arrival date in cases of early arrival or late arrival. Used as the principal business event date for stay analytics and STR benchmarking.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; STR STAR Report

attributes.name: booking_channel_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the distribution channel through which the reservation was originally made (e.g., direct_web, ota, gds, voice, walk_in, corporate_direct). Sourced from Sabre SynXis CRS channel mapping. Used for channel contribution and OTA partnership analysis.

attributes.name: booking_date
attributes.description: Date on which the reservation was originally created (yyyy-MM-dd). Used to calculate booking lead time (days between booking_date and arrival_date), a key input for demand forecasting and pickup report analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: checkin_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time the guest completed the check-in process at the front desk or via mobile/digital check-in (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS front desk module. Used for operational SLA tracking and guest experience analytics.

attributes.name: checkout_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time the guest completed the checkout process (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS cashiering module. Marks the point at which the stay record is finalized and posted to the stay history.

attributes.name: complimentary_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stay was provided on a complimentary (no-charge) basis (True = complimentary; False = revenue-generating stay). Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS. Used for USALI complimentary room reporting and GOP calculation.

attributes.name: confirmation_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric confirmation number assigned by the Central Reservation System (CRS) or Property Management System (PMS) at time of booking. Used by guests and agents to reference the stay. Sourced from Sabre SynXis CRS or Oracle OPERA PMS.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this stay history record was first created in the silver layer lakehouse, typically upon post-checkout processing from Oracle OPERA PMS (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for data lineage, audit trail, and ETL pipeline monitoring.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; GDPR Article 5; SOX

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all monetary amounts on this stay record are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency properties and international financial reporting under IFRS/GAAP.

attributes.name: departure_date
attributes.description: Actual date the guest checked out of the property (yyyy-MM-dd). May differ from the originally reserved departure date in cases of early departure or extended stay. Used in conjunction with arrival_date to compute Length of Stay (LOS).
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; STR STAR Report

attributes.name: do_not_disturb_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guest activated Do Not Disturb (DND) status during the stay (True = DND activated at any point; False = DND not activated). Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS housekeeping module. Used for housekeeping scheduling and guest preference analytics.

attributes.name: fb_revenue
attributes.description: Total Food and Beverage (F&B) charges posted to the guest folio during the stay, including restaurant, bar, room service, and minibar charges. Sourced from Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS. Contributes to TRevPAR calculation.

attributes.name: gss_score
attributes.description: Overall Guest Satisfaction Score (GSS) for the stay as captured by Medallia post-stay survey, typically on a scale of 1-10 or 1-100 depending on survey instrument. Distinct from NPS; measures overall satisfaction rather than likelihood to recommend. Used for Satisfaction and Loyalty Tracking (SALT) reporting.

attributes.name: guest_type
attributes.description: Classification of the guest stay by traveler category. 'fit' (Free Independent Traveler) indicates leisure individual; 'corporate' indicates business traveler under a negotiated account; 'group' indicates part of a group block; 'crew' indicates airline or transport crew; 'complimentary' indicates no-charge stay. Drives segmentation and LTV modeling.

attributes.name: los_nights
attributes.description: Actual number of nights the guest stayed at the property, computed as departure_date minus arrival_date. A core metric for Average Length of Stay (ALOS) analysis, revenue management, and demand forecasting in IDeaS G3 RMS.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; IDeaS G3 RMS; USALI

attributes.name: loyalty_member_number
attributes.description: Loyalty program membership number associated with the guest for this stay. Used to post loyalty points, track qualifying nights, and calculate tier status. Sourced from Salesforce CRM loyalty management module. Subject to GDPR and CCPA privacy regulations.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_earned
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points earned by the guest for this stay, based on the applicable earning rate for the rate plan, room type, and member tier. Sourced from Salesforce CRM loyalty management. Used for loyalty program liability accrual and member engagement analytics.

attributes.name: loyalty_tier_at_stay
attributes.description: The guest's loyalty program tier level at the time of the stay (e.g., Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond). Captured as a snapshot to preserve historical tier context for LTV analysis and personalization, independent of the guest's current tier. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product as tiers vary by brand]

attributes.name: market_segment_code
attributes.description: Market segment classification assigned to the stay per USALI and STR reporting standards (e.g., transient, group, contract, wholesale). Used for Revenue Management System (RMS) demand forecasting and STR STAR Report benchmarking.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; USALI; STR STAR Report

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Net Promoter Score (NPS) provided by the guest for this stay, on a scale of 0-10. Sourced from Medallia post-stay survey. Used for Guest Satisfaction Score (GSS) tracking, service recovery identification, and experience analytics. Null if guest did not respond to survey.

attributes.name: num_adults
attributes.description: Count of adult guests (18 years and older) registered for the stay as recorded in Oracle OPERA PMS. Used for occupancy reporting, F&B revenue forecasting, and capacity planning.

attributes.name: num_children
attributes.description: Count of child guests (under 18 years) registered for the stay as recorded in Oracle OPERA PMS. Used for family segment analytics, amenity planning, and F&B revenue forecasting.

attributes.name: original_arrival_date
attributes.description: The arrival date as originally reserved at time of booking, before any modifications. Used to measure early arrival or late arrival deviations and to support wash factor analysis in IDeaS G3 RMS.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: original_departure_date
attributes.description: The departure date as originally reserved at time of booking, before any modifications. Used to identify early departure and extended stay patterns for demand forecasting and wash factor analysis in IDeaS G3 RMS.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Primary payment instrument used to settle the guest folio at checkout. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS cashiering module. attributes.name: qualifying_nights
attributes.description: Number of nights from this stay that count toward the guest's loyalty program tier qualification. May differ from los_nights if the rate plan is non-qualifying (e.g., wholesale, complimentary). Sourced from Salesforce CRM loyalty management.

attributes.name: rate_plan_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the rate plan under which the stay was booked (e.g., BAR, LRA, NRR, corporate negotiated, package). Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS and Sabre SynXis CRS. Critical for revenue management analysis and channel contribution reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: room_number
attributes.description: Physical room number assigned to the guest for the duration of the stay as recorded in Oracle OPERA PMS. Supports housekeeping scheduling, maintenance tracking, and room-level revenue attribution.

attributes.name: room_revenue
attributes.description: Total room charges posted to the guest folio for the entire stay, excluding taxes, fees, and ancillary charges. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS cashiering module. Core component of RevPAR and TRevPAR calculations per USALI.

attributes.name: room_type_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the room type category occupied during the stay (e.g., KING, DBLQ, SUITE, DLXK). Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS room inventory. Used for room type mix analysis, upsell tracking, and RevPAR decomposition.

attributes.name: service_recovery_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a service recovery action was initiated during or after this stay (True = service recovery case opened; False = no service recovery). attributes.name: stay_status
attributes.description: Outcome status of the guest stay upon checkout processing. 'completed' indicates normal checkout on scheduled departure date; 'early_departure' indicates guest checked out before scheduled departure; 'extended' indicates stay was prolonged beyond original departure date; 'no_show' indicates reservation was not cancelled but guest never arrived; 'cancelled' indicates reservation was cancelled post-check-in processing.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax charges applied to the guest folio for the stay, including occupancy tax, VAT, city tax, and other applicable levies. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS cashiering. Required for IFRS/GAAP financial reporting and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; IFRS/GAAP; SOX; USALI

attributes.name: total_folio_amount
attributes.description: Total amount charged to the guest folio for the entire stay, inclusive of room revenue, F&B revenue, ancillary revenue, and taxes. Represents the gross billing amount settled at checkout. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS cashiering module.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this stay history record was last modified in the silver layer lakehouse (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Captures post-checkout adjustments such as folio corrections, survey score updates, or loyalty point recalculations. Used for data lineage and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; GDPR Article 5; SOX

attributes.name: vip_code
attributes.description: VIP designation code assigned to the guest for this stay in Oracle OPERA PMS (e.g., VIP1, VIP2, VVIP, CELEB). Drives special handling, amenity delivery, and management attention protocols. Null if guest has no VIP designation.

products.name: note
products.description: Freeform and structured notes and alerts attached to guest profiles by property staff. attributes.name: creator_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member (employee) who created the note. Enables accountability tracking and follow-up assignment.

attributes.name: event_booking_id

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the guest profile to which this note is attached. Links the note to the unified guest identity record.

attributes.name: property_id

attributes.name: resolved_by_staff_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member who marked the note as resolved. Enables accountability and service recovery performance measurement.

attributes.name: action_date
attributes.description: The specific hotel business date on which the note action or trace is scheduled to be executed (e.g., the date a pre-arrival amenity should be placed). Distinct from expiry_date which governs visibility.

attributes.name: assigned_department

attributes.name: authoring_department
attributes.description: The hotel department that created the note (e.g., Front Desk, Housekeeping, Food and Beverage, Concierge, Revenue Management, Security, Guest Relations). attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; USALI Department Coding Standards

attributes.name: note_category
attributes.description: Secondary classification providing finer-grained grouping within a note type (e.g., Room Preference, Dietary Restriction, Billing Alert, VIP Protocol, Housekeeping Instruction, Security Alert). attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: data_retention_category

attributes.name: display_on_checkin
attributes.description: Indicates whether this note should be automatically surfaced to front desk staff during the guest check-in process. True = display at check-in; False = do not auto-display. Supports pre-arrival briefing and service personalization.

attributes.name: display_on_checkout
attributes.description: Indicates whether this note should be surfaced to front desk staff during the guest check-out process. True = display at check-out; False = do not auto-display. Useful for billing alerts or follow-up actions at departure.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Front Desk; AHLA Guest Experience Standards

attributes.name: display_on_reservation
attributes.description: Indicates whether this note should be surfaced to reservations agents when a new booking is made for this guest. True = display during reservation creation; False = do not auto-display. Supports proactive service planning.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Reservations; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date after which the note is no longer considered active or actionable. Null indicates the note has no expiry and remains permanently active. Used to auto-expire time-bound traces and alerts.

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guest has provided consent for this type of personal preference data to be stored and processed under GDPR Article 6. True = consent obtained; False = consent not obtained or withdrawn. Critical for EU/EEA guest data compliance.

attributes.name: guest_segment
attributes.description: The guest segment classification at the time the note was created. Free Independent Traveler (FIT), corporate, group, VIP, loyalty elite, or airline crew. Supports segment-specific service delivery and analytics.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profiles; Salesforce CRM; AHLA Segmentation Standards

attributes.name: is_confidential
attributes.description: Indicates whether the note content is restricted to management-level staff only and should not be visible to all front-line employees. True = management-only visibility; False = visible to all authorized staff.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; GDPR Article 5; CCPA

attributes.name: is_vip_alert
attributes.description: Indicates whether this note is specifically flagged as a VIP protocol alert requiring elevated service standards. True = VIP alert; False = standard note. Drives VIP pre-arrival briefing workflows.

attributes.name: language_code

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the note was most recently updated by any staff member. Supports audit trail and change detection in the Silver layer ETL pipeline.

attributes.name: loyalty_member_number

attributes.name: note_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the note was created, aligned to the hotel operational date (which may differ from the calendar date for overnight shifts). Used for daily operations reporting (DOR) and pre-arrival briefing.

attributes.name: note_status

attributes.name: note_type

attributes.name: priority_flag

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Graduated priority ranking of the note for staff triage and pre-arrival briefing. Critical notes require immediate escalation; high notes require same-day action; medium notes are addressed during the stay; low notes are informational.

attributes.name: recurrence_flag

attributes.name: resolution_notes

attributes.name: resolved_timestamp

attributes.name: source_channel

products.name: communication_consent

attributes.name: communication_consent_id

attributes.name: privacy_request_id
attributes.description: Reference to a data subject access request (DSAR) or right-to-erasure request that triggered this consent record update. Null if not related to a DSAR.

attributes.name: consent_audit_trail
attributes.description: Structured or semi-structured audit trail capturing the history of consent changes, including who made changes, when, and why. May be JSON or delimited text format.

attributes.name: consent_capture_url
attributes.description: The URL of the web page or application screen where the consent was captured. Helps trace back to the exact consent form version and context.

attributes.name: consent_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the consent expires and must be re-confirmed. Null for consents without expiration. Some jurisdictions and internal policies require periodic re-consent.

attributes.name: consent_granted_date
attributes.description: The date on which the guest provided explicit consent for the specified communication type and purpose. Critical for GDPR and CCPA compliance audit trails.

attributes.name: consent_granted_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when consent was granted, including time zone information. Provides granular audit trail for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: consent_language_code
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO 639-1 language code indicating the language in which the consent was presented and captured. Required for demonstrating informed consent in the guest native language.

attributes.name: consent_method

products.name: segment
products.description: Guest market segmentation master definitions and individual guest-to-segment assignment records. The master component defines business segments (transient, group, contract, wholesale, complimentary, crew) with segment code, name, hierarchy level, USALI mapping, and applicable rate strategy. The assignment component tracks individual guest-to-segment associations including assignment date, assignment method (rule-based, ML-inferred, manual override), confidence score, validity period, and superseding assignment reference. products.name: profile_merge_history
products.description: Audit trail of guest profile merge and deduplication events recording when duplicate profiles are identified and consolidated into a single golden record. Captures source (non-surviving) profile ID, target (surviving) profile ID, merge timestamp, merge reason (duplicate detected, guest-requested consolidation, property-initiated cleanup), merge method (automatic fuzzy match, manual review, bulk batch), matching criteria used (name+DOB, email+phone, loyalty ID), matching confidence score, operator/system ID, affected child record counts (reservations, stays, preferences migrated), and rollback eligibility flag. Critical for MDM data quality governance, GDPR right-to-erasure audit compliance, CRM data integrity, and loyalty points consolidation verification. Sourced from OPERA PMS Profile Merge utility and Salesforce CRM deduplication workflows.

products.name: corporate_property_contract
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between corporate_account and property. It captures property-specific negotiated rate agreements, billing arrangements, and room night commitments that exist only in the context of a specific corporate account contracting with a specific hotel property. Each record links one corporate account to one property with contract terms, performance targets, and payment arrangements that are negotiated and managed independently per property.. Existence Justification: Corporate accounts negotiate independent contracts with each property in the hotel portfolio. A national corporate account (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte) contracts with 50+ properties across the portfolio, and each property has contracts with dozens of local, regional, and national corporate accounts. Each contract is negotiated separately with property-specific rate codes, discount levels, room night targets, payment terms, and blackout dates. Sales teams manage these contracts property-by-property, and revenue management systems track pickup against contracted room nights per property.

products.name: group_function_space_booking
products.description: This association product represents the event booking relationship between guest group blocks and meeting spaces. It captures the operational assignment of specific function spaces to group events, including setup requirements, attendance guarantees, rental charges, and catering commitments. Each record links one guest group block to one meeting space for a specific event or function within the group's stay, enabling detailed function space inventory management and BEO (Banquet Event Order) execution.. Existence Justification: In travel hospitality operations, group blocks routinely reserve multiple meeting spaces for their events (e.g., a corporate conference books a ballroom for general sessions plus three breakout rooms and a boardroom for executive meetings). Simultaneously, high-demand meeting spaces like ballrooms host dozens of different group blocks throughout the year. Event coordinators actively manage these bookings in Delphi/OPERA with detailed function-specific data including setup type, timing, attendance guarantees, AV needs, and rental charges that belong to neither the group block nor the meeting space alone.

products.name: guest_enrollment
products.description: This association product represents the enrollment event between a guest profile and a loyalty promotion. It captures the member's participation lifecycle in a specific promotional offer, including enrollment channel, progress toward qualifying criteria, completion status, and bonus award fulfillment. Each record links one guest profile to one promotion with attributes that exist only in the context of this participation relationship.. Existence Justification: In travel hospitality loyalty programs, promotion enrollments represent a true many-to-many operational relationship. A single guest profile enrolls in multiple active promotions simultaneously (e.g., Double Points Summer, Stay 3 Get Bonus, Birthday Bonus), and each promotion has thousands of enrolled members. The business actively manages these enrollments as distinct entities, tracking enrollment-specific data such as progress toward qualifying criteria, completion status, and bonus award fulfillment that belongs neither to the profile nor the promotion alone.

products.name: segment_membership
products.description: This association product represents the assignment of guest profiles to marketing segments for campaign targeting and personalization. It captures the many-to-many relationship between guest profiles and marketing segments, where a single guest can belong to multiple segments simultaneously (e.g., High-Value Leisure + Spa Enthusiast + West Coast Traveler), and each segment contains thousands of guest profiles. Each record links one profile to one segment with assignment metadata including confidence scores, effective dates, assignment methods (rule-based vs ML-predicted), and reason codes that exist only in the context of this membership relationship.. Existence Justification: In the travel hospitality business, guest profiles are simultaneously assigned to multiple marketing segments for campaign targeting and personalization (e.g., a single guest can be tagged as High-Value Leisure + Spa Enthusiast + West Coast Traveler), and each segment contains thousands of guest profiles. Marketing teams actively manage these multi-segment memberships with assignment confidence scores, effective dates, assignment methods (rule-based vs ML-predicted), and reason codes. This is an operational many-to-many relationship that the business actively creates, updates, and queries for campaign audience list generation.

domains.name: reservation
domains.description: Core transactional domain managing the full booking lifecycle from inquiry through confirmation, modification, cancellation, and no-show management. Handles individual reservations, group blocks, and corporate bookings across all channels (direct, OTA, GDS, CRS). Tracks booking status, arrival/departure dates, room types, rate codes, special requests, and guarantee methods. Integrates with Oracle OPERA PMS and Sabre SynXis CRS.

products.name: reservation_booking
products.description: Core master record for an individual guest reservation across all booking channels (direct, OTA, GDS, CRS via Sabre SynXis). products.name: booking_status_history
products.description: Immutable audit trail of all reservation lifecycle events including status transitions (Inquiry → Tentative → Confirmed → Modified → Cancelled → No-Show → Checked-In → Checked-Out) and all booking modifications. For status changes, captures previous status, new status, transition timestamp, triggering agent/system, and reason code. For modifications (the SSOT for all amendment records), captures amendment type (date change, room type upgrade/downgrade, rate plan switch, occupancy change, special request update), original values, new values, modification channel, modification timestamp, agent ID, and any associated rate difference or penalty fee. Enables lifecycle analytics, SLA compliance tracking, revenue impact analysis, dispute resolution, and guest service recovery workflows. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS status change and modification events.

products.name: cancellation
products.description: Transactional record capturing all reservation non-fulfillment events including guest cancellations, property-initiated cancellations, OTA-initiated cancellations, and no-show (non-arrival) events. For cancellations: records event date/time, reason code, applicable cancellation policy, penalty/fee amount, cancellation window evaluation, refund eligibility, and processing channel. For no-shows: records no-show date, no-show fee charged, guarantee method used for charge, automatic guarantee charge processing, and OTA chargeback eligibility. Common fields: waiver flag, waiver reason, posting status to guest folio, processing agent/channel, and any subsequent dispute or reversal. Critical for revenue leakage analysis, NRR policy enforcement, revenue recovery operations, OTA chargeback management, and CPOR (Cost Per Occupied Room) reporting.
