products.name: group_block_pickup
products.description: Transactional record tracking individual reservation pickups against a group block, capturing the booking reference, pickup date, room type consumed, rate applied, and remaining block inventory. Enables real-time group block utilization monitoring, attrition risk assessment, and cutoff date management. Supports revenue management decisions on releasing unsold group inventory back to transient availability.

attributes.name: group_block_pickup_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the group block pickup transaction. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: HTNG (Hotel Technology Next Generation) - Reservation Data Standards

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property where the group block pickup occurred. Enables property-level group performance analysis.

attributes.name: reservation_booking_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual reservation that consumed inventory from the group block. Links to the transactional reservation record.

attributes.name: reservation_group_block_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent group block from which this pickup was made. Links to the master group block allocation.

attributes.name: arrival_date
attributes.description: Scheduled check-in date for the pickup reservation. Used for occupancy forecasting and group block utilization analysis.

attributes.name: block_utilization_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the total group block consumed at the time of this pickup. Calculated as (total_block_rooms - remaining_block_rooms) / total_block_rooms * 100.

attributes.name: booking_channel_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the channel through which the pickup was made (e.g., DIRECT, GDS, OTA, CRS). Enables channel attribution analysis for group blocks.

attributes.name: booking_source
attributes.description: Specific source system or platform that originated the pickup (e.g., OPERA, SynXis, Delphi). Used for system integration tracking.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Date when this pickup reservation was cancelled, if applicable. Used for attrition analysis and wash factor calculation.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for cancellation. Supports root cause analysis of group block attrition.

attributes.name: company_name
attributes.description: Name of the company or organization associated with this pickup. Links individual reservations to corporate accounts.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this pickup record was first created in the data platform. Supports data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the rate amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Essential for multi-currency group block management.

attributes.name: cutoff_date
attributes.description: Date by which the group block inventory must be picked up or released back to general inventory. Critical for attrition management.

attributes.name: departure_date
attributes.description: Scheduled check-out date for the pickup reservation. Used to calculate Length of Stay (LOS) and room night consumption.

attributes.name: group_attendee_type
attributes.description: Classification of the attendee role within the group event. Supports rooming list segmentation and billing allocation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: attendee|speaker|organizer|exhibitor|sponsor|staff|guest — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HTNG - MICE (Meetings Incentives Conferences Exhibitions) Standards

attributes.name: guarantee_type
attributes.description: Method used to guarantee the pickup reservation. Critical for no-show risk assessment and revenue assurance.

attributes.name: guest_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for the guest on this pickup reservation. Used for confirmation and pre-arrival communication.

attributes.name: guest_name
attributes.description: Full name of the guest associated with this pickup reservation. Used for rooming list management and guest communication.

attributes.name: guest_phone
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the guest. Critical for day-of-arrival communication and service recovery.

attributes.name: loyalty_member_number
attributes.description: Loyalty program membership identifier for the guest. Enables points accrual and tier benefit application for group pickups.

attributes.name: market_segment_code
attributes.description: Market segment classification for this pickup (e.g., CORPORATE, LEISURE, GOVERNMENT). Supports segmentation analysis within group blocks.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this pickup record was last updated. Enables change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: nights
attributes.description: Total number of room nights consumed by this pickup. Calculated as departure_date minus arrival_date. Key metric for group block utilization.

attributes.name: no_show_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guest failed to arrive for this pickup reservation. Critical for no-show rate tracking and revenue recovery.

attributes.name: pickup_before_cutoff_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pickup occurred before the group block cutoff date. Used to assess on-time pickup performance.

attributes.name: pickup_number
attributes.description: Business-readable identifier for the pickup transaction, typically generated by the Property Management System (PMS) or Central Reservation System (CRS).

attributes.name: pickup_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the pickup reservation. Tracks progression from initial booking through completion or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: confirmed|tentative|cancelled|no_show|checked_in|checked_out|waitlisted — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: pickup_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the individual reservation was booked against the group block inventory. Critical for tracking pickup velocity and cutoff date management.

attributes.name: rate_amount
attributes.description: Nightly room rate applied to this pickup reservation. Used to calculate total room revenue and compare against Best Available Rate (BAR).

attributes.name: rate_code
attributes.description: Rate plan code applied to this pickup reservation. Typically the negotiated group rate code from the master group block contract.

attributes.name: remaining_block_rooms
attributes.description: Number of rooms remaining in the group block after this pickup. Snapshot metric for real-time utilization monitoring.

attributes.name: room_type_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific room type consumed from the group block inventory (e.g., KING, QUEEN, SUITE). Enables room type mix analysis.

attributes.name: room_type_name
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the room type consumed (e.g., Deluxe King, Executive Suite). Supports reporting and guest communication.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this pickup record in the source operational system. Enables cross-system reconciliation and data traceability.

attributes.name: special_requests
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing guest special requests for this pickup (e.g., high floor, accessible room, early check-in). Supports service delivery.

attributes.name: total_room_revenue
attributes.description: Total room revenue generated by this pickup, calculated as rate_amount multiplied by nights. Excludes taxes and fees.

attributes.name: vip_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this pickup is for a VIP guest requiring special handling. Drives service prioritization and amenity allocation.

products.name: reservation_rate_plan
products.description: Reservation-scoped reference master for the bookable rate plan catalog presented to guests and agents via CRS and PMS. Includes BAR (Best Available Rate), LRA (Last Room Availability), NRR (Non-Refundable Rate), corporate negotiated rates, package rates, and promotional rates. Stores rate plan code, rate plan name, rate category, cancellation policy reference, guarantee requirements, minimum LOS restrictions, advance purchase requirements, and channel eligibility flags. SSOT BOUNDARY: This domain owns the bookable rate plan catalog (what can be sold and under what terms). The revenue domain owns rate strategy, pricing optimization, yield management, and dynamic rate amounts. Rate plan records here are synchronized from Sabre SynXis CRS rate configuration and reflect IDeaS G3 RMS rate strategy outputs as read-only pricing inputs.
products.reference: Sabre SynXis CRS Rate Plan / IDeaS G3 Rate Code

attributes.name: reservation_rate_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the reservation rate plan record. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: HTNG (Hotel Technology Next Generation) - Data Standards

attributes.name: cancellation_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservation.cancellation_policy. Business justification: Reservation_rate_plan currently references policy via cancellation_policy_code (string). Normalizing to FK allows joining to get full policy details. Rate plans are defined with specific cancellation

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Audit trail for rate plan authorship is critical revenue management and compliance requirement. Tracks which revenue manager created rate plans for pricing accountability and regulatory audit. No exis

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: add column property_id (BIGINT) with FK to property.property.property_id - reservation rate plans are property-specific

attributes.name: revenue_rate_plan_id
attributes.description: add column revenue_rate_plan_id (BIGINT) with FK to revenue.revenue_rate_plan.revenue_rate_plan_id - reservation rate plans should reference the master rate plan definition

attributes.name: advance_purchase_days
attributes.description: Number of days in advance that a booking must be made to qualify for this rate plan. Common for promotional and non-refundable rates (e.g., 7-day, 14-day, 21-day advance purchase). Null or 0 indicates no advance purchase requirement.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Advance Purchase Strategy, HTNG Rate Restriction Standards

attributes.name: booking_window_end_days
attributes.description: Number of days before arrival when this rate plan is no longer available for booking. Used to close last-minute bookings for certain rate plans. Null indicates no end restriction.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Booking Window Controls

attributes.name: booking_window_start_days
attributes.description: Number of days before arrival when this rate plan becomes available for booking. Used to control early booking windows for promotional rates. Null indicates no start restriction.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Booking Window Controls

attributes.name: channel_corporate_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate plan is available for booking through corporate direct billing channels. Requires corporate account setup and negotiated rate agreement.

attributes.name: channel_direct_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate plan is available for booking through direct channels (property website, call center, front desk). True for most rate plans; false for channel-exclusive rates.

attributes.name: channel_gds_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate plan is available for booking through GDS channels (Sabre, Amadeus, Galileo, Worldspan). Typically used for corporate and travel agent bookings.
attributes.references: HTNG GDS Connectivity Standards, Sabre SynXis CRS Integration

attributes.name: channel_group_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate plan is available for group block bookings through MICE and event sales channels. Managed via Delphi by Amadeus for group inventory allocation.
attributes.references: HTNG Group Booking Standards, Delphi BEO Integration

attributes.name: channel_ota_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate plan is available for booking through OTA channels (Expedia, Booking.com, etc.). Subject to rate parity agreements and channel management rules.
attributes.references: HTNG Channel Distribution Standards, Rate Parity Compliance

attributes.name: commission_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the room rate paid as commission to the booking channel or agent. Typically 10-25% for OTAs, 10% for travel agents. Null if commissionable_flag is false.
attributes.references: HTNG Commission Standards, OTA Contract Terms

attributes.name: commissionable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether bookings under this rate plan are eligible for travel agent or OTA commission. True for most OTA and GDS rates; false for net rates and direct promotional rates.
attributes.references: HTNG Commission Standards, OTA Contract Terms

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this rate plan record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and lifecycle tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls, GDPR Data Lineage

attributes.name: display_sequence
attributes.description: The order in which this rate plan should be displayed to guests and agents in the booking interface. Lower numbers appear first. Used to prioritize high-value or strategic rate plans.
attributes.references: HTNG User Interface Standards, Revenue Management Best Practices

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date after which this rate plan is no longer available for booking or stay dates. Nullable for evergreen rate plans like BAR. Used for promotional and seasonal rate plan expiration.
attributes.references: USALI Revenue Recognition, IDeaS G3 RMS Strategy Calendar

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this rate plan becomes available for booking and stay dates. Aligns with revenue management strategy and seasonal pricing windows.
attributes.references: USALI Revenue Recognition, IDeaS G3 RMS Strategy Calendar

attributes.name: guarantee_method
attributes.description: The method by which the reservation must be guaranteed. Credit card: hold on card; Deposit: partial payment required; Prepayment: full payment required; Direct bill: corporate account billing; None: no guarantee required.
attributes.references: PCI DSS Payment Security Standards, HTNG Guarantee Standards

attributes.name: guarantee_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a payment guarantee (credit card, deposit, or prepayment) is required at the time of booking for this rate plan. True for most rate plans; false for select corporate or group rates with direct billing arrangements.
attributes.references: PCI DSS Payment Security Standards, HTNG Guarantee Requirements

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this rate plan record was last updated. Used for change tracking and synchronization across systems.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls, GDPR Data Lineage

attributes.name: loyalty_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether stays booked under this rate plan are eligible for loyalty program points accrual and elite benefits. True for most direct and qualified rates; false for opaque and deeply discounted rates.
attributes.references: HTNG Loyalty Program Standards, Salesforce CRM Loyalty Rules

attributes.name: loyalty_points_multiplier
attributes.description: The multiplier applied to base loyalty points earned for stays under this rate plan. Standard rates typically have 1.0x; promotional rates may have 0.5x or 2.0x multipliers. Null if loyalty_eligible_flag is false.
attributes.references: HTNG Loyalty Program Standards, Salesforce CRM Loyalty Rules

attributes.name: market_segment_code
attributes.description: Reference code to the market segment this rate plan targets. Examples: TRAN (transient), CORP (corporate), GROUP (group), LEISURE (leisure). Used for revenue reporting and STR benchmarking.
attributes.references: STR Market Segment Standards, USALI Revenue Segmentation

attributes.name: maximum_length_of_stay
attributes.description: Maximum number of nights allowed for a booking under this rate plan. Used to prevent long-stay bookings from blocking high-value short-stay demand. Null indicates no maximum restriction.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS LOS Controls, HTNG Rate Restriction Standards

attributes.name: member_only_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate plan is exclusively available to loyalty program members. True for member-exclusive rates; false for public rates.
attributes.references: HTNG Loyalty Program Standards, Salesforce CRM Member Segmentation

attributes.name: minimum_length_of_stay
attributes.description: Minimum number of nights required for a booking under this rate plan. Used for revenue optimization during high-demand periods. Null or 1 indicates no minimum restriction.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS LOS Controls, HTNG Rate Restriction Standards

attributes.name: package_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the amenities, services, or F&B components included in the package rate. Examples: Daily breakfast for two, $50 spa credit, complimentary parking, welcome amenity. Null for non-package rates.
attributes.references: USALI F&B Revenue Allocation, HTNG Package Rate Standards

attributes.name: package_inclusion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate plan includes bundled amenities, services, or F&B components (e.g., breakfast included, spa credit, parking). True for package rates; false for room-only rates.
attributes.references: USALI F&B Revenue Allocation, HTNG Package Rate Standards

attributes.name: rate_plan_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the rate plan type for segmentation and reporting. Standard includes BAR and rack rates; corporate includes negotiated business rates; promotional includes limited-time offers; package includes bundled F&B or amenities; group includes MICE block rates; wholesale includes tour operator allotments; opaque includes non-branded OTA rates; member includes loyalty program rates; government includes public sector rates. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|corporate|promotional|package|group|wholesale|opaque|member|government — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USALI Revenue Classification, STR Benchmarking Standards

attributes.name: rate_plan_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the rate plan as configured in the CRS and PMS. Examples: BAR, CORP, AAA, PKG, NRF. This is the externally-known code used across all distribution channels.
attributes.references: HTNG Rate Plan Code Standard, Sabre SynXis CRS Rate Configuration

attributes.name: rate_plan_description
attributes.description: Detailed business description of the rate plan, including terms, conditions, restrictions, and benefits. Used for guest communication and agent training.

attributes.name: rate_plan_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the rate plan displayed to guests and agents. Examples: Best Available Rate, Corporate Negotiated Rate, AAA Member Rate, Romance Package, Non-Refundable Rate.

attributes.name: rate_plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the rate plan. Active: available for booking; Inactive: not available for new bookings; Suspended: temporarily disabled; Pending: awaiting approval or activation; Expired: past effective end date.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the system of record where this rate plan was originally configured. SYNXIS: Sabre SynXis CRS; OPERA: Oracle OPERA PMS; IDEAS: IDeaS G3 RMS strategy output; MANUAL: manually configured rate plan.

attributes.name: terms_and_conditions
attributes.description: Legal terms and conditions governing the rate plan, including cancellation penalties, modification rules, no-show charges, and guest obligations. Must comply with consumer protection regulations.
attributes.references: GDPR Consumer Rights, CCPA Disclosure Requirements, FTC Advertising Standards

products.name: cancellation_policy
products.description: Reference master defining the terms and conditions for reservation cancellation, including the policy code, policy name, free cancellation window (hours/days before arrival), penalty structure (first night, percentage of stay, flat fee), non-refundable flag, and applicable rate plan associations. Manages multiple policy tiers (flexible, moderate, strict, non-refundable) aligned with revenue management strategy. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS policy configuration.

attributes.name: cancellation_policy_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cancellation policy. Primary key.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: add column property_id (BIGINT) with FK to property.property.property_id - cancellation policies vary by property and this reference table has zero outbound FKs

attributes.name: allows_modification
attributes.description: Indicates whether reservations under this policy allow date or room type modifications without cancellation. False for most non-refundable policies.
attributes.references: HTNG (Hotel Technology Next Generation) - AHLA Technology

attributes.name: applies_to_corporate_bookings
attributes.description: Indicates whether this policy can be applied to corporate negotiated rate bookings. Corporate accounts may have special cancellation terms.
attributes.references: HTNG (Hotel Technology Next Generation) - AHLA Technology

attributes.name: applies_to_group_bookings
attributes.description: Indicates whether this policy can be applied to group block reservations. Group policies often have different terms than individual FIT (Free Independent Traveler) bookings.
attributes.references: HTNG (Hotel Technology Next Generation) - AHLA Technology

attributes.name: channel_restrictions
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of booking channels where this policy applies or is restricted. Examples: direct_only, ota_excluded, gds_only. Null indicates no channel restrictions.
attributes.references: HTNG (Hotel Technology Next Generation) - AHLA Technology

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the system user who created this cancellation policy. Part of audit trail for policy governance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cancellation policy record was first created in the system. Part of audit trail for policy lifecycle management.

attributes.name: deposit_due_days_before_arrival
attributes.description: Number of days before arrival date by which the deposit must be received. Null indicates deposit due at time of booking.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: deposit_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of total reservation value required as deposit when deposit_required is true. Value stored as decimal (e.g., 100.00 for full prepayment).
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: deposit_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether an advance deposit payment is required at time of booking under this policy. Common for non-refundable and group bookings.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: display_order
attributes.description: Numeric sequence for ordering policies in user interfaces and booking engines. Lower numbers appear first. Used for presenting policies from most to least flexible.
attributes.references: HTNG (Hotel Technology Next Generation) - AHLA Technology

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this cancellation policy is no longer active for new reservations. Null indicates policy is currently active with no planned end date.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this cancellation policy becomes active and can be applied to new reservations. Part of policy lifecycle management.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: free_cancellation_window_days
attributes.description: Number of days before scheduled arrival date during which a guest can cancel without penalty. Alternative to hours-based window for longer lead-time policies.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: free_cancellation_window_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours before scheduled arrival time during which a guest can cancel without penalty. Null indicates no free cancellation window.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: guarantee_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a payment guarantee (credit card, deposit, or prepayment) is required to book under this cancellation policy. Typically true for stricter policies.
attributes.references: PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard)

attributes.name: guest_facing_summary
attributes.description: Concise, guest-friendly summary of the cancellation policy displayed during booking process. Typically 1-2 sentences highlighting key terms.
attributes.references: HTNG (Hotel Technology Next Generation) - AHLA Technology

attributes.name: internal_notes
attributes.description: Internal staff notes and operational guidance for applying this cancellation policy. Not visible to guests. Used for training and exception handling.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: is_non_refundable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this policy represents a non-refundable rate where no refund is provided under any circumstances. True for NRR (Non-Refundable Rate) policies.
attributes.references: HTNG (Hotel Technology Next Generation) - AHLA Technology

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the system user who last modified this cancellation policy. Supports change tracking and accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cancellation policy record was last updated. Tracks policy changes for revenue management analysis and compliance audit.

attributes.name: legal_terms_text
attributes.description: Full legal terms and conditions text for the cancellation policy, including jurisdiction-specific consumer protection disclosures required by GDPR, CCPA, and local regulations.
attributes.references: GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation), CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act)

attributes.name: modification_fee
attributes.description: Fixed fee charged for modifying a reservation when allows_modification is true. Null if no modification fee applies. Currency is property base currency.

attributes.name: no_show_penalty_amount
attributes.description: Fixed monetary penalty charged for no-show when no_show_penalty_type is flat_fee. Currency is property base currency per USALI standards.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: no_show_penalty_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of total reservation value charged as penalty for no-show when no_show_penalty_type is percentage_of_stay. Value stored as decimal.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: no_show_penalty_type
attributes.description: Type of penalty applied when a guest fails to arrive (no-show). May differ from standard cancellation penalty to account for lost revenue opportunity.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: Fixed monetary penalty amount charged for cancellation when penalty_type is flat_fee. Currency is property base currency per USALI standards.

attributes.name: penalty_nights_count
attributes.description: Number of nights charged as penalty when penalty_type is first_night or nights_based. Typically 1 for first night penalty, can be higher for stricter policies.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: penalty_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of total reservation value charged as penalty when penalty_type is percentage_of_stay. Value stored as decimal (e.g., 50.00 for 50%).
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: penalty_type
attributes.description: Type of penalty applied when cancellation occurs outside the free cancellation window. Determines how the cancellation charge is calculated.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: policy_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the cancellation policy used in PMS (Property Management System) and CRS (Central Reservation System) systems. Examples: FLEX, MOD, STRICT, NRF.
attributes.references: HTNG (Hotel Technology Next Generation) - AHLA Technology

attributes.name: policy_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the cancellation policy terms and conditions, including guest-facing language explaining cancellation rules, deadlines, and penalties.

products.name: program_enrollment
products.description: This association product represents the enrollment contract between a guest reservation and a wellness program. It captures the guest's participation in structured multi-day wellness programs, including medical clearances, dietary customizations, program scheduling, and completion tracking. Each record links one reservation to one wellness program with enrollment-specific attributes that exist only in the context of this participation relationship.. Existence Justification: In resort and destination spa operations, guests frequently enroll in multiple wellness programs during a single stay (e.g., a 7-night stay might include a 3-day detox program followed by a 2-day fitness bootcamp), and each wellness program cohort has multiple concurrent participants each with their own reservation. The enrollment itself is an actively managed business entity with program-specific data including medical clearances, dietary customizations, progress tracking, waitlist management, and completion status that belongs to neither the reservation nor the program master record alone.

products.name: group_spa_package_contract
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between reservation_group_block and spa_package. It captures the negotiated spa package offerings included in group room blocks for events, corporate retreats, weddings, and conferences. Each record links one group block to one spa package with contracted pricing, advance booking requirements, billing arrangements, and coordinator details that exist only in the context of this group-specific spa offering.. Existence Justification: In travel hospitality operations, group blocks for weddings, corporate retreats, and conferences routinely contract multiple spa packages as part of their amenity offerings (bride/groom packages, team wellness sessions, VIP treatments). Simultaneously, popular spa packages are offered across multiple concurrent group blocks with different negotiated terms. The relationship represents an operational contract that sales coordinators actively create and manage, with group-specific pricing, booking deadlines, billing arrangements, and customization requirements that belong to neither the block definition nor the package catalog alone.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: dos_email

attributes.name: dos_name

attributes.name: franchise_agreement_number

attributes.name: gds_property_code

attributes.name: gm_name

attributes.name: largest_meeting_room_sqft

attributes.name: last_renovation_date

attributes.name: latitude

attributes.name: longitude

attributes.name: property_name

attributes.name: opening_date

attributes.name: opera_property_code

attributes.name: parent_brand_group

attributes.name: phone_number

attributes.name: pip_status

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: The postal or ZIP code of the property location. Used for geographic analytics, tax jurisdiction mapping, OTA search, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: property_type

attributes.name: revenue_manager_email

attributes.name: revenue_manager_name

attributes.name: star_rating

attributes.name: state_province

attributes.name: synxis_property_code

attributes.name: total_floor_count
attributes.description: The total number of floors in the main hotel tower or building. Used for housekeeping scheduling, elevator capacity planning, and emergency evacuation planning per local fire safety and building codes.

attributes.name: total_meeting_space_sqft
attributes.description: The total square footage of all meeting, conference, and event spaces within the property. Key metric for MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, Exhibitions) sales, group evaluation, and event revenue forecasting in Delphi by Amadeus.

attributes.name: total_room_count

attributes.name: total_suite_count
attributes.description: The number of suite-category rooms within the total room inventory. Used for premium inventory management, upsell strategy, and suite-specific RevPAR reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Room Inventory; USALI Room Type Classification

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the property master record was most recently modified. Used for change data capture (CDC), ETL incremental load processing, and audit trail compliance. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX per platform conventions.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); SOX Audit Trail Requirements; CCPA

products.name: hierarchy
products.description: Defines the organizational and operational hierarchy of properties including corporate portfolio, regional divisions (e.g., Americas, EMEA, APAC), area offices, and property clusters. Captures parent-child relationships with hierarchy level, node name, node code, responsible executive, and effective date. Supports multi-property consolidated reporting with KPI roll-ups (RevPAR, ADR, OCC, GOP) across geographic and organizational tiers. Aligned with STR geographic hierarchy and internal management reporting structures.

attributes.name: hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each node in the property organizational and operational hierarchy. Serves as the primary key for this entity in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: USALI - Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.currency. Business justification: Each hierarchy node reports in ONE currency. Normalize currency reference to master currency table. Remove currency_code string - will be retrieved via JOIN.

attributes.name: fnb_revenue_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fnb.revenue_center. Business justification: Hierarchical F&B reporting requires linking revenue centers to regional/brand nodes. Corporate rollup of F&B KPIs (covers, RevPAR, food cost %) by hierarchy level is core multi-property operations rep

attributes.name: parent_node_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the immediate parent node in the hierarchy tree. Null for the corporate root node. Enables recursive parent-child traversal for consolidated reporting of RevPAR, ADR, OCC, and GOP across organizational tiers.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.property. Business justification: A hierarchy node CAN represent a single property (leaf node) or a grouping (branch node). Link leaf nodes to their property master record. This FK will be nullable - branch nodes (regions, portfolios)

attributes.name: brand_portfolio
attributes.description: Name of the brand portfolio or brand family associated with this hierarchy node (e.g., 'Luxury Collection', 'Premium Brands', 'Select Service'). Applicable to division and region nodes that manage a specific brand segment. Supports brand-level performance reporting and portfolio analytics.
attributes.references: AHLA Brand Standards; STR Chain Scale Classification

attributes.name: chain_scale
attributes.description: STR-defined chain scale classification for this hierarchy node, indicating the service and price tier of properties within this node. Used for competitive benchmarking, STR STAR Report alignment, and brand portfolio segmentation. Values align with STR's standard chain scale categories.
attributes.references: STR (Smith Travel Research) Chain Scale Classification; AHLA Brand Standards

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the geographic location of this hierarchy node (e.g., USA, GBR, SGP). Applicable primarily to property and cluster nodes. Used for regulatory compliance reporting, tax jurisdiction mapping, and geographic analytics.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this hierarchy node record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports audit trail, data lineage tracking, and SOX compliance for financial reporting hierarchy changes.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Controls; GDPR Article 5; USALI

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which this hierarchy node and its parent-child relationship became operationally effective. Used for point-in-time hierarchy reconstruction and historical reporting aligned with management reporting periods.
attributes.references: USALI; IFRS/GAAP Segment Reporting Standards; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date on which this hierarchy node or its parent-child relationship ceases to be effective. Null for currently active nodes. Supports temporal hierarchy versioning for historical consolidated reporting and audit compliance.
attributes.references: USALI; IFRS/GAAP Segment Reporting Standards; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: fiscal_year_start_month
attributes.description: Month number (1-12) indicating the start of the fiscal year for this hierarchy node. Supports USALI-aligned financial period reporting and SAP S/4HANA fiscal year variant configuration for nodes that operate on non-calendar fiscal years.
attributes.references: USALI; IFRS/GAAP; SAP S/4HANA Finance; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: gds_chain_code
attributes.description: Chain code used to identify this portfolio or brand in Global Distribution Systems (GDS) such as Amadeus, Sabre, and Travelport. Applicable to corporate and brand-level hierarchy nodes. Supports channel distribution management and GDS booking analytics.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS; HTNG GDS Standards; IATA Distribution Standards

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Major geographic region classification for this hierarchy node, aligned with STR geographic hierarchy and internal management reporting structures. Used for regional KPI roll-ups and competitive benchmarking via STR STAR Reports. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Americas|EMEA|APAC|GREATER_CHINA|MEA|EUROPE|NORTH_AMERICA|LATIN_AMERICA — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: STR (Smith Travel Research) Geographic Hierarchy Standards; WTTC Regional Classification

attributes.name: is_reporting_node
attributes.description: Indicates whether this hierarchy node is designated as a formal reporting node for consolidated KPI roll-ups (RevPAR, ADR, OCC, GOP). True for nodes that appear in management reporting packages; False for intermediate structural nodes used only for hierarchy traversal.

attributes.name: is_str_market_node
attributes.description: Indicates whether this hierarchy node corresponds to a defined STR competitive market for benchmarking purposes. True for nodes that are directly mapped to an STR market for RGI, MPI, and ARI reporting via STR STAR Reports.
attributes.references: STR (Smith Travel Research) STAR Report Standards; Infor EzRMS

attributes.name: kpi_rollup_method
attributes.description: Method used to aggregate KPIs (RevPAR, ADR, OCC, GOP) from child nodes to this parent node. 'sum' for absolute metrics (room revenue, GOP); 'weighted_average' for rate-based metrics (ADR, RevPAR) weighted by available rooms; 'simple_average' for index metrics; 'none' for leaf nodes with no children.
attributes.references: USALI; STR STAR Report Methodology; AHLA Portfolio Reporting Standards

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric depth of this node within the organizational hierarchy tree, starting at 1 for the corporate root. Enables efficient tree traversal, level-based filtering, and KPI aggregation at each tier (e.g., Level 1 = Corporate, Level 2 = Region, Level 3 = Division, Level 4 = Area Office, Level 5 = Cluster, Level 6 = Property).

attributes.name: management_type
attributes.description: Operational management structure classification for this hierarchy node. 'owned' indicates company-owned assets; 'managed' indicates third-party owner with management contract; 'franchised' indicates franchise agreement; 'leased' indicates leasehold arrangement; 'joint_venture' indicates shared ownership structure. Critical for financial consolidation and USALI reporting.
attributes.references: USALI; IFRS/GAAP; AHLA Ownership and Management Standards

attributes.name: node_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this hierarchy node across systems (e.g., CRS, PMS, ERP). Used as the business key for cross-system integration and reporting roll-ups. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA profit center codes and Oracle OPERA PMS property codes.
attributes.references: USALI; HTNG (AHLA Technology) Data Exchange Standards

attributes.name: node_description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context about this hierarchy node, including its geographic scope, strategic purpose, or operational characteristics. Used for documentation, onboarding, and BI tool tooltips.

attributes.name: node_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the hierarchy node (e.g., 'Americas Region', 'EMEA Division', 'Southeast Asia Cluster', 'Grand Hyatt New York'). Used in management reporting, dashboards, and consolidated KPI roll-ups.
attributes.references: USALI; STR (Smith Travel Research) Geographic Hierarchy Standards

attributes.name: node_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the hierarchy node. 'active' indicates the node is operational and included in reporting; 'inactive' indicates it has been decommissioned; 'pending' indicates a newly created node awaiting activation; 'dissolved' indicates a node that has been merged or restructured out of the hierarchy.

attributes.name: node_type
attributes.description: Classification of the hierarchy node indicating its organizational level. 'corporate' is the top-level portfolio node; 'region' represents major geographic divisions (Americas, EMEA, APAC); 'division' is a sub-regional grouping; 'area_office' is a local management unit; 'cluster' is a grouping of nearby properties; 'property' is an individual hotel or resort asset.
attributes.references: USALI; STR Geographic Hierarchy Standards; AHLA Organizational Standards

attributes.name: path
attributes.description: Materialized full path string from the root node to this node using delimiter-separated node codes (e.g., 'CORP/AMER/USEAST/NYC-CLUSTER'). Enables efficient subtree queries and breadcrumb navigation in BI tools without recursive joins.

attributes.name: property_count
attributes.description: Number of individual property assets directly or indirectly under this hierarchy node. Maintained as a denormalized count for reporting efficiency. Applicable to corporate, region, division, area office, and cluster nodes. Used in portfolio-level KPI reporting and capacity planning.

attributes.name: reporting_segment_code
attributes.description: Internal financial reporting segment code assigned to this hierarchy node, aligned with SAP S/4HANA profit center and segment reporting structures. Used for USALI-compliant financial consolidation, EBITDA and NOI reporting, and SOX-compliant segment disclosures.
attributes.references: USALI; IFRS 8 Operating Segments; SAP S/4HANA Finance; SOX

attributes.name: responsible_executive
attributes.description: Name of the senior executive accountable for this hierarchy node (e.g., Regional Vice President, Area General Manager, General Manager). Used for management reporting accountability, escalation routing, and organizational governance.
attributes.references: AHLA Organizational Standards; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: responsible_executive_email
attributes.description: Corporate email address of the executive accountable for this hierarchy node. Used for automated reporting distribution, escalation notifications, and governance communications.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; AHLA Organizational Standards

attributes.name: responsible_executive_title
attributes.description: Official job title of the executive accountable for this hierarchy node (e.g., 'Senior Vice President - Americas', 'Area General Manager - Southeast Asia'). Supports organizational chart generation and governance documentation.

attributes.name: restructure_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the business reason for any hierarchy restructuring event affecting this node (e.g., regional reorganization, brand portfolio realignment, merger, acquisition, or divestiture). Supports audit trail and change management documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Controls; USALI; AHLA Organizational Standards

attributes.name: sap_profit_center_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA profit center code mapped to this hierarchy node for financial consolidation, USALI-aligned P&L reporting, and management accounting. Enables direct linkage between the property hierarchy and SAP financial reporting structures for EBITDA, NOI, and GOPPAR analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance; USALI; IFRS/GAAP; SOX

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Numeric display order for this node among its siblings within the same parent node. Controls the sequence in which nodes appear in management reports, dashboards, and organizational charts. Lower values appear first.

attributes.name: str_geographic_code
attributes.description: STR-assigned geographic market code for this hierarchy node, used to align internal organizational hierarchy with STR competitive benchmarking markets. Enables direct mapping to STR STAR Report data for Revenue Generation Index (RGI), Market Penetration Index (MPI), and Average Rate Index (ARI) benchmarking.
attributes.references: STR (Smith Travel Research) STAR Report Standards; Infor EzRMS Competitive Benchmarking

attributes.name: str_market_name
attributes.description: Human-readable STR market name corresponding to the STR geographic code (e.g., 'New York City', 'London', 'Singapore'). Used in competitive benchmarking reports and STR STAR Report alignment for RevPAR and ADR market comparisons.
attributes.references: STR (Smith Travel Research) STAR Report Standards

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the primary geographic location of this hierarchy node (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London', 'Asia/Singapore'). Used for scheduling, reporting period alignment, and operational communications across multi-property portfolios.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; HTNG Data Exchange Standards

attributes.name: total_room_count
attributes.description: Aggregate number of guestrooms across all properties under this hierarchy node. Used for portfolio-level RevPAR and OCC calculations, capacity planning, and STR competitive set benchmarking. Maintained as a denormalized aggregate for reporting performance.
attributes.references: USALI; STR STAR Report Standards; AHLA Portfolio Reporting

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this hierarchy node record, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change detection, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Controls; GDPR Article 5; USALI

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number for this hierarchy node record, incremented each time the node's attributes or parent-child relationship is modified. Supports temporal versioning, audit compliance, and point-in-time hierarchy reconstruction for historical reporting.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Controls; USALI; HTNG Data Exchange Standards

attributes.description: Date when the ownership entity acquired its first property or entered the portfolio. Used for investment performance tracking, ROI calculations, and ownership tenure analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ownership entity record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: entity_type

REIT (Real Estate Investment Trust) for publicly traded entities like Host Hotels or Park Hotels, private equity for PE-backed funds, individual for owner-operators, joint venture for multi-party ownership, institutional investor for pension funds or insurance companies, family office for high-net-worth family investment vehicles.

attributes.name: investment_vehicle_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific investment fund, REIT portfolio, or investment vehicle through which the entity holds properties. Used for portfolio segmentation and fund-level performance reporting.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ownership entity record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: legal_entity_name

attributes.name: management_company_affiliation
attributes.description: Name of the property management company or hotel management firm affiliated with or contracted by the ownership entity. Used to identify management relationships and operational oversight structures.

attributes.name: ownership_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional ownership details, special arrangements, joint venture terms, or other contextual information relevant to the ownership entity.

attributes.name: ownership_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the ownership entity within the portfolio. Active indicates current ownership, inactive for historical records, pending acquisition for entities in due diligence, divested for sold assets, under review for entities undergoing restructuring or compliance review.

attributes.name: portfolio_acquisition_value_usd
attributes.description: Total acquisition cost in USD for all properties owned by this entity. Aggregated value used for ROI calculations, EBITDA analysis, and investment performance tracking.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for the ownership entity contact. Used for financial reporting distribution, asset management updates, and franchise agreement communications.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary contact person for the ownership entity. Used for asset management communications, NOI reporting, and operational escalations.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the ownership entity contact. Used for urgent communications and operational escalations.

attributes.name: registered_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the legal registered address for the ownership entity. Used for legal correspondence, tax filings, and franchise agreement documentation.

attributes.name: registered_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the legal registered address (suite, floor, building) for the ownership entity. Optional field for additional address details.

attributes.name: registered_city
attributes.description: City of the legal registered address for the ownership entity.

attributes.name: registered_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the legal registered address of the ownership entity (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR).

attributes.name: registered_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the legal registered address for the ownership entity.

attributes.name: registered_state_province
attributes.description: State or province of the legal registered address for the ownership entity. Used for state-level tax reporting and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: reit_compliance_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT) Compliance Flag

tag_set.value: Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT) Compliance Flag

attributes.name: sox_compliance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ownership entity is subject to Sarbanes-Oxley Act financial controls and reporting requirements. True for publicly traded entities or entities with publicly traded parent companies.

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Tax Identification Number (TIN) / Employer Identification Number (EIN)
attributes.description: Federal tax identification number (EIN in USA) or equivalent tax identifier for the ownership entity. Used for tax reporting, franchise agreements, and financial compliance.

tag_set.value: Tax Identification Number (TIN) / Employer Identification Number (EIN)

attributes.name: total_properties_owned
attributes.description: Current count of properties owned by this entity within the portfolio. Used for portfolio concentration analysis and ownership diversification metrics.

products.name: meeting_space
products.description: Master catalog of meeting, conference, and event spaces within each property. Captures space name, space code, space type (ballroom, boardroom, breakout room, outdoor terrace), total square footage, ceiling height, maximum capacity by setup style (theater, classroom, banquet, reception, U-shape), natural light availability, AV equipment inventory, divisibility (whether space can be partitioned), and rental rate tier. Feeds the event domain for MICE sales and BEO management via Delphi by Amadeus.
products.reference: Function Space / Event Space Catalog (Delphi by Amadeus)

attributes.name: meeting_space_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the meeting space. Primary key.
attributes.references: HTNG (Hotel Technology Next Generation) - Property Data Standards

attributes.name: cleaning_standard_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to housekeeping.cleaning_standard. Business justification: Meeting spaces require event-specific cleaning protocols (pre-event setup cleaning, post-event breakdown cleaning, turnover between events). Banquet and conference services depend on this link to sche

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Meeting and event spaces are profit centers for MICE revenue tracking. Real hospitality operations attribute event revenue, catering, and AV charges to specific spaces for profitability analysis. Crit

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property where this meeting space is located.

attributes.name: accessibility_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the meeting space meets ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) accessibility requirements including wheelchair access, accessible restrooms, and assistive listening systems.
attributes.references: ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) - Accessibility Compliance

attributes.name: adjacent_prefunction_space
attributes.description: Indicates whether the meeting space has an adjacent pre-function or foyer area for registration, breaks, or networking.

attributes.name: blackout_capability
attributes.description: Indicates whether the space can be fully darkened using blackout curtains or shades. Critical for presentations and AV-heavy events.

attributes.name: builtin_av_equipment
attributes.description: Description of permanently installed AV equipment in the space (e.g., projector, screen, sound system, microphones, video conferencing). Comma-separated list.
attributes.references: HTNG Event Management Standards - AV Inventory

attributes.name: capacity_banquet
attributes.description: Maximum number of attendees the space can accommodate in banquet-style seating (round tables with 8-10 guests per table).

attributes.name: capacity_classroom
attributes.description: Maximum number of attendees the space can accommodate in classroom-style seating (rows of tables and chairs facing front).

attributes.name: capacity_hollow_square
attributes.description: Maximum number of attendees the space can accommodate in hollow square configuration (tables arranged in square with open center).

attributes.name: capacity_reception
attributes.description: Maximum number of attendees the space can accommodate for standing reception or cocktail-style events.

attributes.name: capacity_theater
attributes.description: Maximum number of attendees the space can accommodate in theater-style seating (rows of chairs facing front).

attributes.name: capacity_u_shape
attributes.description: Maximum number of attendees the space can accommodate in U-shape seating configuration (tables arranged in U formation).

attributes.name: catering_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether food and beverage (F&B) catering is mandatory when booking this space. Common for ballrooms and premium spaces.
attributes.references: MICE Industry Standards - F&B (Food and Beverage) Policies

attributes.name: ceiling_height_feet
attributes.description: Height of the ceiling measured in feet. Important for AV equipment setup, lighting design, and event atmosphere.

attributes.name: climate_control_type
attributes.description: Type of heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) control available (individual thermostat, shared zone control, or none).
attributes.references: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration) - Environmental Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this meeting space record was first created in the system. Part of audit trail.

attributes.name: dedicated_wifi_bandwidth_mbps
attributes.business_glossary_term: Dedicated WiFi Bandwidth in Megabits Per Second (Mbps)
attributes.description: Dedicated internet bandwidth available for the meeting space measured in Mbps. Null if shared bandwidth or not applicable.

tag_set.value: Dedicated WiFi Bandwidth in Megabits Per Second (Mbps)

attributes.name: divisible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the meeting space can be partitioned into smaller sections using airwalls or movable partitions. Enables flexible space utilization.

attributes.name: emergency_exit_count
attributes.description: Number of emergency exits available in the meeting space. Required for fire safety compliance and event planning.
attributes.references: Local Fire Safety and Building Codes

attributes.name: entrance_width_inches
attributes.description: Width of the main entrance door measured in inches. Important for accessibility compliance and equipment load-in.
attributes.references: ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) - Accessibility Standards

attributes.name: fire_capacity_limit
attributes.description: Maximum occupancy allowed by local fire safety codes and building regulations. Must not be exceeded regardless of setup style.
attributes.references: Local Fire Safety and Building Codes

attributes.name: floor_level
attributes.description: Physical floor or level where the meeting space is located within the property (e.g., Ground Floor, Mezzanine, 2nd Floor, Rooftop).
attributes.references: ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) - Accessibility Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this meeting space record was last updated. Part of audit trail for change tracking.

attributes.name: last_renovation_date
attributes.description: Date when the meeting space last underwent renovation or significant refurbishment. Part of PIP (Property Improvement Plan) tracking.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry) - FF&E (Furniture Fixtures and Equipment) Management

attributes.name: loading_dock_access
attributes.description: Indicates whether the meeting space has direct or convenient access to a loading dock for equipment and material delivery.

attributes.name: meeting_space_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the meeting space. Determines availability for booking and event planning.
attributes.references: HTNG Property Data Standards - Space Status

attributes.name: minimum_catering_spend
attributes.description: Minimum food and beverage spend required when booking this space. Null if no minimum or catering not required.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry) - F&B (Food and Beverage) Revenue

attributes.name: minimum_rental_hours
attributes.description: Minimum number of hours the space must be rented for a single event. Used for revenue management and booking policies.

attributes.name: natural_light_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the meeting space has windows or skylights providing natural daylight. Important for guest experience and event ambiance.

attributes.name: number_of_sections
attributes.description: Number of separate sections the space can be divided into when partitions are deployed. Null if space is not divisible.

attributes.name: rental_rate_tier
attributes.description: Pricing tier classification for the meeting space rental. Actual rates are managed in rate tables and vary by season, day of week, and booking terms.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry) - Revenue Classification

attributes.name: space_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the meeting space within the property. Used in PMS and event management systems for booking and BEO (Banquet Event Order) references.
attributes.references: Delphi by Amadeus - Space Management Standards

attributes.name: space_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the meeting space as displayed to guests and event planners (e.g., Grand Ballroom, Executive Boardroom, Terrace Garden).

attributes.name: space_type
attributes.description: Classification of the meeting space by functional type. Determines suitability for different event formats and MICE (Meetings Incentives Conferences Exhibitions) requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ballroom|boardroom|breakout_room|conference_room|meeting_room|outdoor_terrace|pre_function_space — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: total_square_footage
attributes.description: Total area of the meeting space measured in square feet. Critical for capacity planning and event layout design.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry) - Space Measurement Standards

attributes.name: wifi_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether wireless internet connectivity is available in the meeting space. Essential for modern business events.

products.name: property_outlet
products.description: Master catalog of revenue-generating outlets within each property including restaurants, bars, spas, golf courses, retail shops, and recreational facilities. Captures outlet name, outlet code, outlet type, cuisine type (for F&B), seating capacity, operating hours, POS system identifier (MICROS), revenue center code (USALI), and outlet status. Serves as the SSOT for outlet identity referenced by the foodandbeverage, finance, and event domains.
products.reference: Revenue Center / Outlet Master (OPERA PMS / MICROS POS)

attributes.name: property_outlet_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the property outlet. Primary key.

attributes.name: cleaning_standard_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to housekeeping.cleaning_standard. Business justification: Restaurant and bar outlets require food-service-specific cleaning standards (health department compliance, grease trap maintenance, dining area sanitation). F&B operations depend on this link for heal

attributes.name: currency_id

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Every F&B outlet has an assigned manager tracked for P&L accountability, labor scheduling, operational oversight, and guest service escalations. Replaces denormalized manager contact fields with prope

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.org_unit. Business justification: Outlets operate as distinct organizational units with dedicated labor budgets, schedules, and cost centers. Required for labor cost allocation, schedule generation, and USALI departmental reporting. R

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the property where this outlet is located. Links to the property master data.

attributes.name: alcohol_service_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the outlet is licensed to serve alcoholic beverages. True if alcohol service is permitted.

attributes.name: average_check_amount
attributes.description: Average guest check amount for the outlet. Used for revenue forecasting and performance benchmarking. Expressed in property base currency.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date when the outlet was permanently closed. Null if the outlet is still operational or temporarily closed.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this outlet record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: cuisine_type
attributes.description: The primary cuisine or culinary style offered by the outlet. Applicable to Food and Beverage (F&B) outlets. Examples: Italian, Asian Fusion, Steakhouse, Mediterranean, International.

attributes.name: delivery_service_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the outlet offers delivery service to guest rooms or external locations. True if delivery is available.

attributes.name: dress_code
attributes.description: Dress code policy enforced at the outlet. Communicates guest attire expectations and supports brand positioning.

attributes.name: floor_number
attributes.description: Floor number where the outlet is located within the property. Used for wayfinding and facility management.

attributes.name: gratuity_policy
attributes.description: Policy regarding gratuities (tips) at the outlet. Defines whether gratuity is included in pricing, optional, automatically added, or not accepted.

attributes.name: health_permit_number
attributes.description: Health department permit number for food service operations. Required for Food and Beverage (F&B) outlets.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this outlet record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_renovation_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent major renovation or refurbishment of the outlet. Supports Property Improvement Plan (PIP) tracking and Furniture Fixtures and Equipment (FF&E) lifecycle management.

attributes.name: liquor_license_number
attributes.description: Official liquor license number issued by the local regulatory authority. Required for outlets serving alcohol.

attributes.name: location_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the outlet's physical location within the property (e.g., Lobby Level, Poolside, 5th Floor East Wing). Assists guests in finding the outlet.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether purchases at this outlet are eligible for loyalty program points accrual. True if loyalty points can be earned.

attributes.name: menu_url
attributes.description: Web address where the outlet's current menu can be accessed. Applicable to Food and Beverage (F&B) outlets.

attributes.name: mobile_ordering_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the outlet supports mobile ordering through the property's mobile application or third-party platforms. True if mobile ordering is available.

attributes.name: opening_date
attributes.description: Date when the outlet first opened for business. Used for historical tracking and anniversary celebrations.

attributes.name: operating_hours
attributes.description: Standard operating hours for the outlet. Format varies by property but typically includes days of week and time ranges (e.g., Mon-Fri 6:00 AM - 10:00 PM).

attributes.name: outdoor_seating_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the outlet offers outdoor seating. True if outdoor seating is available.

attributes.name: outlet_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the outlet within the property. Used for operational reference and system integration.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: outlet_name
attributes.description: The business name of the outlet as displayed to guests and used in marketing materials.

attributes.name: outlet_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the outlet. Determines whether the outlet is available for guest use and revenue generation.

attributes.name: outlet_type
attributes.description: Classification of the outlet by its primary business function. Determines operational processes and revenue reporting categories. attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: pos_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the Point of Sale (POS) system instance used by this outlet. Typically references Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS system configuration.

attributes.name: private_dining_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the outlet offers private dining rooms or spaces for exclusive events. True if private dining is available.

attributes.name: reservation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether advance reservations are required or recommended for this outlet. True if reservations are mandatory or strongly encouraged.

attributes.name: revenue_center_code
attributes.description: USALI-compliant revenue center code used for financial reporting and general ledger (GL) integration. Maps outlet revenue to the appropriate financial statement line item.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: seasonal_close_date
