attributes.name: seasonal_open_date
attributes.description: Annual date when the outlet opens for seasonal operation. Applicable only to seasonal outlets.

attributes.name: seasonal_operation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the outlet operates on a seasonal schedule (e.g., summer only, winter only). True if seasonal.

attributes.name: seating_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of guests that can be seated simultaneously in the outlet. Used for reservation management and capacity planning.

attributes.name: service_charge_percentage
attributes.description: Standard service charge percentage applied to guest bills at this outlet. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 18.00 for 18%).
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: square_footage
attributes.description: Total square footage of the outlet space. Used for space utilization analysis and capital expenditure (CapEx) planning.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Web address for the outlet's dedicated website or property page. Used for online marketing and guest information.

products.name: gds_profile
products.description: GDS (Global Distribution System) and CRS property profile records defining how each property is listed and distributed across Sabre, Amadeus, Galileo/Travelport, and direct booking channels. Captures GDS property code, chain code, CRS property code (Sabre SynXis), property display name, short description, long description, hero image URL, amenity flags, and last sync timestamp. Sourced from Sabre SynXis CRS channel configuration. Supports channel distribution and OTA partnership management.
products.reference: GDS Property Profile / CRS Property Listing (Sabre SynXis)

attributes.name: gds_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the GDS/CRS property profile record in the Silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity. Entity role: MASTER_RESOURCE — represents a property listing/distribution profile asset managed and distributed across GDS and CRS channels.
attributes.references: HTNG Data Dictionary; Sabre SynXis CRS Data Model

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.currency. Business justification: Each GDS profile displays rates in ONE currency. Normalize currency reference to master currency table. Remove currency_code string - will be retrieved via JOIN.

attributes.name: fnb_outlet_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fnb.fnb_outlet. Business justification: GDS distribution requires detailed outlet content (cuisine, hours, dress code, reservation policy) for booking channel display. has_restaurant boolean is insufficient; link to outlet master data enabl

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent property master record that this GDS profile describes. Links the distribution profile to the physical hotel or resort asset in the property domain.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Property Master; HTNG Property Profile Standard

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: The primary street address of the property as displayed in GDS and OTA channel listings. Used by guests and travel agents for navigation and correspondence. Classified as confidential organizational contact data.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Sabre SynXis CRS Property Profile; OTA (OpenTravel Alliance) Address Standard

attributes.name: amadeus_property_code
attributes.description: The property identifier specific to the Amadeus GDS network. May differ from the Sabre GDS property code. Used for Amadeus channel distribution, rate loading, and availability display to travel agents on the Amadeus platform.
attributes.references: Amadeus Hotel Distribution; HTNG Channel Distribution Standard

attributes.name: brand_code
attributes.description: The brand identifier code as registered in the GDS and CRS systems. Identifies the hotel brand (e.g., luxury, premium, select-service) under which the property is marketed in distribution channels. Used for brand-level filtering in GDS searches.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Brand Configuration; HTNG Brand Profile Standard

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: The full marketing name of the hotel brand as displayed in GDS and OTA channels (e.g., 'Luxury Collection', 'Marriott Hotels', 'Hilton Garden Inn'). Supports brand-level reporting and channel distribution analytics.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Brand Configuration; HTNG Brand Profile Standard

attributes.name: chain_code
attributes.description: The hotel chain or brand code registered with the GDS networks identifying the parent brand or management company. Used by GDS systems to group properties under a common brand umbrella for travel agent searches and loyalty program linkage.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS; Amadeus Hotel Chain Code Registry; HTNG Channel Distribution Standard

attributes.name: check_in_time
attributes.description: The standard guest check-in time for the property in HH:MM (24-hour) format as published in GDS and OTA channel profiles. Displayed to guests and travel agents during the booking process to set arrival expectations.
attributes.references: OTA (OpenTravel Alliance) Hotel Policy Standard; Sabre SynXis CRS Property Profile

attributes.name: check_out_time
attributes.description: The standard guest check-out time for the property in HH:MM (24-hour) format as published in GDS and OTA channel profiles. Displayed to guests and travel agents during the booking process to set departure expectations.
attributes.references: OTA (OpenTravel Alliance) Hotel Policy Standard; Sabre SynXis CRS Property Profile

attributes.name: city_code
attributes.description: The IATA or GDS city/airport code associated with the property location (e.g., 'NYC', 'LON', 'PAR'). Used by GDS systems to associate the property with a travel destination for search and booking purposes.
attributes.references: IATA Location Code Standard; Sabre SynXis CRS Geographic Configuration

attributes.name: city_name
attributes.description: The full city name of the property location as displayed in GDS and OTA channel listings. Supports geographic search and filtering in distribution channels.
attributes.references: OTA (OpenTravel Alliance) Geographic Standard; Sabre SynXis CRS Property Profile

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the property location as registered in the GDS profile. Used for geographic filtering in GDS and OTA search results and for regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 Country Code Standard; OTA (OpenTravel Alliance) Geographic Code Standard

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this GDS profile record was first created in the Silver layer lakehouse. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and profile lifecycle tracking.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability); SOX Section 404 (Internal Controls); HTNG Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: crs_property_code
attributes.description: The property identifier assigned within the Central Reservation System (CRS), specifically Sabre SynXis CRS. This code is the primary key used for rate distribution, inventory allocation, and booking transactions flowing through the CRS. Distinct from the GDS property code.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Central Reservations Module; HTNG CRS Interface Specification

attributes.name: display_name
attributes.description: The property name as it appears in GDS and CRS search results and booking screens. This is the consumer-facing name used by travel agents and OTA partners. May differ from the legal property name or internal operating name.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Property Profile; OTA (OpenTravel Alliance) Hotel Descriptive Content Standard

attributes.name: distribution_channel_type
attributes.description: Indicates the primary distribution channel scope this profile record covers. 'gds' = GDS-only profile (Sabre/Amadeus/Galileo); 'crs' = CRS direct booking profile; 'ota' = OTA partner profile; 'direct' = brand.com direct booking; 'all' = unified profile across all channels.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Channel Management; HTNG Channel Distribution Standard

attributes.name: fax_number
attributes.description: The fax number for the property as listed in GDS channel profiles. Used by travel agents and corporate accounts for reservation confirmations and group booking correspondence. Classified as confidential organizational contact data.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; OTA (OpenTravel Alliance) Contact Standard; Sabre SynXis CRS Property Profile

attributes.name: floor_count
attributes.description: The total number of floors in the main hotel building as published in GDS and OTA channel profiles. Used by travel agents and guests for property orientation and accessibility planning.
attributes.references: OTA (OpenTravel Alliance) Hotel Facility Standard; Sabre SynXis CRS Property Profile

attributes.name: galileo_property_code
attributes.description: The property identifier specific to the Galileo/Travelport GDS network. Used for Travelport channel distribution, rate loading, and availability display to travel agents on the Galileo platform.
attributes.references: Travelport/Galileo Hotel Distribution; HTNG Channel Distribution Standard

attributes.name: gds_property_code
attributes.description: The unique property identifier assigned within the GDS network (Sabre, Amadeus, Galileo/Travelport). This code is used by travel agents and OTA partners to look up and book the property across GDS channels. Sourced from Sabre SynXis CRS channel configuration.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS; HTNG Channel Distribution Standard; OTA (OpenTravel Alliance) Property Code Specification

attributes.name: has_airport_shuttle
attributes.description: Indicates whether the property offers complimentary or paid airport shuttle service as published in GDS and OTA amenity flags. Used by travel agents and guests to filter properties by transportation amenities.
attributes.references: OTA (OpenTravel Alliance) Hotel Amenity Code Standard; Sabre SynXis CRS Amenity Flags

attributes.name: has_fitness_center
attributes.description: Indicates whether the property has a fitness center or gym as published in GDS and OTA amenity flags. Used by travel agents and guests to filter properties by wellness amenities. Sourced from Sabre SynXis CRS amenity configuration.
attributes.references: OTA (OpenTravel Alliance) Hotel Amenity Code Standard; Sabre SynXis CRS Amenity Flags

attributes.name: has_meeting_facilities
attributes.description: Indicates whether the property has meeting rooms or conference facilities (MICE — Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, Exhibitions) as published in GDS and OTA amenity flags. Used by corporate travel agents and event planners to filter properties for group and event bookings.
attributes.references: OTA (OpenTravel Alliance) Hotel Amenity Code Standard; Sabre SynXis CRS Amenity Flags; AHLA MICE Standards

attributes.name: has_parking
attributes.description: Indicates whether the property offers on-site parking (self-park or valet) as published in GDS and OTA amenity flags. Used by travel agents and guests to filter properties by parking availability.
attributes.references: OTA (OpenTravel Alliance) Hotel Amenity Code Standard; Sabre SynXis CRS Amenity Flags

attributes.name: has_pool
attributes.description: Indicates whether the property has a swimming pool as published in GDS and OTA amenity flags. Used by travel agents and guests to filter properties by recreational amenities. Sourced from Sabre SynXis CRS amenity configuration.
attributes.references: OTA (OpenTravel Alliance) Hotel Amenity Code Standard; Sabre SynXis CRS Amenity Flags

attributes.name: hero_image_url
attributes.description: The URL of the primary hero/banner image displayed on GDS and OTA property listing pages. This is the main visual asset representing the property in channel distribution. Must be a publicly accessible HTTPS URL conforming to OTA image specification standards.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Media Content; OTA (OpenTravel Alliance) Hotel Image Standard

attributes.name: is_ada_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the property meets Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) accessibility requirements as published in GDS and OTA profiles. Used by travel agents and guests requiring accessible accommodations. Supports ADA compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) Accessibility Standards; OTA (OpenTravel Alliance) Accessibility Standard; Sabre SynXis CRS Property Profile

attributes.name: is_pet_friendly

attributes.name: longitude

attributes.name: phone_number

attributes.name: postal_code

attributes.name: profile_effective_date

attributes.name: short_description

attributes.name: website_url

products.name: seasonal_calendar
products.description: Defines property-level seasonal periods and operating calendars that drive rate strategy, staffing models, and operational planning. Captures season name, start date, end date, demand classification (peak, shoulder, off-peak, super-peak), applicable rate season code, holiday indicator, blackout date flag, seasonal facility closures, reduced operating hours, and year-over-year demand trend. Used by revenue management (IDeaS G3 RMS) for rate strategy and BAR level setting, by workforce domain for labor scheduling and seasonal hiring, and by operations for outlet hours and facility availability. Each property maintains its own seasonal calendar reflecting local demand patterns, events, and climate.

attributes.name: seasonal_calendar_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the seasonal calendar entry. Primary key for the seasonal calendar product.

attributes.name: banquet_menu_package_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fnb.banquet_menu_package. Business justification: Seasonal calendars drive banquet package pricing and availability. High-demand seasons trigger premium packages; low seasons activate promotional packages. Revenue management requires linking seasonal

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property for which this seasonal calendar entry applies. Links to the property master data.

attributes.name: advance_booking_days
attributes.description: Typical number of days in advance that guests book for this seasonal period. Used for forecasting accuracy and inventory management. Based on historical booking patterns.

attributes.name: blackout_reason

attributes.name: cancellation_rate_pct

attributes.name: climate_description

attributes.name: competitive_set_position
attributes.description: Property's expected market position relative to its STR competitive set during this seasonal period. Values: leader (outperforming), competitive (at par), lagging (underperforming), premium (high-end positioning), value (budget positioning).

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: demand_classification
attributes.description: Categorization of expected demand level during this seasonal period. Drives pricing strategy, staffing models, and inventory controls. Values: peak (high demand), shoulder (moderate demand), off-peak (low demand), super-peak (exceptional demand). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: peak|shoulder|off-peak|super-peak|low|moderate|high — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Last date of the seasonal period (inclusive). Defines the conclusion of the season for rate strategy and operational planning.

attributes.name: estimated_adr

attributes.name: estimated_occupancy_pct

attributes.name: estimated_revpar

attributes.name: facility_closures

attributes.name: holiday_name

attributes.name: is_blackout_date

attributes.name: is_holiday_period

attributes.name: market_segment_focus

attributes.name: season_code

attributes.name: season_name

attributes.name: season_year

attributes.name: seasonal_calendar_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this seasonal calendar entry. Values: active (in use), draft (being planned), archived (historical), cancelled (no longer applicable).

attributes.name: seasonal_hiring_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether additional seasonal staff hiring is required for this period. Used by HR and workforce planning teams to initiate recruitment.

attributes.name: special_events
attributes.description: Description of major local or property-specific events occurring during this seasonal period that impact demand (e.g., Annual Music Festival, Marathon Weekend, Convention Center Trade Show). Null if no special events.

attributes.name: staffing_level

attributes.name: start_date

attributes.name: yoy_demand_trend

attributes.name: yoy_demand_variance_pct

attributes.name: created_by

products.name: currency
products.description: Reference master for currencies used across the global property portfolio, including ISO 4217 currency codes, currency names, decimal precision, exchange rate source configuration, and base currency designation for financial consolidation.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the currency record. Primary key.

attributes.name: base_currency_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on currency (base_currency_id)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 alphabetic currency code (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY). This is the standard international identifier for the currency used across all financial systems, property management systems, and revenue management platforms.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166 country code for the primary country where this currency is the official legal tender (e.g., USA for USD, GBR for GBP). Used for geographic revenue analysis and Smith Travel Research (STR) market benchmarking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this currency record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and compliance with Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) requirements for financial data.

attributes.name: currency_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the currency in the system. Active currencies are available for all transactions; inactive currencies are retained for historical reporting; deprecated currencies are being phased out; historical currencies are no longer in circulation (e.g., legacy European currencies replaced by EUR); pending currencies are configured but not yet live.

attributes.name: decimal_places
attributes.description: Number of decimal places used for this currency in financial calculations and display. Most currencies use 2 (e.g., USD 100.50), some use 0 (e.g., JPY 1000), and a few use 3 (e.g., BHD 10.250). Critical for accurate revenue calculations, Average Daily Rate (ADR), and Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR) reporting.

attributes.name: display_format
attributes.description: The standard display format for this currency including symbol placement, decimal separator, and thousands separator (e.g., $1,234.56 for USD, 1.234,56 € for EUR). Used to ensure consistent presentation across guest-facing systems, reports, and Business Intelligence (BI) dashboards.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this currency configuration became or will become effective in the system. Used for managing currency transitions, redenominations, and historical accuracy in financial reporting.

attributes.name: erp_currency_code
attributes.description: The currency code or identifier used in the Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system, such as SAP S/4HANA. Used for financial consolidation, General Ledger (GL) posting, Accounts Payable (AP), and Accounts Receivable (AR) integration.

attributes.name: exchange_rate_source
attributes.description: The authoritative source or provider for exchange rate data for this currency (e.g., OANDA, XE.com, Bloomberg, Reuters, Central Bank). Used to ensure consistent exchange rate application across Central Reservation System (CRS), Revenue Management System (RMS), and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems.

attributes.name: exchange_rate_update_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which exchange rates are refreshed for this currency. Critical for accurate revenue recognition, dynamic pricing in Revenue Management System (RMS), and financial consolidation under International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP).

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this currency configuration expires or is no longer valid for new transactions. Nullable for currencies with indefinite validity. Used for managing currency transitions and ensuring historical data integrity.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this currency is currently active and available for use in transactions, reservations, and financial operations. Inactive currencies are retained for historical reporting but cannot be used for new transactions.

attributes.name: is_base_currency
attributes.description: Indicates whether this currency is the base currency for financial consolidation and corporate reporting. Typically one currency per enterprise (e.g., USD for US-headquartered companies). Used for Gross Operating Profit (GOP), Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA), and consolidated financial statements under Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry (USALI).
attributes.references: USALI - Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry

attributes.name: is_crypto_currency
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a cryptocurrency (e.g., Bitcoin, Ethereum) rather than a traditional fiat currency. Used for special handling in payment processing, regulatory compliance, and financial reporting.

attributes.name: minor_unit
attributes.description: The relationship between the major currency unit and its minor unit (e.g., 100 cents = 1 dollar). Defines the subdivision of the currency for precise financial calculations in Property Management System (PMS) and Point of Sale (POS) systems.

attributes.name: currency_name
attributes.description: Full official name of the currency (e.g., United States Dollar, Euro, British Pound Sterling, Japanese Yen). Used for display purposes in financial reports and guest-facing materials.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, special handling instructions, or contextual information about this currency. May include information about currency restrictions, regulatory requirements, or system-specific configuration details.

attributes.name: numeric_code
attributes.description: Three-digit ISO 4217 numeric currency code used in systems where alphabetic codes are not practical. Provides an alternative identifier for the currency in legacy systems and international payment processing.

attributes.name: payment_processing_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this currency is enabled for payment processing through Point of Sale (POS) systems, online booking engines, and payment gateways. Must comply with Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) requirements.
attributes.references: PCI DSS - Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard

attributes.name: pms_currency_code
attributes.description: The currency code or identifier used in the Property Management System (PMS), such as Oracle OPERA. May differ from ISO 4217 code in legacy systems. Used for system integration and data mapping between PMS and enterprise data warehouse.

attributes.name: rounding_method
attributes.description: The rounding method to be applied when performing calculations with this currency. Standard follows mathematical rounding rules; up always rounds up; down always rounds down; nearest rounds to nearest value; bankers rounding (round half to even) minimizes cumulative rounding errors in large transaction volumes. Critical for accurate Average Daily Rate (ADR) and Total Revenue Per Available Room (TRevPAR) calculations.
attributes.references: USALI - Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry

attributes.name: symbol
attributes.description: Standard symbol used to represent the currency (e.g., $, €, £, ¥). Used in user interfaces, reports, and guest-facing displays for quick visual recognition.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this currency record was last modified. Used for change tracking, data quality monitoring, and audit compliance.

products.name: vendor_agreement
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between property and vendor. It captures the negotiated commercial terms, service-level agreements, and relationship parameters that govern procurement relationships between individual hotel properties and their suppliers. Each record links one property to one vendor with property-specific pricing, delivery terms, payment conditions, and local contact arrangements that exist only in the context of this specific property-vendor relationship.. Existence Justification: In travel hospitality operations, each hotel property maintains procurement relationships with multiple vendors across different supply categories (food & beverage suppliers, FF&E vendors, housekeeping suppliers, maintenance contractors), and each vendor serves multiple properties across the portfolio. Each property-vendor relationship has negotiated commercial terms including property-specific discount rates, delivery lead times, minimum order values, payment term overrides, and dedicated local vendor contacts that vary by property. The business actively manages these relationships for vendor performance evaluation, contract compliance monitoring, and procurement optimization.

attributes.description: The standard number of days between order placement and delivery for this vendor to this property. Used for inventory planning and order scheduling.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: The timestamp when this property-vendor agreement record was last updated.

attributes.description: The date of the most recent formal performance review conducted by the property for this vendor. Used to schedule periodic vendor evaluations.

attributes.name: local_contact_phone

products.name: property_space_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the allocation of a specific meeting space to an event booking for a defined time period. It captures the operational assignment of physical function space to MICE events, including setup configuration, timing, attendance guarantees, and rental charges. Each record links one meeting_space to one event_booking with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific space-time allocation.. Existence Justification: In MICE operations, a single multi-day conference event booking routinely requires multiple meeting spaces (e.g., main ballroom for general sessions, multiple breakout rooms for concurrent workshops, boardroom for VIP meetings). Conversely, a high-demand meeting space hosts multiple different event bookings across days and time slots. The allocation itself is an operational entity that event coordinators actively create, modify, and track, with specific attributes like time slots, setup configurations, guaranteed attendance per space, and individual rental charges that belong to neither the space nor the event alone.

products.name: channel_connection
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between property and channel. It captures the commercial and technical relationship governing how a specific property distributes inventory through a specific distribution channel. Each record links one property to one channel with attributes that exist only in the context of this relationship: activation dates, connectivity configuration, commission overrides, rate loading protocols, and inventory allocation rules.. Existence Justification: In the travel hospitality industry, properties distribute inventory through multiple distribution channels simultaneously (GDS networks, OTA platforms, direct web, wholesalers), and each channel serves multiple properties across the portfolio. The business actively manages these property-channel connections as operational entities with specific configuration, activation dates, connectivity protocols, and property-specific commission overrides that cannot be stored on either the property or channel master records alone.

attributes.name: floor_number
attributes.description: The floor level where the room is located within the building. Used for housekeeping routing and guest preferences.

attributes.name: housekeeping_status

attributes.name: kitchenette_available

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this room record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data synchronization.

attributes.name: last_renovation_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent renovation or major refurbishment. Used for PIP (Property Improvement Plan) tracking and FF&E (Furniture Fixtures and Equipment) lifecycle management.

attributes.name: lra_eligible

attributes.name: operational_status

attributes.name: out_of_order_reason

attributes.name: out_of_order_start_date

attributes.name: overbooking_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this room can be included in overbooking calculations. Used by RMS for yield optimization.

attributes.name: room_number

attributes.name: smoking_allowed

attributes.name: square_footage

attributes.name: wing_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the wing or section within a building. Used for operational routing and guest location preferences.

attributes.name: room_status_id
attributes.description: Primary key for room_status

attributes.name: attendant_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the housekeeping staff member currently assigned to clean or service this room.

attributes.name: guest_group_block_id

attributes.name: health_safety_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.health_safety_incident. Links status to incident for incident response workflow, housekeeping coordination, and guest relocati

attributes.name: primary_room_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the housekeeping supervisor or inspector who performed the quality inspection of the room.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the guest currently occupying the room. Null if room is vacant.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the hotel property where the room is located. Links to the property master data.

attributes.name: reservation_booking_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the active reservation currently occupying the room. Null if room is vacant.

attributes.name: room_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the physical room. Links to the room inventory master data.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Room Inventory Module

attributes.name: room_updated_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user (staff member) who last updated the room status.

attributes.name: blocked_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the room is administratively blocked from sale (e.g., VIP hold, renovation, inventory control, group block).

attributes.name: cleaning_type
attributes.description: Type of cleaning service required or last performed. Checkout: full cleaning after guest departure; Stayover: daily service for occupied room; Deep Clean: comprehensive periodic cleaning; Turndown: evening service; Refresh: light touch-up.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this room status record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: discrepancy_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating a mismatch between front desk status and housekeeping status (e.g., front desk shows vacant but housekeeping shows occupied). Requires investigation.

attributes.name: discrepancy_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes describing the nature of any status discrepancy and actions taken to resolve it.

attributes.name: do_not_disturb_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the guest has activated the do not disturb indicator, preventing housekeeping and other staff from entering.

attributes.name: expected_checkin_date
attributes.description: The scheduled check-in date for the next arriving guest. Used for due-in planning and housekeeping prioritization.

attributes.name: expected_checkout_date
attributes.description: The scheduled checkout date for the current guest occupying the room. Used for due-out planning.

attributes.name: front_desk_status
attributes.description: Current operational status from the front desk perspective. Vacant: unoccupied and available; Occupied: guest currently in residence; Reserved: booked for future arrival; Due Out: guest scheduled to check out today; Due In: guest scheduled to check in today; Out of Order: room unavailable for sale.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Front Desk Module

attributes.name: housekeeping_status
attributes.description: Current housekeeping state of the room indicating cleanliness and readiness. Dirty: needs full cleaning; Clean: cleaned but not inspected; Inspected: cleaned and quality-checked; Pickup: minor refresh needed; Out of Service: maintenance required; Do Not Disturb: guest requested no service.

attributes.name: is_blocked
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the room is administratively blocked from sale (e.g., for renovation, VIP hold, or inventory control).

attributes.name: is_clean
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the room has been cleaned and is ready for occupancy. True if housekeeping status is clean or inspected.

attributes.name: is_inspected
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the room has passed housekeeping quality inspection after cleaning.

attributes.name: is_out_of_order
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the room is out of order and unavailable for sale due to maintenance or other operational issues.

attributes.name: last_cleaned_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the room was last cleaned by housekeeping staff.

attributes.name: last_inspected_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the room last passed housekeeping quality inspection.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this room status record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: last_occupied_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the room was last occupied by a guest (most recent check-in or last known occupancy).
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Front Desk Module

attributes.name: last_vacated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the room was last vacated by a guest (most recent check-out).
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Front Desk Module

attributes.name: maintenance_status
attributes.description: Current maintenance condition of the room. Available: no maintenance issues; Minor Repair: small issues not blocking occupancy; Major Repair: significant issues requiring attention; Out of Order: room cannot be occupied; Scheduled Maintenance: planned preventive maintenance.

attributes.name: occupancy_status
attributes.description: Simple binary occupancy indicator. Vacant: no guest assigned; Occupied: guest currently checked in; Reserved: future reservation exists.

attributes.name: out_of_order_end_date
attributes.description: The expected or actual date when the room will be or was returned to service after being out of order.

attributes.name: out_of_order_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the room is out of order (e.g., plumbing issue, HVAC failure, renovation, pest control, water damage).

attributes.name: out_of_order_start_date
attributes.description: The date when the room was first designated as out of order.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Housekeeping priority level for servicing this room. Urgent: immediate attention required (e.g., due-in within 1 hour); High: priority cleaning (e.g., VIP guest, early check-in); Normal: standard cleaning schedule; Low: can be deferred.

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text special instructions for housekeeping staff regarding this room (e.g., guest allergies, VIP preferences, extra amenities required).

attributes.name: status_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the room status was last updated in the system. Tracks the most recent status transition.

attributes.name: turndown_service_status
attributes.description: Status of evening turndown service for the room. Not Requested: no turndown service scheduled; Requested: guest or property standard requires turndown; Completed: turndown service has been performed; Declined: guest declined turndown service.

products.name: availability_snapshot
products.description: Date-level inventory availability record per room type per property capturing total physical rooms, rooms sold, rooms blocked (group and allotment), out-of-order rooms, out-of-service rooms, complimentary rooms, house-use rooms, day-use rooms, and net available rooms. The authoritative SSOT for real-time occupancy (OCC) calculation and available-to-sell inventory. Feeds IDeaS G3 RMS for yield optimization and supports LRA (Last Room Availability) flag tracking. Reconciled nightly during night audit against PMS folios and room status. Serves as the foundation for RevPAR, occupancy trending, and inventory reconciliation reporting.
products.reference: IDeaS G3 Inventory Snapshot / OPERA Availability

attributes.name: availability_snapshot_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the availability snapshot record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: demand_forecast_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.demand_forecast. Business justification: Availability snapshots capture actual rooms sold/available; demand forecasts predict future demand. Linking actuals to forecasts enables forecast accuracy measurement (MAPE calculation), model perform

attributes.name: experiment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.experiment. Business justification: A/B testing in hospitality involves inventory availability experiments (scarcity messaging tests, overbooking threshold optimization, dynamic availability display). Experiments must track which availa

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the hotel property for which this availability snapshot is recorded.

attributes.name: room_type_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the room type (e.g., Standard King, Deluxe Suite) for which availability is tracked.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Room Type Configuration

attributes.name: closed_to_arrival_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether new reservations are allowed to check in on this date. When true, no new arrivals are accepted, but existing multi-night stays can continue.

attributes.name: closed_to_departure_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether guests are allowed to check out on this date. When true, reservations must extend beyond this date to capture higher-value multi-night stays.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this availability snapshot record was first created in the data warehouse.

attributes.name: discrepancy_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting any discrepancies found during reconciliation, including root cause and resolution actions.

attributes.name: lra_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Last Room Availability is enabled for this room type on this date. When true, the property commits to selling rooms at contracted rates even if only one room remains.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS LRA Control Logic

attributes.name: max_los_restriction
attributes.description: Maximum number of nights allowed for a reservation starting on this date. Used to prevent long stays during high-demand periods.

attributes.name: min_los_restriction
attributes.description: Minimum number of nights required for a reservation starting on this date. Used for demand management and revenue optimization.

attributes.name: net_available_rooms
attributes.description: Net number of rooms available to sell after accounting for all deductions (OOO, OOS, house use, blocks). Calculated as total physical rooms minus all unavailable and blocked rooms.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Available Inventory Calculation

attributes.name: occ_rate
attributes.description: Occupancy rate percentage for this room type on this date, calculated as (rooms sold + complimentary rooms) / net available rooms * 100. Key performance metric for revenue management.
attributes.references: STR (Smith Travel Research) Occupancy Calculation Standard

attributes.name: overbooking_limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of rooms that can be overbooked for this room type on this date, based on historical no-show and cancellation patterns. Used for yield optimization.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of the nightly reconciliation process for this snapshot. Indicates whether the snapshot has been validated against PMS folios and room status.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Night Audit Reconciliation

attributes.name: rooms_blocked_allotment
attributes.description: Number of rooms allocated to contracted allotments (OTA, wholesaler, corporate contracts) that are held but not yet sold.

attributes.name: rooms_blocked_group
attributes.description: Number of rooms blocked for group reservations (MICE, corporate blocks) that are not yet sold but are held off general inventory.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Group Block Management

attributes.name: rooms_complimentary
attributes.description: Number of rooms occupied by complimentary guests (e.g., loyalty rewards, service recovery, VIP comps). Counted in occupancy but not in revenue.

attributes.name: rooms_day_use
attributes.description: Number of rooms sold for day-use only (check-in and check-out on the same day), typically for meetings or short stays.

attributes.name: rooms_house_use
attributes.description: Number of rooms occupied by hotel staff, contractors, or used for operational purposes (e.g., training, storage). Not available for sale.

attributes.name: rooms_out_of_order
attributes.description: Number of rooms temporarily unavailable due to maintenance, repair, or refurbishment. These rooms are not available for sale.

attributes.name: rooms_out_of_service
attributes.description: Number of rooms permanently or long-term unavailable due to major renovation, structural issues, or strategic decisions. Not available for sale.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Room Status Management

attributes.name: rooms_overbooked
attributes.description: Actual number of rooms overbooked (sold beyond physical capacity) for this room type on this date.

attributes.name: rooms_sold
attributes.description: Number of rooms sold (occupied by paying guests) for this room type on this date. Used in OCC (Occupancy Rate) calculation.

attributes.name: snapshot_date
attributes.description: The business date for which this availability snapshot is recorded. Represents the stay date, not the snapshot creation date.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry) Daily Operations Reporting

attributes.name: snapshot_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when this availability snapshot was captured. Typically recorded during the nightly audit process.

attributes.name: stop_sell_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this room type is completely closed for sale on this date across all channels. When true, no new reservations are accepted.

attributes.name: total_physical_rooms
attributes.description: Total number of physical rooms of this room type at the property, representing the maximum inventory capacity.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this availability snapshot record was last updated in the data warehouse.

products.name: room_block
products.description: Group or event room block record reserving a contracted quantity of rooms by room type for a defined date range and pickup period. Captures block code, block name, group/event association, contracted room-nights by type and date, cumulative pickup, release/cutoff dates, attrition percentage and penalty terms, wash factor, and block status lifecycle (tentative, definite, cancelled, released). Links to group reservations and event contracts. Supports group inventory management, attrition tracking, and block release decisions in Oracle OPERA PMS and Delphi by Amadeus.

attributes.description: Contractual percentage threshold below which the group incurs attrition penalties for unmet room night commitments. Expressed as percentage (e.g., 20.00 for 20%).

attributes.name: block_name

attributes.name: block_status

attributes.name: deposit_amount

attributes.name: deposit_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the deposit payment must be received to maintain the block reservation.

attributes.name: deposit_required_flag

attributes.name: end_date

attributes.name: internal_notes

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.name: negotiated_rate_amount

attributes.name: overbooking_allowed_flag

attributes.name: owner_email

attributes.name: owner_name

attributes.name: owner_phone

attributes.name: picked_up_room_nights

attributes.name: pickup_percentage

attributes.name: rate_code

attributes.name: special_requests

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: First date of the room block period when rooms are reserved for the group or event.

Tracks cumulative pickup, remaining block availability, pickup pace versus prior year, and variance to contracted rooms. products.reference: OPERA Block Pickup / IDeaS Group Evaluation

attributes.name: block_pickup_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the daily block pickup tracking record.

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the corporate or event account that owns this group block contract.

attributes.description: Reference to the hotel or resort property where the block pickup occurred.

attributes.name: room_block_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent group room block contract for which pickup is being tracked.

attributes.name: room_type_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific room type (e.g., King Deluxe, Double Queen) for which pickup is tracked.

attributes.name: block_status

attributes.name: booking_channel_code
attributes.description: The distribution channel through which the group block was booked (e.g., Direct, GDS, Sales Team).

attributes.name: contracted_rooms
attributes.description: The total number of rooms committed in the original group block contract for this room type and stay date.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Group Block Contract

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this block pickup record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cumulative_pickup
attributes.description: The total cumulative number of rooms picked up from the block from contract inception through the current pickup date.

attributes.name: cutoff_date
attributes.description: The contractual date by which the group must pick up rooms or release unused inventory back to general availability.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Group Block Contract Terms

attributes.name: days_to_arrival
attributes.description: The number of days remaining from the pickup date until the stay date, used to assess booking window and release timing.

attributes.name: displacement_cost

attributes.name: forecasted_pickup
attributes.description: The revenue management systems forecasted number of rooms expected to be picked up from this block by arrival date.

attributes.name: group_code
attributes.description: The unique alphanumeric code assigned to the group block in the PMS for identification and reservation linking.

attributes.name: is_lra_eligible

attributes.description: The market segment classification for this group block (e.g., Corporate, Association, SMERF, Government).

attributes.name: net_pickup
attributes.description: The adjusted pickup count after applying wash factor, representing the expected actual occupied rooms from the block.

attributes.name: pickup_date
attributes.description: The date on which this pickup measurement was captured or calculated, representing the snapshot date for reporting.

attributes.name: pickup_notes

attributes.name: pickup_pace_variance
attributes.description: The difference between current year pickup and prior year pickup at the same point in time, indicating booking pace trend.

attributes.name: pickup_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of contracted rooms that have been picked up, calculated as (rooms_picked_up / contracted_rooms) * 100.

attributes.name: pickup_rate
attributes.description: The negotiated room rate (ADR) for rooms picked up from this block, used for revenue calculation and forecasting.

attributes.name: pickup_revenue
attributes.description: The total room revenue generated from picked-up rooms, calculated as rooms_picked_up multiplied by pickup_rate.

attributes.name: pickup_variance
attributes.description: The difference between actual rooms picked up and contracted rooms (rooms_picked_up minus contracted_rooms), indicating over or under performance.

attributes.name: prior_year_pickup
attributes.description: The number of rooms picked up for the same group or comparable group at the same point in time last year, used for pace analysis.

attributes.name: rate_plan_code
attributes.description: The rate plan code associated with the group block pricing structure.

attributes.name: released_rooms
attributes.description: The number of rooms from the block that have been released back to general inventory due to non-pickup or cutoff date passage.

attributes.name: remaining_block_rooms

attributes.name: rooms_picked_up
attributes.description: The number of rooms from the block that have been reserved or booked by group attendees as of the pickup date.

attributes.name: stay_date

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this block pickup record was last modified or refreshed.

attributes.name: wash_factor
attributes.description: The percentage of block rooms expected to cancel or no-show, used to adjust net pickup forecasts and overbooking strategies.

Distinguishes between OOO (not counted in available inventory) and OOS (counted but not sold) per USALI standards. Managed in Oracle OPERA PMS.

attributes.name: primary_out_employee_id

attributes.name: property_id

attributes.name: approved_by_name

attributes.name: closed_by_name

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this out-of-order record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and operational reporting.

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: duration_days

attributes.name: estimated_cost
attributes.description: Estimated cost in local currency for repairs, maintenance, or renovation work required to return the room to service. Used for CapEx and OpEx planning.
attributes.references: USALI - Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry

attributes.name: expected_return_date
attributes.description: Planned or estimated date when the room is expected to be returned to sellable inventory after repairs or maintenance are completed.

attributes.name: guest_impacted_flag

attributes.name: impact_on_revpar

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: ooo_code

attributes.name: ooo_reason

attributes.name: ooo_status
attributes.description: Designation type: OOO (Out-of-Order - not counted in available inventory) or OOS (Out-of-Service - counted in inventory but not sold). Follows USALI standards for inventory accounting.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Urgency level assigned to the repair or maintenance work (Critical, High, Medium, Low). Critical priority indicates immediate revenue impact or safety concern.

attributes.name: record_status

attributes.name: relocation_required_flag

attributes.name: reported_by_name

attributes.name: responsible_department

attributes.name: safety_concern_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the out-of-order condition involves a safety or health hazard requiring immediate attention per OSHA or local safety regulations.
attributes.references: OSHA - Occupational Safety and Health Administration

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date when the room was first designated as out-of-order or out-of-service and removed from sellable inventory.

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the room was designated as out-of-order or out-of-service, including time of day for accurate inventory impact tracking.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this out-of-order record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: work_order_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the maintenance or repair work order associated with this out-of-order designation. Links to work order management system.

products.name: allotment
products.description: Channel or partner allotment record defining a pre-allocated inventory quota for a specific distribution channel, OTA, tour operator, wholesale partner, or corporate account. Captures allotment quantity by room type and date range, release period (days before arrival), auto-release rules, sell-through/freesale thresholds, performance-based adjustment triggers, and channel-specific rate linkage. Managed in Sabre SynXis CRS for real-time channel distribution and inventory allocation across OTA, GDS, and wholesale partners.

attributes.name: allotment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the channel or partner allotment record. Primary key.
attributes.references: HTNG (Hotel Technology Next Generation) - Inventory Management Standards

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Channel allotments are frequently tied to co-marketing campaigns with OTAs or wholesalers (Expedia exclusive inventory for joint promotions). Essential for tracking channel partnership performance, re

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution channel, Online Travel Agency (OTA), Global Distribution System (GDS), tour operator, wholesale partner, or corporate account to which this allotment is allocated.

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to guest.corporate_account. Business justification: Travel agency and corporate allotments are contracted with specific accounts. Revenue management needs this link for contract compliance monitoring, allotment utilization reporting, commission calcula

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Channel allotments are managed by sales/distribution departments with dedicated cost center budgets for channel management labor, technology costs, and commission expenses. Essential for departmental

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the hotel property where this allotment applies.

attributes.name: revenue_rate_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the rate plan associated with this allotment, defining the pricing structure and rate rules for bookings made through this channel or partner. Nullable if rate is managed separately.

attributes.name: room_type_id
attributes.description: Reference to the room type (e.g., Standard King, Deluxe Suite) for which this allotment is defined.

attributes.name: activated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this allotment was activated and made available for bookings. Nullable if not yet activated.

attributes.name: adjustment_trigger_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether performance-based automatic adjustment of the allotment quantity is enabled (True) or disabled (False). When enabled, the allotment quantity may be increased or decreased based on sell-through performance.

attributes.name: allocated_quantity
attributes.description: The total number of rooms pre-allocated to the channel or partner for the specified room type and date range.

attributes.name: allotment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the allotment: active (currently in use), inactive (not currently active), suspended (temporarily halted), expired (past end date), or pending (awaiting activation).

attributes.name: allotment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the allotment by partner type: channel (generic distribution channel), OTA (Online Travel Agency), GDS (Global Distribution System), wholesale (wholesale partner), corporate (corporate account), group (group booking block), or tour_operator (tour operator allocation). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: channel|ota|gds|wholesale|corporate|group|tour_operator — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: auto_release_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether unsold allotment inventory is automatically released back to general inventory when the release period is reached (True) or requires manual release (False).

attributes.name: available_quantity
attributes.description: The number of rooms remaining available in this allotment (calculated as allocated_quantity minus sold_quantity).

attributes.name: booking_window_end_days
attributes.description: The maximum number of days before arrival that bookings can be made from this allotment. For example, 365 means bookings can be made up to 365 days in advance. Nullable if no maximum booking window applies.

attributes.name: booking_window_start_days
attributes.description: The minimum number of days before arrival that bookings can be made from this allotment. For example, 1 means bookings can be made starting 1 day before arrival. Nullable if no minimum booking window applies.

attributes.name: allotment_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier or code for the allotment, used for tracking and reporting purposes in the Central Reservation System (CRS) and Property Management System (PMS).

attributes.name: commission_rate_percent
attributes.description: The commission percentage paid to the channel or partner for bookings made through this allotment. For example, 15.00 represents a 15% commission.

attributes.name: contract_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the legal contract or agreement governing this allotment arrangement with the channel or partner.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this allotment record was first created in the Central Reservation System (CRS).

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The last date on which this allotment is effective. Nullable for open-ended allotments.

attributes.name: expired_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this allotment expired and was no longer available for bookings. Nullable if not yet expired.

attributes.name: freesale_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel or partner can sell beyond the allocated quantity by accessing general inventory (True) or is restricted to the allocated quantity only (False). Freesale allows partners to sell from the hotel's available inventory without a fixed allotment limit.

attributes.name: freesale_threshold_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum number of rooms that must remain available in general inventory before freesale access is restricted or disabled for this allotment. Nullable if freesale is not enabled.

attributes.name: lra_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether Last Room Availability (LRA) is enabled for this allotment, allowing the channel or partner to sell the last available room at the property (True) or restricting access when inventory is low (False).

attributes.name: max_los
attributes.description: The maximum number of nights a guest can book when reserving from this allotment. Nullable if no maximum Length of Stay (LOS) restriction applies.

attributes.name: min_los
attributes.description: The minimum number of nights a guest must book when reserving from this allotment. Nullable if no minimum Length of Stay (LOS) restriction applies.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this allotment record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: allotment_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name for the allotment (e.g., 'Expedia Summer Block', 'Corporate XYZ Annual Contract').

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this allotment, including special terms, conditions, or operational instructions.

attributes.name: overbooking_limit
attributes.description: The maximum number of rooms that can be overbooked for this allotment beyond the allocated quantity, used for yield optimization and revenue management. Nullable if overbooking is not permitted.

attributes.name: performance_threshold_percent
attributes.description: The minimum sell-through percentage required to maintain or increase the allotment quantity. For example, 80.00 means the partner must sell at least 80% of the allocated rooms to avoid reduction. Nullable if no performance threshold applies.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: The priority ranking of this allotment relative to other allotments for the same room type and date range. Lower numbers indicate higher priority for inventory allocation. Used by Revenue Management System (RMS) for dynamic allocation.

attributes.name: release_period_days
attributes.description: The number of days before the arrival date by which unsold allotment inventory must be released back to general inventory. For example, a 7-day release period means unsold rooms are returned to the hotel 7 days before arrival.

attributes.name: sold_quantity
attributes.description: The number of rooms from this allotment that have been sold or reserved by the channel or partner.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The first date on which this allotment becomes effective and inventory is allocated to the channel or partner.

attributes.name: suspended_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this allotment was suspended or temporarily halted. Nullable if never suspended.

products.name: inventory_overbooking_policy
products.description: Property and room-type level overbooking policy configuration defining maximum overbooking limits (as percentage or absolute count above physical capacity) per room type per stay date or date range. Captures overbooking threshold, walk risk tolerance, upgrade buffer, and approval authority. Managed by revenue management team in IDeaS G3 RMS and enforced in Oracle OPERA PMS and Sabre SynXis CRS.

attributes.name: inventory_overbooking_policy_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the overbooking policy configuration record.

attributes.name: primary_inventory_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who approved this overbooking policy for activation.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the hotel property to which this overbooking policy applies.

attributes.name: room_type_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific room type (e.g., King Suite, Double Queen) governed by this overbooking policy.

attributes.name: tertiary_inventory_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who most recently modified this overbooking policy record.

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: The role or position authorized to approve and activate this overbooking policy, ensuring accountability for revenue and guest satisfaction impact.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this overbooking policy was formally approved for use.

attributes.name: cancellation_forecast_rate
attributes.description: The expected cancellation rate (as a percentage) for this room type during the policy period, used to justify overbooking limits.

attributes.name: channel_applicability
attributes.description: Defines which distribution channels (direct, OTA, GDS) are subject to this overbooking policy, enabling channel-specific inventory control.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this overbooking policy record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this overbooking policy expires or is no longer enforced. Null indicates an open-ended policy.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Date Range Configuration

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this overbooking policy becomes active and begins to govern inventory allocation.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Date Range Configuration

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this overbooking policy record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: los_restriction_max
attributes.description: Maximum length of stay (in nights) allowed for reservations subject to this overbooking policy. Null indicates no maximum restriction.

attributes.name: los_restriction_min
attributes.description: Minimum length of stay (in nights) required for reservations subject to this overbooking policy. Null indicates no minimum restriction.

attributes.name: lra_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether Last Room Availability is enabled for this overbooking policy, allowing distribution partners to sell inventory up to the overbooking limit.

attributes.name: maximum_overbooking_rooms
attributes.description: The absolute maximum number of rooms that can be overbooked above physical capacity, calculated or manually set based on the overbooking limit configuration.

attributes.name: no_show_forecast_rate
attributes.description: The expected no-show rate (as a percentage) for this room type during the policy period, factored into overbooking calculations.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context, rationale, or special instructions related to this overbooking policy.

attributes.name: overbooking_limit_type
attributes.description: Defines whether the overbooking limit is expressed as a percentage of physical capacity, an absolute room count, or dynamically calculated by the RMS.

attributes.name: overbooking_limit_value
attributes.description: The numeric value representing the maximum overbooking threshold. Interpretation depends on overbooking_limit_type (e.g., 10.00 for 10% or 5.00 for 5 rooms).

attributes.name: physical_room_capacity
attributes.description: The actual number of physical rooms of this room type available at the property, used as the baseline for calculating overbooking limits.

attributes.name: policy_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the overbooking policy, used for reference in revenue management and distribution systems.

attributes.name: policy_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name describing the overbooking policy (e.g., 'High Season King Suite Overbooking', 'Standard Double Overbooking').

attributes.name: policy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the overbooking policy indicating whether it is actively enforced in reservation systems.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: The priority level of this overbooking policy relative to other policies, used to resolve conflicts when multiple policies apply to the same inventory.

attributes.name: upgrade_buffer_rooms
attributes.description: Number of higher-category rooms reserved as a buffer to accommodate overbooked guests through complimentary upgrades, reducing walk risk.

attributes.name: walk_cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the walk cost estimate (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: walk_cost_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated average cost per walked guest (including relocation, compensation, and goodwill), used in revenue optimization calculations.

attributes.name: walk_risk_tolerance
attributes.description: The acceptable level of risk for walking guests (relocating to another property) due to overbooking, influencing the aggressiveness of the overbooking strategy.

products.name: los_restriction

Captures restriction type, effective date range, applicable channels, and override authority.

attributes.name: override_authority_level

attributes.name: override_reason_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a documented reason is required when this LOS restriction is overridden. True if reason is mandatory, false otherwise.

attributes.name: priority_rank

attributes.name: restriction_code
attributes.description: Business code identifying this LOS restriction rule for operational reference and reporting.

attributes.name: restriction_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context, rationale, or special instructions for this LOS restriction. Used for operational communication and audit purposes.

attributes.name: restriction_status

attributes.name: revpar_threshold_amount

attributes.name: channel_priority_rank

products.name: rate_plan_room_type_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the assignment between room types and channel rate plans in the revenue management system. It captures room-type-specific rate adjustments, length-of-stay restrictions, sell limits, and availability controls that exist only in the context of a specific room type being sold under a specific channel rate plan. Each record links one room type to one channel rate plan with pricing and inventory control attributes that revenue managers actively configure and adjust based on demand forecasts and channel strategy.. Existence Justification: In hotel revenue management operations, each room type can be sold under multiple channel rate plans (BAR, corporate, package, OTA-specific plans), and each channel rate plan applies to multiple room types within a property. Revenue managers actively configure and manage room-type-specific rate adjustments, length-of-stay restrictions, sell limits, and availability controls for each room-type-rate-plan combination. This is a core operational entity in PMS/RMS systems where humans create, update, and delete these assignments as part of daily yield management and channel distribution strategy.

It captures which wash factor was applied to which block, the predicted and actual wash percentages, variance analysis, and the business context (lead time bucket, block size tier) that determined factor selection. Each record links one room block to one wash factor with attributes that exist only in the context of this application event.. Existence Justification: In revenue management operations, a single group room block is evaluated against multiple wash factor configurations during its lifecycle—initial forecasting may apply one factor based on lead time and block size, revised forecasts may apply updated factors as the block matures, and post-event analysis compares actual performance against multiple factor models to refine future predictions. Conversely, a single wash factor configuration (e.g., 'Corporate groups, 60-90 day lead time, 25-50 rooms') is applied to many different room blocks that match its criteria. Revenue managers actively track each block×wash_factor application as a distinct performance measurement record with predicted vs. actual wash variance.

products.name: room_type_promotion
products.description: This association product represents the promotional configuration between room types and loyalty promotions. It captures the specific promotional rates, bonus earning rules, and booking restrictions that apply when a member books a specific room type under a specific promotion. Each record links one room type to one promotion with attributes that define the promotional offer mechanics, rate overrides, and eligibility windows that exist only in the context of this specific room-promotion combination.. Existence Justification: In travel hospitality loyalty programs, promotions (e.g., 'Book 3 Nights, Earn 5000 Bonus Points' or 'Suite Upgrade Promotion') apply to multiple room types with type-specific promotional rates, bonus earning multipliers, and booking restrictions. Conversely, each room type participates in multiple concurrent promotions throughout the year (seasonal offers, tier-specific promotions, flash sales). Revenue management and loyalty teams actively configure and manage these room-type-promotion combinations, setting promotional rates, blackout dates, inventory caps, and booking windows for each pairing.

products.name: room_type_competitive_benchmark
products.description: This association product represents the configuration relationship between room types and competitive sets for STR benchmarking and rate shopping. It captures the specific mapping rules that revenue managers define to determine which room type categories are compared against which competitive set segments. Each record links one room type to one competitive set with relationship-specific attributes including benchmark category mapping, rate shopping frequency overrides, length-of-stay parameters, and effective date ranges that exist only in the context of this specific room-type-to-comp-set pairing.. Existence Justification: Revenue managers actively configure many-to-many mappings between room types and competitive sets for STR benchmarking and rate shopping. A single room type (e.g., Deluxe King) can be benchmarked against multiple competitive sets simultaneously (luxury downtown set, airport premium set, corporate traveler set), and each competitive set is used to benchmark multiple room types across the property. Each pairing requires relationship-specific configuration including STR category mapping, rate shopping frequency overrides, LOS parameters, and effective date ranges that cannot reside on either the room type or competitive set entity alone.

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: days_of_week_mask
attributes.description: 7-character binary string indicating which days of the week the restriction applies, ordered Monday through Sunday (e.g., '1111100' = Mon–Fri only, '0000011' = Sat–Sun only). Enables day-of-week yield strategies such as weekend minimum stay requirements.

attributes.name: demand_forecast_level

attributes.name: distribution_status

attributes.name: effective_date

attributes.name: expiry_date

attributes.name: hurdle_rate_amount

attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; USALI

attributes.name: is_blackout
attributes.description: Indicates whether the effective date range is designated as a blackout period, during which the rate plan is completely closed to new bookings. Commonly applied during peak demand events, holidays, or sold-out periods.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; AHLA

attributes.name: is_cta
attributes.description: Indicates whether arrivals are blocked on the effective date(s) for this rate plan and room type. When True, guests cannot check in on the restricted date, preventing short-stay bookings that fragment inventory during high-demand periods.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; HTNG

attributes.name: is_ctd
attributes.description: Indicates whether departures are blocked on the effective date(s) for this rate plan and room type. When True, guests cannot check out on the restricted date, used to extend stays through high-demand nights and maximize occupancy continuity.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; HTNG

attributes.name: is_loyalty_exempt
attributes.description: Indicates whether members of the hotel's loyalty program are exempt from this restriction (e.g., LRA — Last Room Availability guarantee for elite members). Supports loyalty program administration and member benefit fulfillment.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; Salesforce CRM; AHLA Loyalty Standards

attributes.name: last_distributed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this restriction was last successfully distributed to external channels (OTA, GDS) via Sabre SynXis CRS. Used to monitor distribution latency and SLA compliance for rate parity management.

attributes.name: max_advance_purchase_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days prior to arrival within which a booking must be made to qualify for this rate plan. Defines the booking window ceiling for advance purchase restrictions, preventing bookings made too far in advance at promotional rates.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: max_los
attributes.description: Maximum number of nights a guest is permitted to stay under this rate plan on the restricted date(s). Used to prevent long-stay bookings at discounted rates during high-demand periods. Null when restriction type is not MAX_LOS.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: min_los
attributes.description: Minimum number of nights a guest must stay to be eligible to book under this rate plan on the restricted date(s). A core yield optimization lever in revenue management. Null when restriction type is not MIN_LOS.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: override_allowed

attributes.name: override_authorization_level

attributes.name: priority_rank

attributes.name: restriction_code

attributes.name: restriction_name

attributes.name: restriction_reason

attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; AHLA

attributes.name: restriction_scope
attributes.description: Defines the level at which this restriction is applied: 'property' = entire property; 'room_type' = specific room category; 'rate_plan' = specific rate plan only; 'channel' = specific distribution channel (OTA, GDS, direct). Determines how broadly the restriction is enforced across inventory.

attributes.name: restriction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the rate restriction record. 'active' = currently enforced; 'inactive' = disabled but retained for history; 'pending' = scheduled but not yet effective; 'expired' = past end date; 'overridden' = manually superseded by a revenue manager.

attributes.name: restriction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the restriction mechanism applied. MIN_LOS = Minimum Length of Stay; MAX_LOS = Maximum Length of Stay; CTA = Closed to Arrival; CTD = Closed to Departure; ADVANCE_PURCHASE = minimum days before arrival required to book; BLACKOUT = date fully closed to booking; HURDLE_RATE = minimum acceptable rate threshold.
