attributes.description: Identifier of the subject property (the 'home' property) that owns this competitive set definition. Links to the property master record in the Property domain.

attributes.name: advance_purchase_window_days
attributes.description: The booking lead time window in days used for rate shopping comparisons within this competitive set (e.g., 0 = same-day, 7 = 7-day advance, 30 = 30-day advance). Ensures rate intelligence is captured at consistent booking horizons for fair ADR comparison.
attributes.references: Infor EzRMS — Rate Intelligence Configuration; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the competitive set definition was formally approved by the revenue management authority. Supports audit trail requirements for comp set governance and STR STAR Report submission integrity.
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Management Governance Policy; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the revenue management leader or Director of Revenue who approved this competitive set definition. Required for governance and audit trail of comp set changes that affect STR STAR Report submissions.
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Management Governance Policy; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: ari_target
attributes.description: The Average Rate Index (ARI) target threshold for this competitive set. ARI = Property ADR / Comp Set ADR. A value above 1.00 indicates the property targets a higher ADR than the competitive set average. Drives BAR pricing strategy in IDeaS G3 RMS.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report — ARI Methodology; USALI Revenue Performance Standards

attributes.name: benchmarking_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code used for normalizing ADR, RevPAR, and TRevPAR benchmarking metrics across all properties in the competitive set (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). Ensures consistent monetary comparison in STR STAR Report analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Code Standard; STR STAR Report — Currency Normalization

attributes.name: competitive_set_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the competitive set. 'active' sets are used in live RMS benchmarking and STR reporting; 'inactive' sets are suspended; 'pending_approval' awaits revenue management sign-off; 'archived' are historical sets retained for trend analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this competitive set record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and change history tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity and Accountability; SOX Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: demand_segment_focus
attributes.description: The primary guest demand segment this competitive set is designed to benchmark. 'transient' focuses on FIT (Free Independent Traveler) and leisure; 'group' focuses on MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, Exhibitions) and group blocks; 'contract' focuses on negotiated corporate rates; 'all_segments' covers the full mix.
attributes.references: USALI — Demand Segmentation Standards; Infor EzRMS

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The date from which this competitive set definition becomes active and is used for STR STAR Report benchmarking, RGI, MPI, and ARI calculations. Aligns with STR reporting period start.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report — Reporting Period Standards; Infor EzRMS

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The date on which this competitive set definition expires and is no longer used for active benchmarking. Null indicates an open-ended, currently active set. Supports historical trend analysis when comp set membership changes.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report — Reporting Period Standards; Infor EzRMS

attributes.name: geographic_market
attributes.description: The geographic market or submarket in which the competitive set operates (e.g., 'Manhattan Midtown', 'Chicago O'Hare Corridor', 'Miami Beach'). Aligns with STR market definitions used for Market Penetration Index (MPI) calculations.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report — Market Definition Standards

attributes.name: ideass_comp_set_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: IDeaS G3 Revenue Management System (RMS) Competitive Set Code
attributes.description: The competitive set reference code as configured in IDeaS G3 RMS for pricing strategy alignment. Enables synchronization of comp set definitions between Infor EzRMS benchmarking and IDeaS G3 RMS dynamic pricing rules (DRR) and BAR optimization.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Competitive Intelligence Configuration

tag_set.value: IDeaS G3 Revenue Management System (RMS) Competitive Set Code

attributes.name: is_str_submitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this competitive set has been formally submitted to STR (Smith Travel Research) for STAR Report benchmarking. True means the set is registered with STR and receives STAR Report data; False means it is an internal-only comp set.

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which the competitive set membership and parameters were reviewed by the revenue management team. Best practice requires annual or semi-annual review to ensure comp set relevance as market conditions evolve.
attributes.references: Infor EzRMS — Comp Set Review Workflow; AHLA Revenue Management Best Practices

attributes.name: los_benchmark_nights
attributes.description: The standard Length of Stay (LOS) in nights used as the basis for rate comparison within this competitive set. Typically set to 1 night for transient benchmarking. Used to normalize ADR comparisons across properties with different LOS mix.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report — LOS Normalization; Infor EzRMS

attributes.name: market_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the primary geographic market for this competitive set (e.g., 'USA', 'GBR', 'DEU'). Used for multi-national portfolio benchmarking and currency normalization in revenue performance reporting.

attributes.name: market_segment
attributes.description: Hotel chain scale segment classification of the competitive set as defined by STR. Ensures that the comp set is composed of properties within the same or adjacent competitive tier. Used to validate comp set composition integrity for RGI and MPI calculations.
attributes.references: STR Chain Scale Segmentation Standard; AHLA Hotel Classification Guidelines

attributes.name: max_room_count
attributes.description: Maximum number of guestrooms a competitor property may have to qualify for inclusion in this competitive set. Used alongside min_room_count to define the acceptable size range for comp set membership.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report — Comp Set Eligibility Criteria

attributes.name: member_count
attributes.description: Total number of competitor properties currently included in this competitive set. STR STAR Report typically requires a minimum of 3 and maximum of 10 competitor properties for statistically valid benchmarking. Derived from the comp set membership roster but stored here for quick reference.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report — Minimum Comp Set Size Requirements

attributes.name: min_room_count
attributes.description: Minimum number of guestrooms a competitor property must have to qualify for inclusion in this competitive set. Ensures size comparability for RevPAR and occupancy benchmarking. Typically aligned with the subject property's room count range.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report — Comp Set Eligibility Criteria

attributes.name: mpi_target
attributes.description: The Market Penetration Index (MPI) target threshold for this competitive set. MPI = Property Occupancy Rate / Comp Set Occupancy Rate. A value above 1.00 indicates the property targets higher occupancy than the competitive set average. Used in revenue strategy planning.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report — MPI Methodology; USALI Revenue Performance Standards

attributes.name: competitive_set_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name assigned to the competitive set (e.g., 'Downtown Luxury Primary Set', 'Airport Corridor Secondary Set'). Used in Infor EzRMS and STR STAR Report submissions to identify the grouping.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report — Competitive Set Naming Convention; Infor EzRMS

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this competitive set definition. Ensures comp set membership remains current and aligned with market dynamics. Triggers a review workflow in the Revenue Management System.
attributes.references: Infor EzRMS — Comp Set Review Workflow; AHLA Revenue Management Best Practices

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for revenue management team annotations regarding this competitive set, such as rationale for competitor inclusion/exclusion, market context, or pending changes. Not used in automated benchmarking calculations.

attributes.name: primary_benchmarking_metric
attributes.description: The primary Key Performance Indicator (KPI) used to evaluate competitive performance for this comp set. Options include RevPAR (Revenue Per Available Room), ADR (Average Daily Rate), Occupancy Rate (OCC), TRevPAR (Total Revenue Per Available Room), or GOPPAR (Gross Operating Profit Per Available Room).
attributes.references: STR STAR Report — Benchmarking Metric Definitions; USALI

attributes.name: property_type_filter
attributes.description: Filter defining the property service type composition of this competitive set. Ensures benchmarking is conducted against properties of comparable service level and amenity offering. Aligns with AHLA property classification standards.
attributes.references: AHLA Hotel Classification Standards; STR Chain Scale Definitions

attributes.name: rate_shop_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which competitor rates are retrieved from OTA and GDS channels for properties in this competitive set. Drives the cadence of dynamic pricing adjustments in IDeaS G3 RMS. Only applicable when rate_shopping_enabled is True.
attributes.references: Infor EzRMS — Rate Shopping Configuration; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: rate_shopping_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether automated rate shopping (competitive rate intelligence) is active for this competitive set. When True, the RMS retrieves competitor BAR rates from OTA channels and GDS for dynamic pricing decisions. When False, only STR STAR Report data is used.
attributes.references: Infor EzRMS — Rate Shopping Configuration; HTNG Rate Intelligence Standards

attributes.name: rgi_target
attributes.description: The Revenue Generation Index (RGI) target threshold set by the revenue management team for this competitive set. RGI = Property RevPAR / Comp Set RevPAR. A target above 1.00 indicates the property aims to outperform the comp set. Used in IDeaS G3 RMS and Infor EzRMS for performance goal-setting.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report — RGI Methodology; USALI Revenue Performance Standards

attributes.name: rms_comp_set_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Revenue Management System (RMS) Competitive Set ID
attributes.description: The native competitive set identifier as stored in the Revenue Management System (Infor EzRMS or IDeaS G3 RMS). Used for cross-system reconciliation and data lineage tracing between the lakehouse Silver Layer and the operational RMS.
attributes.references: Infor EzRMS — Competitive Benchmarking Module; IDeaS G3 RMS

tag_set.value: Revenue Management System (RMS) Competitive Set ID

attributes.name: set_type
attributes.description: Classification of the competitive set indicating its strategic purpose. 'primary' is the main STR STAR Report comp set; 'secondary' is an alternate benchmarking group; 'custom' is an ad-hoc internal set; 'str_defined' is a set defined by STR directly; 'internal' is used for internal rate intelligence only.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report — Competitive Set Classification; Infor EzRMS

attributes.name: str_comp_set_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: STR (Smith Travel Research) Competitive Set Code
attributes.description: The unique alphanumeric code assigned by STR (Smith Travel Research) to identify this competitive set in the STAR Report system. Required for submitting and retrieving benchmarking data from STR. Maps directly to the STR comp set identifier in Infor EzRMS.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report — Competitive Set Identifier Standard

tag_set.value: STR (Smith Travel Research) Competitive Set Code

attributes.name: str_market_code
attributes.description: The STR-assigned market code identifying the geographic market in which this competitive set is benchmarked. Used to retrieve market-level aggregates for MPI calculation and to align with STR STAR Report market definitions.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report — Market Code Reference

attributes.name: str_report_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which STR STAR Report data is received and processed for this competitive set. Determines the cadence of RGI, MPI, and ARI metric refreshes in the Revenue Management System.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report — Data Delivery Specifications

attributes.name: str_submarket_code
attributes.description: The STR-assigned submarket code for more granular geographic benchmarking within a broader STR market. Used when the competitive set operates in a distinct submarket (e.g., airport vs. downtown within the same city market).
attributes.references: STR STAR Report — Submarket Code Reference

attributes.name: str_submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which this competitive set was submitted to STR for STAR Report registration. Relevant only when is_str_submitted is True. Used for audit and compliance tracking of STR data agreements.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report — Submission Audit Trail

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this competitive set record was most recently modified. Used to detect changes in comp set definitions, track membership updates, and support incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Silver Layer. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity and Accountability; SOX Audit Trail Requirements

products.name: str_benchmark
products.description: Competitive intelligence records combining STR STAR Report benchmark indices and granular competitor rate shopping data. Stores RGI (Revenue Generation Index), MPI (Market Penetration Index), ARI (Average Rate Index), property vs comp set ADR/occupancy/RevPAR, report period, and STR submission date from STR data feed. Also captures all shopped competitor rates by competitor property, room type category, rate plan type, shopped rate amount, currency, stay date, shop date, lead time, channel (OTA, direct, GDS), and data source. Sourced from STR (Smith Travel Research) and rate shopping tools (OTA Insight, RateGain) into Infor EzRMS. This is the single authoritative product for all competitive rate intelligence and market benchmarking.
products.reference: STR STAR Report / RGI / MPI / ARI

attributes.name: str_benchmark_id
attributes.description: Primary key for str_benchmark

attributes.name: competitive_set_id
attributes.description: The identifier for the competitive set (comp set) as defined in the STR STAR Report submission. A comp set is the group of competitor properties against which the subject property is benchmarked for ADR, occupancy, and RevPAR performance.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report Methodology; Infor EzRMS Competitive Benchmarking Module

attributes.name: imported_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Revenue analysts import and validate STR benchmark data; employee attribution required for data quality accountability, submission workflow tracking, and performance evaluation of competitive intellig

attributes.name: market_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.market_segment. Business justification: STR benchmark data can be segmented by market segment for competitive analysis. str_benchmark has market_segment (STRING) which should be normalized to FK. N str_benchmark records → 1 market_segment.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the subject property for which this STR benchmark or rate shop record applies. Links to the property master record in the Property domain.

attributes.name: ari
attributes.description: The Average Rate Index (ARI) measures the subject property's ADR (Average Daily Rate) relative to its STR competitive set. An ARI above 1.0 (or 100) indicates the property is achieving a higher average rate than its comp set peers.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report Methodology; AHLA Performance Benchmarking Standards

attributes.name: benchmark_currency_code
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all STR STAR Report monetary benchmark values (ADR, RevPAR) are reported for this record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; STR STAR Report Methodology

attributes.name: benchmark_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of this benchmark or rate shop record. 'active' = current valid record; 'superseded' = replaced by a revised STR submission; 'pending_review' = awaiting data quality validation; 'rejected' = failed data quality checks.
attributes.references: Infor EzRMS; STR STAR Report Data Quality Standards; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: comp_set_adr
attributes.business_glossary_term: Competitive Set (Comp Set) Average Daily Rate (ADR)
attributes.description: The aggregated Average Daily Rate (ADR) of the STR competitive set for the benchmark report period. Used to compute the ARI and assess the property's rate positioning relative to the market.

tag_set.value: Competitive Set (Comp Set) Average Daily Rate (ADR)

attributes.name: comp_set_occupancy_rate
attributes.description: The aggregated occupancy rate (OCC) of the STR competitive set for the benchmark report period. Used to compute the MPI and assess the property's demand capture relative to the market.

attributes.name: comp_set_revpar
attributes.business_glossary_term: Competitive Set (Comp Set) Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR)
attributes.description: The aggregated RevPAR of the STR competitive set for the benchmark report period. Used to compute the RGI and assess the property's overall revenue performance relative to the market.

tag_set.value: Competitive Set (Comp Set) Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR)

attributes.name: comp_set_rooms_available
attributes.description: The total number of rooms available (supply) across all properties in the STR competitive set during the benchmark report period. Used as the denominator for comp set RevPAR and occupancy calculations.

attributes.name: competitor_property_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier or code assigned to the competitor property within the rate shopping tool or STR system (e.g., STR property code, OTA Insight property ID). Used for consistent competitor tracking across rate shop cycles.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report Methodology; OTA Insight; RateGain

attributes.name: competitor_property_name
attributes.description: The name of the competitor hotel or resort property for which a rate shop observation was captured. Populated only for records with record_type = 'competitor_rate_shop'. Sourced from OTA Insight or RateGain rate shopping tools.
attributes.references: Infor EzRMS Competitive Benchmarking; OTA Insight; RateGain

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: The originating data source or feed from which this benchmark or rate shop record was ingested. Identifies whether the record came from the STR STAR Report data feed, OTA Insight, RateGain rate shopping tool, Infor EzRMS, or manual entry.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report; OTA Insight; RateGain; Infor EzRMS

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: The distribution channel through which the competitor rate was observed during rate shopping. Key channels include OTA (Online Travel Agency), direct (hotel website), GDS (Global Distribution System), brand website, and voice. Enables channel-level competitive rate analysis.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS; Infor EzRMS; HTNG Channel Distribution Standards

attributes.name: ingested_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this STR benchmark or rate shop record was ingested into the silver layer lakehouse from the source data feed (STR, OTA Insight, RateGain, or Infor EzRMS). Used for data lineage, SLA monitoring, and ETL audit.
attributes.references: HTNG Data Exchange Standards; SOX Financial Controls; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: is_rate_parity_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shopped competitor rate is in compliance with rate parity agreements across distribution channels. True = rate parity maintained; False = rate disparity detected. Used for OTA contract compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: PCI DSS; Sabre SynXis CRS; OTA Insight Rate Parity Monitoring

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: The number of days between the shop date and the stay date at the time the competitor rate was captured. A key dimension for rate shop analysis — rates typically vary by lead time (e.g., 0-day, 7-day, 30-day, 90-day windows).
attributes.references: Infor EzRMS; IDeaS G3 RMS; OTA Insight

attributes.name: los_nights
attributes.description: The Length of Stay (LOS) in nights for which the competitor rate was shopped. Rate shopping tools capture rates for specific LOS windows (e.g., 1-night, 2-night, 7-night) as rates may vary by LOS due to minimum stay restrictions.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; HTNG Rate Standards

attributes.name: market_location_type
attributes.description: The STR-defined market location type for the subject property or competitor property (e.g., urban, suburban, airport, resort, small metro, interstate). Used to contextualize benchmark performance within the appropriate market geography.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report Methodology; AHLA Market Classification Standards

attributes.name: mpi
attributes.description: The Market Penetration Index (MPI) measures the subject property's occupancy rate relative to its STR competitive set. An MPI above 1.0 (or 100) indicates the property is capturing more than its fair share of available demand.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report Methodology; AHLA Performance Benchmarking Standards

attributes.name: ota_platform_name
attributes.description: The specific OTA platform name from which the competitor rate was shopped (e.g., Expedia, Booking.com, Hotels.com, Agoda). Populated when distribution_channel = 'OTA'. Enables OTA-level competitive rate parity analysis.
attributes.references: OTA Insight; RateGain; Sabre SynXis CRS Channel Management

attributes.name: property_adr
attributes.description: The subject property's Average Daily Rate (ADR) for the benchmark report period, expressed in the reporting currency. ADR is calculated as total room revenue divided by total rooms sold, per USALI standards.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report Methodology; USALI Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry

attributes.name: property_occupancy_rate
attributes.description: The subject property's occupancy rate (OCC) for the benchmark report period, expressed as a decimal fraction (e.g., 0.8250 = 82.50%). Calculated as rooms sold divided by rooms available per USALI standards.

attributes.name: property_revpar
attributes.description: The subject property's Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR) for the benchmark report period. RevPAR = ADR × Occupancy Rate. A primary KPI for hotel revenue performance per USALI and STR standards.

attributes.name: property_rooms_available
attributes.description: The total number of rooms available (supply) at the subject property during the benchmark report period. Used as the denominator for RevPAR and occupancy calculations per USALI standards.

attributes.name: rate_availability_status
attributes.description: The availability status of the competitor rate at the time of the rate shop observation. Indicates whether the rate was available for booking, sold out, restricted (e.g., minimum stay), on request, or not shopped for this combination.

attributes.name: rate_plan_type
attributes.description: The type of rate plan under which the competitor rate was shopped or the benchmark rate applies. Includes BAR (Best Available Rate), LRA (Last Room Availability), NRR (Non-Refundable Rate), package, corporate, group, and promotional rates. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BAR|LRA|NRR|package|corporate|group|promotional|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; Infor EzRMS; HTNG Rate Plan Standards

attributes.name: record_type
attributes.description: Discriminator indicating whether this record represents an STR STAR Report benchmark index record or a granular competitor rate shopping observation. Enables partitioned querying across both data types within this unified product.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report Methodology; Infor EzRMS; OTA Insight; RateGain

attributes.name: report_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the STR STAR Report benchmark period for which the benchmark indices and performance metrics are reported.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report Methodology; USALI Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: report_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the STR STAR Report benchmark period (e.g., start of week, month, or year-to-date window) for which the benchmark indices and performance metrics are reported.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report Methodology; USALI Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: report_period_type
attributes.description: The temporal granularity of the STR STAR Report benchmark period. Determines whether the record represents a daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, annual, or year-to-date benchmark snapshot.

attributes.name: rgi
attributes.description: The Revenue Generation Index (RGI) measures the subject property's RevPAR performance relative to its STR competitive set. An RGI above 1.0 (or 100) indicates the property is outperforming its comp set on RevPAR. Sourced from STR STAR Report.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report Methodology; AHLA Performance Benchmarking Standards

attributes.name: room_type_category
attributes.description: The standardized room type category for which the competitor rate was shopped (e.g., standard, deluxe, suite). Enables like-for-like rate comparison across competitor properties. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|deluxe|suite|junior_suite|executive|connecting|accessible|villa|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HTNG Room Type Standards; Infor EzRMS; OTA Insight

attributes.name: shop_date
attributes.description: The date on which the rate shopping observation was captured from the competitor channel. The difference between shop_date and stay_date defines the booking lead time for competitive rate analysis.

attributes.name: shopped_rate_amount
attributes.description: The publicly available rate amount captured for the competitor property during the rate shopping observation, expressed in the shopped rate currency. Represents the per-night room rate for the specified stay date, room type, and rate plan.
attributes.references: OTA Insight; RateGain; Infor EzRMS Competitive Benchmarking

attributes.name: shopped_rate_currency_code
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the shopped competitor rate amount is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). May differ from the benchmark currency if the competitor property operates in a different market.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; OTA Insight; RateGain

attributes.name: stay_date
attributes.description: The specific arrival or stay date for which the competitor rate was shopped. Represents the future date of intended guest stay, enabling forward-looking competitive rate analysis and demand forecasting.
attributes.references: Infor EzRMS; OTA Insight; RateGain; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: str_property_code
attributes.description: The unique property identifier assigned by STR (Smith Travel Research) to the subject property. Used to match and reconcile STR STAR Report submissions and benchmark data feeds.
attributes.references: STR (Smith Travel Research) STAR Report Methodology; AHLA Data Standards

attributes.name: str_report_version
attributes.description: The version number of the STR STAR Report data file or submission from which this benchmark record was sourced. STR may issue revised reports for the same period; this field tracks which version of the report was ingested.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report Methodology; Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: str_submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which the property submitted its performance data to STR for inclusion in the STAR Report benchmark cycle. Used for data reconciliation and audit trail.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report Methodology; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this record was last modified in the silver layer, such as when a revised STR STAR Report submission supersedes a prior record or when a data quality correction is applied.
attributes.references: HTNG Data Exchange Standards; SOX Financial Controls; GDPR Article 5

products.name: competitor_rate
products.description: Competitive rate intelligence records capturing publicly available or shopped rates from competitor properties. Stores competitor property identifier, room type category, rate plan type, shopped rate, currency, stay date, shop date, lead time, channel shopped (OTA, direct, GDS), and data source. Used in Infor EzRMS for competitive benchmarking and rate positioning decisions.

attributes.name: competitor_rate_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each competitor rate intelligence record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this data product.
attributes.references: HTNG Data Standards; Infor EzRMS Competitive Benchmarking Module

attributes.name: competitive_set_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.competitive_set. Business justification: Competitor rate shopping is organized by competitive sets. competitor_rate currently has competitive_set_code (STRING) which should be normalized to FK. N competitor_rate records belong to 1 competiti

attributes.name: competitor_property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the competitor property record against which this rate was shopped. Links to the competitor property master.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report; Infor EzRMS Competitive Set Configuration

attributes.name: shopped_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Revenue analysts conduct competitor rate shopping; employee attribution required for competitive intelligence workflow tracking, data quality accountability, and performance evaluation of rate shoppin

attributes.name: ari
attributes.description: Average Rate Index (ARI) calculated as Travel Hospitality's ADR divided by the competitive set's ADR for the same period. ARI > 1.0 indicates rate premium over the competitive set. Sourced from STR STAR Report or computed from shopped rates.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report; AHLA; Infor EzRMS Competitive Benchmarking

attributes.name: availability_status
attributes.description: Availability status of the competitor room type and rate plan at the time of the shop. Indicates whether the rate was bookable (available), the room type was sold out, or the rate was closed to arrival. Used in demand and compression analysis.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Inventory Controls; Infor EzRMS; HTNG Data Standards

attributes.name: cancellation_policy
attributes.description: Cancellation policy associated with the shopped competitor rate. Distinguishes refundable (flexible) rates from NRR (Non-Refundable Rates), which is a key dimension in rate plan competitive analysis.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; AHLA Revenue Management Best Practices

attributes.name: channel_name
attributes.description: Specific name of the booking channel or OTA platform where the rate was shopped (e.g., Expedia, Booking.com, Hotels.com, Marriott.com, Amadeus GDS). Provides granular channel-level competitive intelligence beyond the channel category.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS; HTNG Channel Distribution Standards

attributes.name: channel_shopped
attributes.description: The distribution channel through which the competitor rate was observed. OTA = Online Travel Agency (e.g., Expedia, Booking.com), GDS = Global Distribution System, direct = competitor brand website. Enables channel-level rate parity and competitive positioning analysis.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS; HTNG Channel Distribution Standards; AHLA

attributes.name: competitor_property_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the competitor hotel or resort property as it appears in the competitive set or OTA listing. Supports reporting and analyst review.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report; Infor EzRMS Competitive Set Configuration

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the country where the competitor property is located (e.g., USA, GBR, FRA). Supports geographic segmentation and multi-market competitive analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this competitor rate record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and SLA monitoring for competitive intelligence data freshness.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; HTNG Data Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the shopped rate is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency normalization in global competitive benchmarking.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Origin system or method by which the competitor rate data was obtained. Infor EzRMS automated shop, STR STAR Report feed, OTA scrape, GDS feed, manual entry, or third-party rate intelligence API. Affects data quality and freshness assessment.
attributes.references: Infor EzRMS; STR STAR Report; HTNG Data Standards

attributes.name: data_source_reference
attributes.description: Specific URL, feed identifier, or external reference from the data source where the competitor rate was retrieved (e.g., OTA listing URL, STR report batch ID, GDS transaction ID). Supports data lineage and auditability.
attributes.references: Infor EzRMS; HTNG Data Standards; SOX

attributes.name: day_of_week
attributes.description: Day of the week corresponding to the stay date (MON through SUN). Pre-computed to support day-of-week rate pattern analysis and weekday vs. weekend competitive pricing strategies without requiring date function computation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MON|TUE|WED|THU|FRI|SAT|SUN — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS Demand Forecasting

attributes.name: fees_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether mandatory fees (resort fees, destination fees, amenity fees) are included in the shopped rate (True) or excluded (False). Affects true cost comparison for rate parity and competitive positioning analysis.
attributes.references: AHLA Resort Fee Transparency Guidelines; USALI

attributes.name: is_weekend
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stay date falls on a weekend (Friday or Saturday night, True) or a weekday (False). Supports weekend vs. weekday rate positioning analysis and demand segmentation.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS Demand Forecasting

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days between the shop date and the stay date (stay_date minus shop_date). Key metric in revenue management for understanding booking window pricing behavior and demand curve positioning.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; AHLA Revenue Management Best Practices

attributes.name: los_nights
attributes.description: The number of nights for which the shopped rate applies, representing the Length of Stay (LOS) restriction or assumption used during the rate shop. Affects rate comparability across competitors.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; AHLA Revenue Management Best Practices

attributes.name: market_code
attributes.description: STR-defined or internal market code representing the geographic market in which the competitor property operates (e.g., NYC, MIAMI, LONDON). Aligns with STR STAR Report market definitions for RGI and MPI benchmarking.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report Market Definitions; Infor EzRMS

attributes.name: meal_plan_code
attributes.description: Meal plan included in the shopped rate. RO = Room Only, BB = Bed and Breakfast, HB = Half Board, FB = Full Board, AI = All Inclusive. Affects rate comparability and value positioning analysis.
attributes.references: IH&RA Hospitality Standards; HTNG Data Standards; Infor EzRMS

attributes.name: occupancy_assumption
attributes.description: Number of guests (occupancy) assumed when the rate was shopped (typically 1 or 2 adults). Affects rate comparability as some competitors price differently by occupancy.
attributes.references: Infor EzRMS Competitive Benchmarking Module; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: our_rate
attributes.description: Travel Hospitality's own Best Available Rate (BAR) for the equivalent room type, stay date, and channel at the time of the shop. Enables direct rate gap and rate index calculations without requiring a join to the rate plan table.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; USALI; AHLA Revenue Management Best Practices

attributes.name: previous_shopped_rate
attributes.description: The competitor rate captured in the immediately preceding shop for the same property, stay date, room type, and channel. Enables rate change delta calculation and trend analysis without requiring a self-join.
attributes.references: Infor EzRMS Competitive Benchmarking Module; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: property_segment
attributes.description: Market segment classification of the competitor property (luxury, premium, select-service, extended stay, resort). Enables segment-level competitive benchmarking aligned with Travel Hospitality's own portfolio segmentation.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report Segmentation; AHLA; Infor EzRMS

attributes.name: rate_change_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates the direction of rate movement compared to the previous shop for the same competitor, stay date, room type, and channel. Supports rate velocity tracking and competitive pricing alerts in Infor EzRMS.
attributes.references: Infor EzRMS Competitive Benchmarking Module; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: rate_delta
attributes.description: Absolute difference between the current shopped rate and the previous shopped rate (shopped_rate minus previous_shopped_rate). Positive value indicates a rate increase; negative indicates a decrease. Supports competitive pricing alert thresholds in RMS.
attributes.references: Infor EzRMS Competitive Benchmarking Module; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: rate_gap
attributes.description: Difference between Travel Hospitality's own rate and the competitor's shopped rate (our_rate minus shopped_rate). Positive value indicates our rate is higher than the competitor; negative indicates we are priced below. Core metric for rate positioning decisions.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; STR STAR Report; AHLA Revenue Management Best Practices

attributes.name: rate_in_usd
attributes.description: Competitor shopped rate converted to US Dollars (USD) using the exchange rate applicable at the time of the shop. Enables normalized cross-currency competitive benchmarking and global RevPAR index calculations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; USALI; IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS

attributes.name: rate_plan_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the competitor rate plan as displayed on the booking channel (e.g., 'Advance Purchase 21 Days', 'Flexible Rate', 'Member Exclusive'). Provides context for rate plan classification.
attributes.references: Infor EzRMS Competitive Benchmarking Module; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: rate_plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the competitor rate plan type shopped. BAR = Best Available Rate, NRR = Non-Refundable Rate. Enables comparison of like-for-like rate plan positioning across the competitive set.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Rate Plan Taxonomy; Sabre SynXis CRS; AHLA Revenue Management Best Practices

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of this competitor rate record in the Silver Layer. Active = current valid record; superseded = replaced by a newer shop for the same key dimensions; invalid = data quality issue flagged; pending_review = awaiting analyst validation.
attributes.references: HTNG Data Standards; SOX Data Governance; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: room_type_category
attributes.description: Standardized room type category used for cross-competitor comparison (e.g., Standard, Deluxe, Suite, Junior Suite). Normalized from competitor-specific room type codes to enable apples-to-apples benchmarking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|deluxe|superior|suite|junior_suite|executive|villa — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: STR STAR Report Room Type Taxonomy; HTNG Data Standards

attributes.name: shop_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the competitor rate was shopped or retrieved. Used to calculate lead time and to track rate movement over time.
attributes.references: Infor EzRMS Competitive Benchmarking Module; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: shop_run_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the rate shopping run or batch session that produced this record, enabling traceability back to the originating shop event.

attributes.name: shop_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) at which the competitor rate was captured during the shopping session. Enables intra-day rate movement tracking.

attributes.name: shopped_rate
attributes.description: The publicly available or shopped room rate for the competitor property for the specified stay date, room type, and rate plan. Represents the gross rate as displayed on the booking channel before taxes and fees. Core input for ADR and RevPAR competitive benchmarking.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report; Infor EzRMS; IDeaS G3 RMS; USALI

attributes.name: special_event_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stay date coincides with a known special event, conference, or demand driver (True) that may explain elevated competitor rates. Supports demand-adjusted competitive rate analysis.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Demand Calendar; Infor EzRMS

attributes.name: star_rating
attributes.description: Official star rating of the competitor property (1.0 to 5.0) as recognized by the relevant hospitality rating authority. Used to filter and segment competitive benchmarking analysis.

attributes.name: stay_date
attributes.description: The specific calendar date for which the competitor rate applies — i.e., the check-in date or the date of the night being priced. Core dimension for rate positioning analysis.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; USALI

attributes.name: taxes_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shopped rate includes taxes and fees (True) or is a pre-tax rate (False). Critical for ensuring rate comparability across channels and geographies where tax display conventions differ.
attributes.references: PCI DSS; USALI; AHLA Revenue Management Best Practices

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this competitor rate record in the Silver Layer. Used for incremental processing, change data capture, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; HTNG Data Standards

products.name: group_evaluation
products.description: Group business evaluation records generated by IDeaS G3 RMS for group booking inquiries, encompassing the full displacement analysis and wash factor modeling. Captures group inquiry reference, proposed dates, room block size, proposed group rate, displacement cost analysis (transient rooms displaced, transient ADR displaced, net revenue impact, total spend including F&B and ancillary), wash factor parameters (expected attrition percentage by group type, booking lead time bucket, historical wash percentage, adjusted wash factor), recommended minimum rate, accept/decline recommendation, evaluation status, and revenue manager decision. This is the SSOT for all group revenue decision-making including displacement modeling and block attrition forecasting.

attributes.name: group_evaluation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each group business evaluation record generated by IDeaS G3 RMS. Primary key for the group_evaluation data product in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the corporate account, travel agency, or group organizer account associated with this group inquiry, as maintained in Salesforce CRM and Oracle OPERA PMS AR module.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Object; Oracle OPERA PMS AR

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Group RFPs often originate from marketing campaigns targeting corporate/SMIC segments. Linking the campaign helps measure campaign effectiveness in driving qualified group leads and conversion rates.

attributes.name: decision_maker_member_id

attributes.name: guest_group_block_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to guest.guest_group_block. Business justification: Revenue managers evaluate guest group blocks for displacement analysis and rate decisions. The group_evaluation process directly assesses guest.guest_group_block entities to determine whether to accep

attributes.name: ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger. Business justification: Group booking decisions impact revenue recognition and require GL account mapping for group revenue tracking, displacement cost accounting, and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: primary_banquet_event_order_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Primary Banquet Event Order Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fnb.banquet_event_order. Business justification: Group evaluations assess F&B revenue contribution from banquet events to offset room displacement. Required for displacement analysis, group acceptance decisions, total property profitability evaluati

attributes.description: Identifier of the hotel or resort property for which the group evaluation is being conducted. Links to the property master record in the Property domain.

attributes.name: revenue_rate_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.revenue_rate_plan. Business justification: Group evaluations are performed for specific rate plans. group_evaluation has rate_plan_code (STRING) which should be normalized to FK. N group_evaluation records → 1 revenue_rate_plan. Removes redund

attributes.name: wash_factor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.wash_factor. Business justification: Group evaluations apply wash factors from the wash_factor master table to estimate attrition. N group_evaluation records → 1 wash_factor. Note: wash_factor_pct on group_evaluation is the APPLIED value

attributes.name: ancillary_revenue_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated ancillary revenue from the group including spa, parking, audio-visual, business center, and other non-room, non-F&B spend. Used in total spend calculation for net revenue impact assessment.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module; USALI — Other Operated Departments

attributes.name: arrival_date
attributes.description: Proposed first night of the group room block. Used as the start of the displacement analysis window in IDeaS G3 RMS.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: attrition_pct
attributes.description: Expected attrition percentage for the group block by group type, representing the proportion of contracted rooms the group is expected not to use. Distinct from wash factor in that attrition is the contractual exposure, while wash is the statistical pickup adjustment.

attributes.name: channel_code
attributes.description: The distribution channel through which the group inquiry was received (e.g., direct sales, GDS, OTA, travel agency). Used for channel contribution analysis and commission cost modeling in the net revenue impact calculation.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS — Channel Management; AHLA Channel Distribution Standards

attributes.name: counter_offer_rate
attributes.description: Alternative per-room per-night rate proposed by the revenue manager as a counter-offer to the group organizer when the proposed_group_rate is below the minimum_acceptable_rate. Populated only when revenue_manager_decision = 'counter_offer'.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this group evaluation record was first captured in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Used for data lineage and ETL audit trail.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity; SOX — Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this evaluation record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Ensures consistent financial reporting per USALI and IFRS/GAAP standards.

attributes.name: cutoff_date
attributes.description: The date by which unbooked rooms in the group block are released back to general inventory. After this date, the property may sell unreserved block rooms to transient guests. Critical for inventory management and wash factor actualization.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS — Group Block Management; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: decision_override_reason
attributes.description: Free-text justification provided by the revenue manager when their decision overrides the RMS recommendation (e.g., strategic account relationship, future business potential, competitive displacement risk). Required when revenue_manager_decision differs from rms_recommendation.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: decision_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the revenue manager recorded their final accept, decline, or counter-offer decision. Used for SLA tracking and decision audit trail.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module; SOX — Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: demand_forecast_occupancy_pct
attributes.description: Forecasted transient Occupancy Rate (OCC) for the property during the group's proposed stay dates, as generated by IDeaS G3 RMS or Infor EzRMS. High forecasted occupancy increases displacement cost and raises the minimum acceptable rate.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Forecasting Module; Infor EzRMS — Demand Forecasting; STR STAR Report

attributes.name: departure_date
attributes.description: Proposed last night of the group room block (checkout date). Defines the end of the displacement analysis window.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: displacement_cost
attributes.description: Total estimated revenue lost from displaced transient business if the group block is accepted, calculated as transient_rooms_displaced multiplied by transient_adr_displaced across the stay period. Key component of the net revenue impact analysis.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Displacement Analysis Module; USALI; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: evaluation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the group evaluation workflow. Tracks progression from initial inquiry receipt through revenue manager decision. 'pending' = awaiting RMS analysis; 'under_review' = revenue manager reviewing; 'recommended_accept' = RMS recommends acceptance; 'recommended_decline' = RMS recommends decline; 'accepted' = revenue manager approved; 'declined' = revenue manager rejected.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: evaluation_timestamp
attributes.description: The principal real-world event timestamp when the group evaluation was initiated and processed by IDeaS G3 RMS. Represents the business event time, distinct from record audit timestamps.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module

attributes.name: fb_revenue_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated Food and Beverage (F&B) revenue contribution from the group, including banquet, catering, and outlet spend. Sourced from Delphi by Amadeus event catering estimates and historical group F&B spend patterns.
attributes.references: Delphi by Amadeus — Catering Module; USALI — F&B Department

attributes.name: group_name
attributes.description: Name of the group or event associated with the booking inquiry (e.g., 'Acme Corp Annual Sales Conference 2025'). Used for identification and reporting across Delphi by Amadeus and Oracle OPERA PMS.
attributes.references: Delphi by Amadeus — Group Block Management; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: group_room_revenue
attributes.description: Total projected room revenue from the group block at the proposed group rate, calculated as adjusted room block (post-wash) multiplied by proposed_group_rate across all nights. Gross revenue contribution from rooms only.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module; USALI

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: Classification of the group by business segment. Drives wash factor parameters and attrition modeling in IDeaS G3 RMS. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: corporate|association|government|leisure|sports|wedding|social|tour_operator|incentive — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module; AHLA Group Business Standards

attributes.name: historical_wash_pct
attributes.description: Historical average wash percentage for this group type and property, derived from past group performance data in IDeaS G3 RMS. Serves as the baseline input before adjustments for lead time and current demand conditions.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Wash Factor Modeling; Infor EzRMS — Demand Forecasting

attributes.name: inquiry_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference number assigned to the group booking inquiry, as generated by the Central Reservation System (CRS) or Property Management System (PMS). Used to cross-reference the evaluation with the originating inquiry across Oracle OPERA PMS and Sabre SynXis CRS.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: is_definite_booking
attributes.description: Indicates whether the group inquiry has converted to a definite (contracted) booking following a positive revenue manager decision. True = definite booking confirmed; False = still in tentative or evaluation stage.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS — Group Block Management; Delphi by Amadeus

attributes.name: lead_time_bucket
attributes.description: Categorical bucket representing the number of days between the group inquiry date and the proposed arrival date. Used as a parameter in wash factor modeling, as groups booked further in advance typically exhibit higher wash rates.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Wash Factor Modeling; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: los_nights
attributes.description: Total number of nights in the proposed group stay, calculated as departure_date minus arrival_date. Represents the Length of Stay (LOS) for the group block used in displacement and revenue impact modeling.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module; USALI

attributes.name: minimum_acceptable_rate
attributes.description: The minimum per-room per-night rate recommended by IDeaS G3 RMS below which accepting the group would result in negative net revenue impact after accounting for displacement costs. This is the RMS-generated floor rate for negotiation.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: net_revenue_impact
attributes.description: Net revenue impact of accepting the group, calculated as total group spend (room + F&B + ancillary) minus displacement cost. Positive value indicates the group is accretive; negative value indicates the group destroys revenue versus transient alternative. Primary decision metric in the evaluation.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Displacement Analysis Module; USALI; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: peak_night_rooms
attributes.description: Maximum number of rooms occupied on any single night within the group block. Used for capacity planning and displacement analysis at the peak demand point.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module; AHLA Group Business Standards

attributes.name: proposed_group_rate
attributes.description: The per-room per-night rate proposed by the group organizer or sales manager for the room block, expressed in the property's operating currency. This is the rate under evaluation against the displacement cost and minimum acceptable rate.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module; USALI; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: revenue_manager_decision
attributes.description: Final decision made by the revenue manager after reviewing the RMS recommendation and displacement analysis. May align with or override the RMS recommendation. 'pending' indicates no decision has been recorded yet.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: revpar_impact
attributes.description: Estimated change in Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR) for the property during the group stay dates if the group is accepted, compared to the transient-only forecast. Negative RevPAR impact is a key indicator for decline recommendation.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module; STR STAR Report; USALI

attributes.name: rgi_benchmark
attributes.description: The property's Revenue Generation Index (RGI) from the STR STAR Report for the competitive set during the evaluation period. Used as a competitive context benchmark to assess whether accepting the group at the proposed rate is competitively rational.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report — Revenue Generation Index (RGI); Infor EzRMS — Competitive Benchmarking

attributes.name: rms_recommendation
attributes.description: Automated accept, decline, or counter-offer recommendation generated by IDeaS G3 RMS based on displacement analysis, wash factor modeling, and net revenue impact. This is the system-generated recommendation prior to revenue manager override.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module

attributes.name: room_block_size
attributes.description: Total number of guest rooms requested in the group block across all nights of the stay. This is the peak or contracted room block size as submitted in the group inquiry.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the originating operational system (IDeaS G3 RMS group evaluation ID or Delphi by Amadeus opportunity ID). Enables traceability back to the system of record for audit and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module; Delphi by Amadeus

attributes.name: transient_adr_displaced
attributes.description: The forecasted Average Daily Rate (ADR) of the transient business that would be displaced by the group block, as estimated by IDeaS G3 RMS. Used to quantify the revenue opportunity cost of accepting the group.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Displacement Analysis Module; STR STAR Report; USALI

attributes.name: transient_rooms_displaced
attributes.description: Estimated number of transient (individual) room nights that would be displaced if the group block is accepted, as calculated by IDeaS G3 RMS displacement analysis. Core input to the net revenue impact calculation.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Displacement Analysis Module; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this group evaluation record was last modified in the Silver Layer lakehouse, including revenue manager decision updates or status changes.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity; SOX — Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: wash_factor_pct
attributes.description: The adjusted wash factor percentage applied to the contracted room block to estimate actual pickup. Derived from historical wash percentage, group type attrition patterns, and booking lead time bucket. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 15.00 = 15% wash). Used to calculate the adjusted room block for revenue modeling.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Wash Factor Modeling; AHLA Group Business Standards

Critical for revenue managers to assess booking pace and adjust pricing strategy.
