attributes.description: Revenue management system forecast for the expected ADR (Average Daily Rate) on the stay_date, as generated by IDeaS G3 RMS or Infor EzRMS. Baseline against which adr_on_books is compared to assess rate performance vs plan.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Forecasting Module; Infor EzRMS — Revenue Strategy

attributes.name: forecasted_revpar
attributes.description: Revenue management system forecast for RevPAR (Revenue Per Available Room) on the stay_date. Baseline against which revpar_on_books is compared to assess overall revenue pace vs plan. Expressed in the property's operating currency.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Forecasting Module; Infor EzRMS — Revenue Strategy; USALI

attributes.name: forecasted_rooms
attributes.description: Revenue management system forecast for total rooms expected to be occupied on the stay_date, as generated by IDeaS G3 RMS or Infor EzRMS at the time of this report snapshot. Baseline against which rooms_on_books pace is measured to compute variance.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Forecasting Module; Infor EzRMS — Demand Forecasting

attributes.name: is_special_event
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stay_date coincides with a designated special event (conference, concert, sporting event, holiday, local festival) that materially impacts demand. When true, pace expectations and pricing strategies are adjusted relative to normal demand patterns.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Event Calendar; Infor EzRMS — Demand Forecasting

attributes.name: is_weekend
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stay_date falls on a weekend (Saturday or Sunday). Boolean flag used to segment pickup reports into weekday vs weekend cohorts for pace analysis, as weekend demand patterns and pricing strategies differ materially from weekday.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Demand Forecasting; Infor EzRMS

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days between the report_date and the stay_date (stay_date minus report_date). Represents the booking window or days-out at the time of this snapshot. Critical for pace analysis — revenue managers compare pickup velocity across standard lead-time intervals (90, 60, 30, 14, 7, 1 days out).
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Pickup Report Module; Infor EzRMS — Demand Forecasting

attributes.name: los_restriction_active
attributes.business_glossary_term: Length of Stay (LOS) Restriction Active Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a LOS (Length of Stay) restriction (minimum stay requirement) is currently active for the stay_date. LOS restrictions are a key revenue management lever applied during high-demand periods to maximize total revenue across multiple nights.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Inventory Controls; Sabre SynXis CRS — Rate Distribution

tag_set.value: Length of Stay (LOS) Restriction Active Flag

attributes.name: min_los
attributes.description: Minimum number of nights a guest must stay to book the stay_date, when a LOS restriction is active. Null when los_restriction_active is false. Used to enforce stay-through requirements during high-demand periods to prevent short-stay displacement of longer, higher-value bookings.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Inventory Controls; Sabre SynXis CRS — Rate Distribution

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text annotations entered by the revenue manager to document observations, strategy decisions, or contextual factors affecting the pickup pace for this stay_date (e.g., 'Rate opened on OTA due to slow pace', 'Group block released — expect transient pickup'). Supports audit trail and strategy documentation.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Pickup Report Module; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: pickup_velocity
attributes.description: Rate of new reservations being added per day for the stay_date, calculated as the incremental rooms picked up divided by the number of days elapsed in the measurement window. Expressed as rooms per day. Enables revenue managers to assess acceleration or deceleration of booking pace.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Pickup Report Module; Infor EzRMS — Demand Forecasting

attributes.name: prior_year_adr
attributes.description: ADR (Average Daily Rate) on books for the equivalent stay_date in the prior year, at the same lead time. Enables year-over-year rate comparison to assess whether current pricing strategy is yielding rate improvement or erosion versus the prior period.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Pickup Report Module; STR STAR Report benchmarking standard; USALI

attributes.name: prior_year_rooms_on_books
attributes.description: Number of rooms that were on books for the equivalent stay_date in the prior year, at the same lead time (days out). Enables year-over-year (YOY) pace comparison — a standard revenue management benchmarking technique to contextualize current booking pace against historical performance.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Pickup Report Module; STR STAR Report benchmarking standard; Infor EzRMS

attributes.name: rate_plan_code
attributes.description: Rate plan identifier for which this pickup report is scoped (e.g., BAR, LRA, NRR, CORP, PKG). When null, the report covers all rate plans. Enables rate-plan-level pace analysis to assess BAR (Best Available Rate) and NRR (Non-Refundable Rate) booking velocity.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS — Rate Distribution; IDeaS G3 RMS — Pricing Module

attributes.name: report_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this pickup snapshot was captured. Represents the 'as-of' date for all rooms-on-books and ADR figures in this record. The difference between stay_date and report_date defines the lead time (days out). Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP requirement (date-precision is standard for daily pickup reports).
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Pickup Report Module; Infor EzRMS — Demand Forecasting

attributes.name: report_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this pickup report record, typically formatted as PKP-{PropertyCode}-{StayDate}-{SequenceNumber}. Used by revenue managers to reference specific pickup snapshots in IDeaS G3 RMS and Infor EzRMS reporting. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER requirement.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Pickup Report Module; Infor EzRMS — Demand Forecasting

attributes.name: report_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this pickup report record. 'draft' indicates the snapshot is being assembled; 'published' indicates it is available for revenue manager consumption; 'superseded' indicates a later snapshot for the same stay_date/report_date exists; 'cancelled' indicates the report was voided. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER LIFECYCLE_STATUS requirement.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Pickup Report Module

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pickup report generation cadence: 'daily' for standard automated daily snapshots, 'weekly' for weekly pace summaries, 'monthly' for month-end pace reviews, or 'adhoc' for analyst-triggered on-demand reports. Determines the reporting frequency context for pace trend analysis.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Pickup Report Module; Infor EzRMS — Revenue Strategy

attributes.name: revpar_on_books
attributes.business_glossary_term: Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR) on Books
attributes.description: Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR) derived from current on-books position, calculated as (adr_on_books multiplied by rooms_on_books) divided by total_available_rooms. Composite pace metric combining rate and occupancy performance. Expressed in the property's operating currency.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry); STR STAR Report benchmarking standard; IDeaS G3 RMS

tag_set.value: Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR) on Books

attributes.name: room_type_code
attributes.description: Room type classification for which this pickup report is scoped (e.g., STD, DLX, STE, KNG, DBL). When null, the report covers all room types for the property. Enables room-type-level pace analysis to support inventory controls and upsell strategy.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS — Room Type Configuration; IDeaS G3 RMS — Inventory Controls

attributes.name: rooms_on_books
attributes.description: Total number of rooms confirmed on books for the stay_date as of the report_date. This is the primary pace indicator — the current committed inventory position. Revenue managers compare this against forecast and prior-year actuals to assess demand trajectory.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Pickup Report Module; Oracle OPERA PMS — Reservations

attributes.name: rooms_on_books_14d
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rooms on Books at 14 Days Out
attributes.description: Number of rooms that were on books for the stay_date when the lead time was 14 days (i.e., the snapshot captured 14 days prior to stay_date). Critical short-window pace indicator used to trigger last-minute pricing tactics and inventory controls.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Pickup Report Module; Infor EzRMS — Demand Forecasting

tag_set.value: Rooms on Books at 14 Days Out

attributes.name: rooms_on_books_1d
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rooms on Books at 1 Day Out
attributes.description: Number of rooms that were on books for the stay_date when the lead time was 1 day (i.e., the snapshot captured 1 day prior to stay_date). Final pre-arrival pace indicator representing near-final committed occupancy before day-of walk-ins.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Pickup Report Module; Oracle OPERA PMS — Reservations

tag_set.value: Rooms on Books at 1 Day Out

attributes.name: rooms_on_books_30d
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rooms on Books at 30 Days Out
attributes.description: Number of rooms that were on books for the stay_date when the lead time was 30 days (i.e., the snapshot captured 30 days prior to stay_date). Key pace benchmark for near-term demand assessment and rate strategy adjustments.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Pickup Report Module; Infor EzRMS — Demand Forecasting

tag_set.value: Rooms on Books at 30 Days Out

attributes.name: rooms_on_books_60d
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rooms on Books at 60 Days Out
attributes.description: Number of rooms that were on books for the stay_date when the lead time was 60 days (i.e., the snapshot captured 60 days prior to stay_date). Standard pace benchmark used by revenue managers to assess mid-range booking momentum.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Pickup Report Module; Infor EzRMS — Demand Forecasting

tag_set.value: Rooms on Books at 60 Days Out

attributes.name: rooms_on_books_7d
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rooms on Books at 7 Days Out
attributes.description: Number of rooms that were on books for the stay_date when the lead time was 7 days (i.e., the snapshot captured 7 days prior to stay_date). Near-arrival pace indicator used to assess last-week demand and trigger promotional or restriction actions.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Pickup Report Module; Infor EzRMS — Demand Forecasting

tag_set.value: Rooms on Books at 7 Days Out

attributes.name: rooms_on_books_90d
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rooms on Books at 90 Days Out
attributes.description: Number of rooms that were on books for the stay_date when the lead time was 90 days (i.e., the snapshot captured 90 days prior to stay_date). Used as a historical pace benchmark for comparison against current rooms_on_books to measure pickup velocity over the 90-day window.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Pickup Report Module; Infor EzRMS — Demand Forecasting

tag_set.value: Rooms on Books at 90 Days Out

attributes.name: rooms_variance_to_forecast
attributes.description: Difference between rooms_on_books and forecasted_rooms (rooms_on_books minus forecasted_rooms). Positive value indicates ahead-of-pace (over-performing vs forecast); negative value indicates behind-pace (under-performing). Primary KPI for revenue manager intervention decisions.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Pickup Report Module; Infor EzRMS — Revenue Strategy

attributes.name: special_event_name
attributes.description: Name or description of the special event associated with the stay_date when is_special_event is true (e.g., 'Super Bowl Weekend', 'Annual Tech Conference', 'New Year's Eve'). Provides context for anomalous pace patterns in revenue management reporting.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Event Calendar; Infor EzRMS — Demand Forecasting

attributes.name: stay_date
attributes.description: The specific calendar date for which booking pace and pickup velocity are being measured. This is the future arrival/occupancy date that revenue managers are monitoring. Central dimension of the pickup report — all rooms-on-books and ADR snapshots relate to this date.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Pickup Report Module; STR STAR Report benchmarking standard

attributes.name: total_available_rooms
attributes.description: Total number of rooms available for sale for the stay_date at the property (net of out-of-order and out-of-service rooms). Denominator for occupancy rate (OCC) calculation and RevPAR computation. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS inventory controls.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS — Housekeeping and Inventory; USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this pickup report record was last modified in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED requirement.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) — audit trail requirements; GDPR Article 5

products.name: revenue_overbooking_policy
products.description: Property-level overbooking policy configuration defining authorized overbooking levels by room type, day of week, and season. Captures maximum overbooking percentage, absolute overbooking cap, walk policy (compensation type, partner hotel agreements), and approval authority. Managed by revenue management and enforced in Oracle OPERA PMS and IDeaS G3 RMS inventory controls.

attributes.name: revenue_overbooking_policy_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the overbooking policy record. Primary key for the revenue_overbooking_policy data product in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; IDeaS G3 RMS Inventory Controls

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who formally approved this overbooking policy. Links to the workforce/employee master record. Required for SOX compliance and audit trail.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; AHLA Revenue Management Governance

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.policy. Business justification: Overbooking practices must comply with consumer protection policies. Overbooking policy approval requires compliance review to ensure fair walk procedures and compensation. Essential for consumer prot

attributes.name: primary_revenue_property_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the hotel or resort property to which this overbooking policy applies. Links to the property master record in the Property domain.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; AHLA Property Standards

attributes.name: risk_register_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.risk_register. Business justification: Overbooking carries operational and reputational risk requiring risk management oversight. Risk committee reviews overbooking policies and monitors walk incidents. Essential for enterprise risk manage

attributes.name: ada_room_exempt
attributes.description: Indicates whether Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) accessible rooms are excluded from the overbooking pool under this policy. True = ADA rooms are never overbooked. Required for ADA compliance.
attributes.references: ADA Americans with Disabilities Act; AHLA Accessibility Standards; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: approval_authority_level
attributes.description: Organizational authority level required to approve and activate this overbooking policy. Defines the governance hierarchy for policy authorization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: revenue_manager|director_of_revenue|gm|corporate_rm|vp_revenue|cro — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AHLA Revenue Management Governance; SOX Internal Controls; USALI

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this overbooking policy was formally approved by the designated authority. Recorded in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format. Required for audit trail and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; AHLA Revenue Management Governance; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: auto_adjust_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether IDeaS G3 RMS or Infor EzRMS is authorized to automatically adjust the overbooking percentage within the defined min/max bounds without manual revenue manager intervention. True = dynamic auto-adjustment enabled.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Inventory Controls; Infor EzRMS Revenue Strategy

attributes.name: cancellation_rate_assumption_pct
attributes.description: Historical or forecast cancellation rate percentage used as the actuarial basis for setting the overbooking level. Derived from IDeaS G3 RMS or Infor EzRMS demand forecasting models and reviewed periodically by revenue management.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Forecasting; Infor EzRMS Demand Forecasting; USALI

attributes.name: channel_scope
attributes.description: Distribution channel scope to which this overbooking policy applies. 'all' = all booking channels. 'direct' = brand.com and direct reservations. 'ota' = Online Travel Agency bookings. 'gds' = Global Distribution System bookings. 'voice' = call center. 'group' = group block reservations.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Channel Management; Oracle OPERA PMS; HTNG Channel Distribution Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this overbooking policy record was first created in the system, recorded in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: day_of_week_mask
attributes.description: Seven-character binary string representing the days of the week this policy applies to, ordered Monday through Sunday (e.g., '1111100' = Mon–Fri only, '1111111' = all days). Enables granular day-of-week yield optimization.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Inventory Controls; Oracle OPERA PMS Rate Restrictions

attributes.name: demand_tier
attributes.description: Demand classification tier from the Revenue Management System that this policy is calibrated for. Aligns with IDeaS G3 RMS and Infor EzRMS demand forecasting segments to enable yield optimization by demand level.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Demand Forecasting; Infor EzRMS Demand Forecasting; STR STAR Report benchmarking

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Calendar date from which this overbooking policy becomes active and enforceable in the Property Management System and Revenue Management System.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; IDeaS G3 RMS; USALI Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this overbooking policy ceases to be active. Null indicates an open-ended policy with no defined end date.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; IDeaS G3 RMS; USALI Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Most recent date on which this overbooking policy was formally reviewed by the revenue management team. Used to track compliance with the defined review frequency.
attributes.references: AHLA Revenue Management Best Practices; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: los_restriction_min
attributes.description: Minimum Length of Stay (LOS) in nights required for this overbooking policy to apply. Supports LOS-based yield optimization strategies in IDeaS G3 RMS. Null indicates no minimum LOS restriction.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Inventory Controls; Oracle OPERA PMS Rate Restrictions; USALI

attributes.name: loyalty_points_walk_bonus
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program bonus points awarded to walked guests as additional compensation under this policy. Integrates with Salesforce CRM Loyalty Management and the Loyalty domain for points fulfillment.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Loyalty Management; AHLA Loyalty Program Standards

attributes.name: loyalty_tier_exempt
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of loyalty program tier codes (e.g., 'PLATINUM,DIAMOND') whose members are exempt from being walked under this policy. Integrates with Salesforce CRM Loyalty Management.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Loyalty Management; AHLA Loyalty Program Standards

attributes.name: min_overbooking_pct
attributes.description: Minimum overbooking level as a percentage below which the revenue management system should alert or auto-adjust. Supports dynamic overbooking optimization in IDeaS G3 RMS to prevent under-selling.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Inventory Controls; Infor EzRMS Revenue Strategy

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal review of this overbooking policy by the revenue management team. Drives workflow alerts in the Revenue Management System.
attributes.references: AHLA Revenue Management Best Practices; IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS

attributes.name: no_show_rate_assumption_pct
attributes.description: Historical or forecast no-show rate percentage used as the actuarial basis for setting the overbooking level. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS historical data and IDeaS G3 RMS forecasting models.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Forecasting; Oracle OPERA PMS; USALI

attributes.name: overbooking_cap
attributes.description: Maximum absolute number of rooms that may be overbooked above physical inventory, regardless of the overbooking percentage. Acts as a hard ceiling to limit walk exposure. Enforced in Oracle OPERA PMS inventory controls.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Inventory Controls; IDeaS G3 RMS; AHLA Overbooking Standards

attributes.name: overbooking_pct
attributes.description: Maximum authorized overbooking level expressed as a percentage above the physical room inventory for the applicable room type (e.g., 5.00 = 5% above capacity). Core yield optimization parameter managed in IDeaS G3 RMS and enforced in OPERA PMS inventory controls.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Inventory Controls; AHLA Overbooking Best Practices; USALI

attributes.name: pms_rule_code
attributes.description: Oracle OPERA PMS inventory control rule code corresponding to this overbooking policy. Used for reconciliation between the lakehouse and the operational PMS configuration.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Inventory Controls; HTNG (AHLA Technology) Integration Standards

attributes.name: policy_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for revenue management team annotations, special conditions, or contextual notes about this overbooking policy (e.g., 'Applies during citywide convention periods only', 'Reviewed post-Q3 STR STAR Report').
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; IDeaS G3 RMS; AHLA Revenue Management Best Practices

attributes.name: policy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the overbooking policy. 'active' means the policy is enforced in OPERA PMS and IDeaS G3 RMS. 'draft' indicates pending approval. 'suspended' means temporarily disabled. 'archived' means retired from use.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; IDeaS G3 RMS Inventory Controls

attributes.name: policy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the overbooking policy by reservation segment. 'standard' applies to general transient bookings. 'dynamic' indicates IDeaS G3 RMS auto-adjusts levels. 'group' applies to group blocks. 'guaranteed' applies to guaranteed reservation types only.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Oracle OPERA PMS; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: rate_plan_scope
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of rate plan codes (BAR, NRR, LRA, corporate, etc.) to which this overbooking policy applies. Null indicates the policy applies to all rate plans. Aligns with Sabre SynXis CRS rate distribution configuration.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Rate Distribution; Oracle OPERA PMS; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: review_frequency
attributes.description: Scheduled frequency at which this overbooking policy is reviewed and potentially recalibrated by the revenue management team. Supports governance and continuous optimization of overbooking levels.
attributes.references: AHLA Revenue Management Best Practices; IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS

attributes.name: rms_policy_reference
attributes.description: Native policy identifier or rule code as stored in IDeaS G3 RMS or Infor EzRMS. Enables direct cross-system traceability between the lakehouse Silver Layer record and the source RMS configuration.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Inventory Controls; Infor EzRMS Revenue Strategy

attributes.name: room_type_code
attributes.description: OPERA PMS room type code to which this overbooking policy applies (e.g., 'KING', 'DBLQ', 'SUITE'). A null or wildcard value indicates the policy applies to all room types at the property.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Room Type Configuration; AHLA Room Classification Standards

attributes.name: season_code
attributes.description: Revenue management season classification code (e.g., 'PEAK', 'SHOULDER', 'OFF') that scopes this overbooking policy. Aligns with IDeaS G3 RMS demand forecasting season definitions.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Demand Forecasting; Infor EzRMS Revenue Strategy

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this overbooking policy record was most recently modified, recorded in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and Silver Layer incremental processing.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: vip_reservation_exempt
attributes.description: Indicates whether VIP-flagged reservations (loyalty elite, corporate VIP, celebrity) are excluded from walk eligibility under this policy. True = VIP reservations are protected from walk. Integrates with Salesforce CRM guest profiles.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profiles; Salesforce CRM; AHLA Guest Experience Standards

attributes.name: walk_alert_threshold
attributes.description: Number of overbooked rooms at which the system triggers an alert to the front desk and revenue management team to initiate proactive walk management. Configured in Oracle OPERA PMS.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Front Desk Operations; AHLA Walk Policy Standards

attributes.name: walk_compensation_amount
attributes.description: Monetary compensation amount authorized for walked guests under this policy, expressed in the property's operating currency. Applicable when walk_policy_type is 'cash_compensation' or 'voucher'. Governed by AHLA walk policy standards.
attributes.references: AHLA Walk Policy Standards; Oracle OPERA PMS Cashiering; USALI

attributes.name: walk_compensation_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the walk compensation amount (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). Required for multi-currency property portfolios.

attributes.name: walk_policy_type
attributes.description: Type of compensation offered to guests who are walked (relocated) due to overbooking. 'comp_room' = complimentary room at partner hotel. 'cash_compensation' = monetary payment. 'upgrade' = room upgrade if available. 'partner_hotel' = relocation to contracted partner property. 'voucher' = future stay voucher. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: comp_room|cash_compensation|upgrade|partner_hotel|voucher|loyalty_points|transport_voucher — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; AHLA Walk Policy Standards; ADA Accessibility Compliance

attributes.name: walk_transport_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether complimentary transportation to the partner hotel is included in the walk compensation package under this policy. True = transportation is provided at property expense.
attributes.references: AHLA Walk Policy Standards; Oracle OPERA PMS

products.name: revenue_budget
products.description: Revenue planning, strategy, and budget records combining strategic revenue targets with financial budget commitments at the property and market segment level, aligned to USALI standards. Captures planning period, property, strategy type (transient, group, total revenue), target and budgeted ADR/occupancy/RevPAR/TRevPAR, budgeted room revenue, key tactical actions and strategic initiatives, budget version (original, revised, reforecast), strategy status (draft, approved, active), planning horizon, and approving revenue director. This is the SSOT for all revenue planning governance — both strategic direction and financial targets — used for variance analysis against actuals in the DOR, management reporting, owner presentations, and strategic revenue governance.

attributes.name: revenue_budget_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each revenue budget record. Primary key for the revenue_budget data product in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: budgeted_fnb_outlet_id

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.name: employee_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to event.event_booking. Business justification: Budget planning incorporates known definite event bookings as committed revenue for fiscal period forecasting. Required for budget vs actual variance analysis with event segmentation and MICE revenue

attributes.name: finance_budget_id

attributes.name: market_segment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the market segment (e.g., transient leisure, transient corporate, group, wholesale, OTA) for which this budget is defined. Enables segment-level revenue planning and variance analysis.

attributes.name: profit_center_id

attributes.name: property_id
