attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the revenue director formally approved this budget version. Marks the transition from 'draft' to 'approved' strategy status.

attributes.name: budgeted_available_rooms
attributes.description: Total number of room-nights planned to be available for sale during the planning period (capacity baseline). Used as the denominator for RevPAR, TRevPAR, and GOPPAR calculations and STR STAR Report benchmarking.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report; USALI; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: budgeted_cpor
attributes.description: Budgeted Cost Per Occupied Room (CPOR) in the property's operating currency, representing the planned direct operating cost per occupied room night. Used for profitability planning and variance analysis against actuals.

attributes.name: budgeted_events_revenue
attributes.description: Total budgeted revenue from Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, and Exhibitions (MICE) and event spaces for the planning period. Supports TRevPAR planning and event sales governance in Delphi by Amadeus.
attributes.references: USALI; Delphi by Amadeus; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: budgeted_fb_revenue
attributes.description: Total budgeted Food and Beverage (F&B) revenue in the property's operating currency for the planning period. Supports TRevPAR planning and USALI departmental revenue reporting.
attributes.references: USALI; Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: budgeted_gop
attributes.description: Budgeted Gross Operating Profit (GOP) in the property's operating currency for the planning period, per USALI departmental and undistributed expense structure. Used for GOPPAR derivation and owner NOI reporting.

attributes.name: budgeted_occupied_rooms
attributes.description: Total number of room-nights planned to be occupied (sold) during the planning period. Derived from budgeted available rooms × target OCC, stored as a planning target for demand forecasting and group block management.
attributes.references: USALI; IDeaS G3 RMS; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: budgeted_other_revenue
attributes.description: Total budgeted ancillary revenue (spa, parking, resort fees, retail, etc.) in the property's operating currency for the planning period. Completes the TRevPAR revenue stack beyond rooms, F&B, and events.

attributes.name: budgeted_room_revenue
attributes.description: Total budgeted room revenue (in operating currency) for the planning period and market segment. The primary monetary commitment in the revenue budget, used for variance analysis against actuals in the DOR and management reporting. Classified confidential as a strategic financial target.

attributes.name: budgeted_total_revenue
attributes.description: Aggregate budgeted total revenue across all revenue streams (rooms + F&B + events + other) in the property's operating currency for the planning period. The top-line financial commitment used in owner presentations and EBITDA planning.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this revenue budget record was first created in the lakehouse Silver Layer. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX financial controls compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this budget record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Ensures consistent multi-currency reporting across global properties.

attributes.name: demand_forecast_source
attributes.description: Identifies the system or method used to generate the demand forecast underpinning this budget: 'IDeaS_G3' (IDeaS G3 RMS automated forecast), 'Infor_EzRMS' (Infor EzRMS forecast), 'manual' (revenue manager manual input), or 'hybrid' (combination). Supports data lineage and forecast accuracy tracking.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal month or period number (1–12) within the fiscal year for monthly budget granularity. Supports period-level variance analysis in the DOR and management reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this revenue budget belongs (e.g., 2025). Aligns with the property's USALI-compliant financial reporting calendar and SAP S/4HANA GL fiscal periods.

attributes.name: is_owner_approved
attributes.description: Indicates whether this budget has received formal approval from the property owner or ownership group (True = owner-approved; False = pending or not required). Relevant for managed properties where owner sign-off is contractually required.

attributes.name: key_tactical_actions
attributes.description: Free-text description of the near-term tactical revenue actions planned for this budget period (e.g., BAR adjustments, LRA controls, OTA channel mix shifts, promotional rate activations). Captured from the revenue strategy narrative in IDeaS G3 RMS and Infor EzRMS.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, assumptions, or commentary associated with this revenue budget record (e.g., macro-economic assumptions, renovation impact adjustments, force majeure notes). Supports management reporting and audit documentation.

attributes.name: planning_horizon_type
attributes.description: Granularity of the planning horizon for this budget record: 'annual' (full-year plan), 'quarterly' (90-day rolling), 'monthly' (period-level), or 'weekly' (short-term tactical). Determines the reporting cadence for variance analysis.

attributes.name: planning_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the planning horizon covered by this revenue budget (e.g., 2025-12-31 for an annual plan). Defines the effective end of the budget period.

attributes.name: planning_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the planning horizon covered by this revenue budget (e.g., 2025-01-01 for an annual plan). Defines the effective start of the budget period for variance tracking against actuals.

attributes.name: property_segment
attributes.description: Brand/service tier of the property for which this budget applies: 'luxury', 'premium', 'select_service', or 'extended_stay'. Enables cross-segment benchmarking and portfolio-level revenue governance.
attributes.references: AHLA (American Hotel and Lodging Association); STR STAR Report

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for this budget record, used in management reports, owner presentations, and cross-system references (e.g., SAP S/4HANA GL budget entries). Format: RB-{PropertyCode}-{Year}.

attributes.name: strategic_initiatives
attributes.description: Free-text description of longer-horizon strategic revenue initiatives included in this budget (e.g., loyalty program rate strategy, new OTA partnership, dynamic pricing rule (DRR) rollout, group business development targets). Supports owner presentations and management reporting.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: strategy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this revenue budget and strategy record. 'draft' = under preparation; 'approved' = signed off by revenue director; 'active' = in-period execution; 'superseded' = replaced by a newer version; 'archived' = closed period record.

attributes.name: strategy_type
attributes.description: Classifies the revenue strategy scope covered by this budget: 'transient' (FIT/BAR-driven room revenue), 'group' (MICE and group block revenue), 'total_revenue' (TRevPAR-level all-revenue planning), 'food_and_beverage' (F&B revenue plan), 'events' (event/conference revenue), or 'other'. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: transient|group|total_revenue|food_and_beverage|events|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USALI; IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which this budget version was formally submitted for review and approval. Used for governance tracking and audit trail in owner presentations and management reporting.

attributes.name: target_adr
attributes.description: Budgeted Average Daily Rate (ADR) in the property's operating currency for the planning period. Represents the planned average revenue earned per occupied room per night. Core revenue KPI used in STR STAR Report, RGI, and MPI benchmarking.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report; USALI; IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS

attributes.name: target_alos
attributes.description: Budgeted Average Length of Stay (ALOS) in nights for the planning period and market segment. Supports LOS-based pricing strategy, minimum stay restrictions, and demand pattern planning in IDeaS G3 RMS.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; USALI

attributes.name: target_ari
attributes.description: Budgeted Average Rate Index (ARI) target, representing the property's planned ADR performance relative to its STR competitive set (property ADR / comp set ADR). Supports rate strategy and competitive positioning planning.

attributes.name: target_goppar
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Gross Operating Profit Per Available Room (GOPPAR)
attributes.description: Budgeted Gross Operating Profit Per Available Room (GOPPAR) in the property's operating currency. Represents the profitability target per available room after operating expenses, used in owner presentations and GOP governance.

tag_set.value: Target Gross Operating Profit Per Available Room (GOPPAR)

attributes.name: target_mpi
attributes.description: Budgeted Market Penetration Index (MPI) target, representing the property's planned occupancy performance relative to its STR competitive set (property OCC / comp set OCC). Supports competitive benchmarking strategy.

attributes.name: target_occupancy_rate
attributes.description: Budgeted occupancy rate (OCC) expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00) for the planning period. Represents the planned proportion of available rooms expected to be sold. Core KPI input for RevPAR calculation and STR STAR Report benchmarking.
attributes.references: STR (Smith Travel Research) STAR Report; USALI; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: target_revpar
attributes.description: Budgeted Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR) in the property's operating currency for the planning period. Calculated as ADR × OCC but stored as a strategic target for direct comparison against actuals and STR competitive set benchmarks (RGI).
attributes.references: STR STAR Report; USALI; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: target_rgi
attributes.description: Budgeted Revenue Generation Index (RGI) target, representing the property's planned RevPAR performance relative to its STR competitive set (property RevPAR / comp set RevPAR). RGI > 1.0 indicates planned market share gain.

attributes.name: target_trevpar
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Total Revenue Per Available Room (TRevPAR)
attributes.description: Budgeted Total Revenue Per Available Room (TRevPAR) in the property's operating currency, encompassing all revenue streams (rooms, F&B, events, spa, parking, etc.) per available room. Supports total revenue strategy planning beyond rooms-only RevPAR.
attributes.references: USALI; IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS

tag_set.value: Target Total Revenue Per Available Room (TRevPAR)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this revenue budget record was most recently modified. Tracks version changes, reforecast updates, and approval workflow transitions for audit and governance purposes.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Indicates the iteration of this budget record: 'original' (initial annual plan), 'revised' (mid-year adjustment), or 'reforecast' (rolling forecast update). Supports version-controlled variance analysis in the Daily Operations Report (DOR) and management reporting.

products.name: channel_contribution
products.description: Transactional records measuring revenue contribution by distribution channel (OTA, GDS, direct web, voice, corporate, wholesale) per property and stay period. Captures channel type, booking volume, room nights, gross revenue, net revenue after commission, average commission rate, cost per booking (CPA), and channel mix percentage. Supports channel optimization and OTA partnership management decisions.

attributes.name: channel_contribution_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each channel contribution record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this transactional summary entity. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — represents a discrete revenue contribution measurement event per distribution channel, property, and reporting period.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: analyzed_fnb_outlet_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fnb.fnb_outlet. Business justification: Channel analysis includes F&B attachment rates by booking source (OTA guests vs direct = different outlet usage). Required for channel profitability analysis, package optimization, outlet marketing st

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Channel performance reports must attribute bookings/revenue to the marketing campaigns that drove traffic to each channel. This is core marketing ROI measurement and enables campaign-level profitabili

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution channel master record (e.g., OTA, GDS, direct web, voice, corporate, wholesale). Used to join channel-level attributes such as channel name, partner agreement, and commission tier.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS; HTNG (Hotel Technology Next Generation)

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Channel revenue and distribution costs are tracked by cost center for departmental P&L, channel profitability analysis, and USALI departmental reporting.

attributes.name: ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger. Business justification: Channel revenue and distribution costs post to specific GL accounts for financial statement preparation, commission expense tracking, and revenue net of distribution reporting.

attributes.name: loyalty_member_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.member_segment. Business justification: Channel performance analysis by loyalty segment reveals segment-specific booking behavior and channel preferences. Business process: segment-level channel effectiveness reporting for optimizing distri

attributes.name: market_segment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the market segment associated with bookings through this channel (e.g., transient leisure, corporate, group, wholesale). Supports revenue management segmentation analysis.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Channel performance rolls up to profit centers for consolidated reporting, ownership reporting, and portfolio-level channel strategy evaluation.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the hotel or resort property for which channel contribution is being measured. Enables property-level channel mix analysis and OTA partnership management decisions.

attributes.name: revenue_rate_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.revenue_rate_plan. Business justification: Channel contribution analysis is segmented by rate plan. channel_contribution has rate_plan_code (STRING) which should be normalized to FK to revenue_rate_plan. N channel_contribution records → 1 reve

attributes.name: adr
attributes.description: Average Daily Rate achieved through this distribution channel during the reporting period, calculated as gross room revenue divided by rooms sold. Industry-standard KPI per STR STAR Report methodology. Enables channel-level ADR benchmarking.
attributes.references: STR (Smith Travel Research) STAR Report; USALI; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: advance_booking_days
attributes.description: Average number of days in advance that reservations were made through this channel (booking lead time). Measures booking pace by channel and informs dynamic pricing and rate restriction strategies in the Revenue Management System.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: alos
attributes.description: Average Length of Stay (ALOS) in nights for bookings originating from this distribution channel during the reporting period. Calculated as total room nights divided by booking volume. Informs LOS (Length of Stay) restriction strategies in the RMS.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; USALI; STR STAR Report

attributes.name: booking_volume
attributes.description: Total number of confirmed reservations received through this distribution channel during the reporting period. Core metric for channel productivity analysis and OTA partnership evaluation.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS; IDeaS G3 RMS; USALI

attributes.name: business_date
attributes.description: The principal operational business date on which this channel contribution record was generated or posted, as defined by the Property Management System (PMS) business date. Distinct from audit timestamps; used for daily operations reporting (DOR) and period-end reconciliation.

attributes.name: cancellation_count
attributes.description: Total number of reservations cancelled through this distribution channel during the reporting period. Used to calculate channel-level cancellation rate and assess OTA cancellation policy impact on revenue.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; USALI

attributes.name: cancellation_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of total bookings through this channel that were cancelled during the reporting period (cancellation_count / booking_volume * 100). High cancellation rates from OTA channels impact revenue predictability and yield optimization.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Oracle OPERA PMS; USALI

attributes.name: channel_mix_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of total property booking volume or room nights attributable to this distribution channel during the reporting period. Measures channel contribution to overall distribution mix. Used for channel optimization strategy and OTA dependency analysis.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; USALI

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Classification of the distribution channel through which bookings were made. OTA (Online Travel Agency) includes Expedia, Booking.com; GDS (Global Distribution System) includes Sabre, Amadeus; direct_web is brand.com; voice is call center; corporate is negotiated accounts; wholesale is tour operators and bed banks. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: OTA|GDS|direct_web|voice|corporate|wholesale|metasearch|loyalty_redemption — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS; HTNG; AHLA (American Hotel and Lodging Association)

attributes.name: commission_amount
attributes.description: Total commission or distribution fee paid to the channel partner (OTA, GDS, travel agent) for bookings during the reporting period. Deducted from gross revenue to derive net revenue. Critical for channel cost analysis and OTA contract management.
attributes.references: USALI; SAP S/4HANA Finance AP; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: commission_rate_pct
attributes.description: Average commission rate (as a percentage of gross revenue) paid to the channel partner during the reporting period. Calculated as commission_amount / gross_revenue * 100. Used to benchmark OTA commission costs and negotiate channel agreements.
attributes.references: USALI; AHLA; SAP S/4HANA Finance AP

attributes.name: contribution_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of the channel contribution record. 'draft' indicates preliminary data; 'confirmed' indicates validated and finalized; 'adjusted' indicates post-close corrections applied; 'closed' indicates period locked; 'cancelled' indicates record voided.

attributes.name: cost_per_booking
attributes.description: Total distribution cost per confirmed booking through this channel, including commissions, GDS transaction fees, and incremental booking costs. Also known as Cost Per Acquisition (CPA). Key metric for channel ROI analysis and OTA partnership management.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency operations across global properties and ensures financial reporting compliance.

attributes.name: data_extract_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when data was extracted from the source operational system (OPERA PMS, SynXis CRS, or IDeaS G3 RMS) for loading into the Databricks Silver Layer. Used for data freshness monitoring and SLA compliance tracking.

attributes.name: gds_transaction_fees
attributes.description: Total GDS (Global Distribution System) per-transaction fees incurred for bookings processed through GDS channels (Sabre, Amadeus, Travelport) during the reporting period. Applicable only to GDS channel type; zero for non-GDS channels. Included in total distribution cost.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS; USALI; SAP S/4HANA Finance AP

attributes.name: gross_revenue
attributes.description: Total gross room revenue generated through this distribution channel before deducting commissions, OTA fees, or GDS transaction fees. Represents the full rack or negotiated rate charged to guests. Used in ADR and RevPAR calculations per USALI standards.
attributes.references: USALI; IFRS/GAAP; SAP S/4HANA Finance GL

attributes.name: is_direct_channel
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is a direct booking channel (brand.com, loyalty app, call center, walk-in). Direct channels carry zero or minimal commission cost. Used to track direct booking share as a KPI for reducing OTA dependency.
attributes.references: AHLA; Sabre SynXis CRS; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: is_ota_channel
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is Online Travel Agency (OTA) Channel Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this distribution channel is an Online Travel Agency (OTA) such as Expedia or Booking.com. Enables quick segmentation of OTA vs. non-OTA channels for commission cost analysis and direct booking strategy reporting.

tag_set.value: Is Online Travel Agency (OTA) Channel Flag

attributes.name: loyalty_bookings_count
attributes.description: Number of bookings through this channel made by loyalty program members during the reporting period. Tracks loyalty member channel preference and supports direct booking incentive strategies to reduce OTA dependency.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Oracle OPERA PMS; AHLA

attributes.name: net_revenue
attributes.description: Net room revenue retained by the property after deducting all channel commissions and distribution fees from gross revenue. Primary metric for evaluating true channel profitability and informing channel mix optimization decisions.
attributes.references: USALI; IFRS/GAAP; SAP S/4HANA Finance GL

attributes.name: no_show_count
attributes.description: Total number of reservations from this channel where the guest did not arrive and did not cancel. No-shows impact revenue recovery and are tracked per channel to assess booking quality and enforce no-show policies.

attributes.name: nrr_bookings_count
attributes.description: Number of bookings made at Non-Refundable Rate (NRR) through this channel during the reporting period. NRR bookings provide revenue certainty and reduce cancellation risk. Used to assess channel-level rate plan mix.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Oracle OPERA PMS; USALI

attributes.name: occupancy_pct
attributes.description: Occupancy rate (OCC) attributable to this distribution channel, expressed as a percentage of available rooms occupied by channel-sourced bookings. Supports channel-level yield analysis and demand forecasting integration with IDeaS G3 RMS.
attributes.references: STR (Smith Travel Research) STAR Report; USALI; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this channel contribution record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements per SOX and GDPR compliance.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this channel contribution record was last modified. Tracks adjustments, restatements, or corrections to channel revenue data. Required for SOX financial controls.

attributes.name: reporting_granularity
attributes.description: Time granularity at which this channel contribution record is aggregated. 'daily' for day-level DOR reporting; 'weekly' for pace analysis; 'monthly' for USALI period reporting; 'quarterly' for STR STAR Report benchmarking.
attributes.references: USALI; STR (Smith Travel Research) STAR Report; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: reporting_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the reporting period (stay date range) for which channel contribution metrics are aggregated. Together with reporting_period_start_date defines the measurement window.
attributes.references: USALI; STR (Smith Travel Research) STAR Report

attributes.name: reporting_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the reporting period (stay date range) for which channel contribution metrics are aggregated. Used to define the measurement window for ADR, RevPAR, and channel mix analysis.
attributes.references: USALI; STR (Smith Travel Research) STAR Report

attributes.name: revenue_net_of_distribution
attributes.business_glossary_term: Revenue Net of Total Distribution Cost
attributes.description: Net revenue after deducting all distribution costs (commissions, GDS fees, OTA fees) from gross revenue. Represents the true retained revenue contribution of the channel. Supports channel profitability ranking and optimization decisions.
attributes.references: USALI; IFRS/GAAP; SAP S/4HANA Finance GL

tag_set.value: Revenue Net of Total Distribution Cost

attributes.name: revpar
attributes.description: Revenue Per Available Room contributed by this channel, calculated as channel gross revenue divided by total available rooms for the reporting period. Core yield optimization metric per STR STAR Report and USALI standards.
attributes.references: STR (Smith Travel Research) STAR Report; USALI; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: rgi
attributes.description: Revenue Generation Index (RGI) attributable to this channel, measuring the property's RevPAR performance relative to the competitive set for channel-sourced bookings. RGI > 1.0 indicates above-market performance. Sourced from STR STAR Report and Infor EzRMS.
attributes.references: STR (Smith Travel Research) STAR Report; Infor EzRMS; USALI

attributes.name: room_nights
attributes.description: Total number of room nights generated by bookings through this channel during the reporting period. A room night equals one room occupied for one night. Fundamental input for occupancy rate (OCC) and RevPAR calculations.
attributes.references: STR (Smith Travel Research) STAR Report; USALI; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: total_distribution_cost
attributes.description: Total all-in cost of distributing inventory through this channel, including commissions, GDS transaction fees, OTA merchant model costs, and any incremental booking fees. Used to calculate net channel profitability and CPOR (Cost Per Occupied Room) by channel.

products.name: displacement_analysis
products.description: Displacement analysis records evaluating the revenue opportunity cost of accepting group or contract business versus holding inventory for higher-rated transient demand. Captures analysis date, stay dates, room block size, proposed rate, estimated transient displacement rooms, estimated transient ADR displaced, net revenue impact, total spend analysis (rooms + F&B + ancillary), and recommendation outcome. Generated by IDeaS G3 RMS group evaluation module.

attributes.name: displacement_analysis_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each displacement analysis record. Primary key for the displacement_analysis data product in the revenue domain Silver layer.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: banquet_event_order_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Related Banquet Event Order Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fnb.banquet_event_order. Business justification: Displacement calculations include banquet F&B revenue to offset room revenue displacement from group blocks. Required for group profitability analysis, acceptance decisions, total property revenue opt

tag_set.value: Related Banquet Event Order Id (Foreign Key)

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: When evaluating group blocks during high-demand periods driven by marketing campaigns, revenue managers need campaign context to assess true displacement cost and whether to accept group business.

attributes.name: demand_forecast_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the demand forecast record used as the basis for transient displacement estimates in this analysis. Links to the revenue.demand_forecast product.

attributes.name: guest_group_block_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to guest.guest_group_block. Business justification: Displacement analysis quantifies revenue impact of accepting specific guest group blocks. Revenue managers calculate transient displacement cost, net contribution, and RevPAR impact for each guest.gue

attributes.name: ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger. Business justification: Displacement decisions impact revenue recognition and require GL posting for group vs transient revenue tracking, profitability analysis, and revenue mix reporting.

attributes.name: market_segment_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the market segment associated with the group or contract business being evaluated (e.g., MICE, corporate group, leisure group). Drives segmentation in revenue reporting.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the hotel or resort property for which the displacement analysis is being conducted. Links to the property master record.

attributes.name: revenue_rate_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the proposed rate plan associated with the group or contract business being evaluated. Used to assess the proposed rate against transient BAR (Best Available Rate).
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: analysis_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the displacement analysis was performed by the Revenue Management System or revenue manager. Represents the principal business event date for this record.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Group Evaluation Module

attributes.name: analysis_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the displacement analysis, typically generated by IDeaS G3 RMS group evaluation module (e.g., 'DISP-2024-00123'). Used for cross-system traceability and revenue manager communication.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Group Evaluation Module

attributes.name: analysis_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the displacement analysis record. 'draft' indicates in-progress; 'pending_review' awaits revenue manager sign-off; 'approved' or 'rejected' reflects final decision; 'superseded' indicates a newer analysis replaced this one.

attributes.name: analysis_type
attributes.description: Classification of the type of business being evaluated for displacement. Distinguishes between group room blocks, long-stay contracts, tour operator allotments, and wholesale agreements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: group_evaluation|contract_evaluation|tour_operator|wholesale|corporate_negotiated|government — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: ancillary_revenue_contribution
attributes.description: Estimated ancillary revenue contribution from the group if accepted, including spa, parking, audio-visual, and other non-room, non-F&B spend. Supports total spend analysis for TRevPAR (Total Revenue Per Available Room) evaluation.

attributes.name: channel_source
attributes.description: Distribution channel through which the group or contract inquiry originated (e.g., direct sales, GDS (Global Distribution System), OTA (Online Travel Agency), Delphi event sales). Informs channel cost considerations in the displacement calculation.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS; Delphi by Amadeus; AHLA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the displacement analysis record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to all monetary amounts in this displacement analysis record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: decision_rationale
attributes.description: Free-text narrative explaining the revenue manager's reasoning behind the recommendation outcome, including demand conditions, competitive context, or strategic considerations not captured in quantitative fields.

attributes.name: displacement_risk_level
attributes.description: Categorical risk rating assigned to the displacement analysis indicating the severity of transient revenue displacement if the group is accepted. Derived from net_revenue_impact and forecast_occupancy_pct thresholds configured in IDeaS G3 RMS.

attributes.name: estimated_transient_adr_displaced
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Transient Average Daily Rate (ADR) Displaced
attributes.description: Estimated average per-room per-night rate that transient guests would have paid for the same rooms and dates, as forecast by IDeaS G3 RMS. Core metric for measuring revenue opportunity cost of accepting group business.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; STR STAR Report; USALI

tag_set.value: Estimated Transient Average Daily Rate (ADR) Displaced

attributes.name: estimated_transient_rooms_displaced
attributes.description: Estimated number of transient room-nights that would be displaced (lost) if the group block is accepted. Derived from IDeaS G3 RMS demand forecast for the stay period.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Group Evaluation Module

attributes.name: fb_revenue_contribution
attributes.description: Estimated Food and Beverage (F&B) revenue contribution from the group if accepted, including banquet, catering, and outlet spend. Part of the total spend analysis supporting TRevPAR-based evaluation.
attributes.references: Delphi by Amadeus; Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS; USALI

attributes.name: forecast_occupancy_pct
attributes.description: Projected occupancy percentage (OCC) for the property during the stay period at the time of analysis, as sourced from the demand forecast. Contextualizes the displacement risk — high OCC increases displacement cost.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; STR STAR Report; USALI

attributes.name: group_room_revenue
attributes.description: Total projected room revenue from the group block if accepted, calculated as proposed_group_rate × room_block_size × los_nights. Represents the revenue inflow side of the displacement equation.

attributes.name: is_peak_period
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stay dates fall within a designated peak demand period (e.g., major events, holidays, high-season). Peak periods carry higher displacement risk and typically require higher minimum acceptable rates.

attributes.name: is_special_event
attributes.description: Indicates whether a special event (concert, convention, sporting event, etc.) is occurring in the market during the stay period, which may elevate transient demand and increase displacement cost.

attributes.name: los_nights
attributes.description: Total number of nights in the proposed group stay period (LOS). Calculated as stay_date_to minus stay_date_from. Used in yield optimization and LOS restriction analysis.

attributes.name: min_acceptable_rate
attributes.description: The minimum per-room per-night rate at which accepting the group block would be revenue-neutral or accretive, as calculated by the displacement model. Used by sales teams as a negotiation floor.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Group Evaluation Module; AHLA

attributes.name: net_revenue_impact
attributes.description: Net revenue impact of accepting the group business, calculated as total_group_spend minus transient_room_revenue_displaced. A positive value indicates the group is accretive; negative indicates displacement loss exceeds group gain.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Group Evaluation Module; USALI

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or commentary entered by the revenue manager regarding special circumstances, negotiation history, or strategic context not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: proposed_group_rate
attributes.description: The proposed per-room per-night rate offered to the group or contract client. Compared against estimated transient ADR (Average Daily Rate) to determine revenue opportunity cost.

attributes.name: recommendation_outcome
attributes.description: Revenue management recommendation resulting from the displacement analysis. 'accept' indicates the group is revenue-positive; 'reject' indicates displacement loss exceeds group value; 'accept_with_conditions' requires rate or block size negotiation; 'defer' awaits further demand data; 'counter_offer' proposes alternative terms.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Group Evaluation Module; AHLA

attributes.name: reviewed_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the revenue manager or director who reviewed and acted upon the displacement analysis recommendation. Supports accountability and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: reviewed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the revenue manager completed their review and recorded the final recommendation outcome. Distinct from created_timestamp and updated_timestamp; represents the business decision event time.

attributes.name: revpar_impact
attributes.description: Estimated change in RevPAR (Revenue Per Available Room) attributable to accepting the group block, expressed as a positive or negative dollar amount per available room. Key KPI for revenue management decision-making.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; STR STAR Report; USALI

attributes.name: rms_evaluation_reference
attributes.description: Native evaluation or job identifier assigned by IDeaS G3 RMS when the group evaluation was executed. Enables traceability back to the source system run for audit and re-evaluation purposes.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Group Evaluation Module

attributes.name: room_block_size
attributes.description: Total number of rooms in the proposed group or contract room block being evaluated for displacement impact. Core input to the displacement calculation.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Group Evaluation Module; Delphi by Amadeus

attributes.name: room_type_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the room type or category requested in the group block (e.g., STD, DLX, STE). Used to assess displacement impact at the room-type level.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: special_event_name
attributes.description: Name or description of the special event influencing demand during the stay period, when is_special_event is true. Provides context for the displacement risk assessment.

attributes.name: stay_date_from
attributes.description: First night of the proposed group or contract stay period being evaluated. Defines the start of the displacement window for transient demand comparison.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: stay_date_to
attributes.description: Last night of the proposed group or contract stay period being evaluated. Defines the end of the displacement window for transient demand comparison.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: total_group_spend
attributes.description: Total estimated revenue from the group across all revenue streams (rooms + F&B + ancillary). Used as the numerator in the full displacement value comparison to support TRevPAR-based decision-making.

attributes.name: transient_room_revenue_displaced
attributes.description: Total estimated transient room revenue that would be lost if the group block is accepted, calculated as estimated_transient_adr_displaced × estimated_transient_rooms_displaced × los_nights. Represents the revenue opportunity cost.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; USALI; STR STAR Report

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the displacement analysis record was last modified. Tracks revisions made by revenue managers or automated RMS re-evaluations.

products.name: revenue_negotiated_rate
products.description: Corporate and wholesale negotiated rate agreements defining contracted pricing for specific accounts, travel management companies (TMCs), and consortia. Captures account identifier, rate code, negotiated rate amount, LRA (Last Room Availability) obligation, blackout dates, minimum night commitment, contract period, and rate loading status in Sabre SynXis CRS and Oracle OPERA PMS. Distinct from public rate plans — these are account-specific contracted rates.

attributes.name: revenue_negotiated_rate_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the negotiated rate agreement record in the lakehouse Silver layer. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: HTNG Data Dictionary; Oracle OPERA PMS Rate Management

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to event.event_account. Business justification: Negotiated rates are contracted with specific event accounts (corporate, consortia, national accounts). Essential for contract rate management, event planner rate loading, and account-specific pricing

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Negotiated corporate rates are sometimes created as part of B2B marketing campaigns. Tracking the originating campaign supports contract performance analysis and measures campaign success in driving c

attributes.name: distribution_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel. Business justification: Corporate negotiated rates are loaded to specific channels (GDS with specific chain codes, OTA corporate programs, direct booking engines). Rate loading and distribution tracking requires knowing whic

attributes.name: ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger. Business justification: Negotiated corporate rates post to specific GL accounts for contract revenue tracking, corporate account profitability analysis, and revenue recognition compliance.

attributes.name: market_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.market_segment. Business justification: Negotiated rates are classified by market segment (e.g., Corporate, Wholesale). revenue_negotiated_rate has market_segment_code (STRING) which should be normalized to FK. N negotiated_rate records → 1

attributes.name: minimum_loyalty_tier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.tier. Business justification: Corporate negotiated rates often include tier-based eligibility or enhanced benefits. Business process: enforcing tier requirements for corporate rate access, common in negotiated contracts that offer

attributes.name: negotiated_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Sales/revenue managers negotiate corporate rates; contract owner tracking required for renewal workflow management, commission attribution, and performance evaluation of negotiated rate portfolio mana

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.policy. Business justification: Corporate negotiated rates must comply with anti-discrimination and contract policies. Contract approval process validates policy compliance before rate activation. Essential for corporate rate govern

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property for which this negotiated rate agreement applies. A single negotiated rate may be scoped to one property or replicated per property for multi-property contracts.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; USALI Property Segmentation

attributes.name: revenue_rate_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent rate plan definition under which this negotiated rate is structured. Links to the rate plan master in Sabre SynXis CRS or Oracle OPERA PMS.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Rate Plan; Oracle OPERA PMS Rate Configuration

attributes.name: room_type_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific room type to which this negotiated rate applies. Null if the rate applies to all room types under the agreement.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Room Type Configuration; HTNG Room Type Standards

attributes.name: advance_booking_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days in advance a reservation must be made to qualify for this negotiated rate. Zero indicates same-day booking is permitted.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Advance Purchase Rules; Sabre SynXis CRS Booking Window

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The contracted nightly room rate (Average Daily Rate) agreed upon for this account. Represents the fixed or base rate per room per night in the specified currency. Core pricing field for revenue management and contract compliance.
attributes.references: USALI ADR Definition; Oracle OPERA PMS Rate Amount; STR STAR Report ADR Benchmarking

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status for this negotiated rate agreement. Rates must be approved by revenue management leadership before loading into CRS/GDS channels.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; Oracle OPERA PMS Rate Approval Workflow; IDeaS G3 RMS Approval Process

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the revenue management leader or director who approved this negotiated rate agreement for distribution.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; Oracle OPERA PMS Audit Trail

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this negotiated rate agreement received final approval for loading and distribution.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; Oracle OPERA PMS Audit Trail

attributes.name: blackout_dates
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or date range expressions representing dates on which this negotiated rate is not available (e.g., peak demand periods, holidays, special events). Stored as a structured string; detailed blackout records are managed in the rate_restriction product.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Blackout Date Configuration; Sabre SynXis CRS Rate Availability; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: breakfast_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether breakfast is included in the negotiated rate. Affects F&B (Food and Beverage) revenue allocation and rate value proposition reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Package Configuration; USALI F&B Revenue Allocation

attributes.name: commission_pct
attributes.description: Commission percentage payable to the TMC, travel agency, or consortia for reservations booked under this negotiated rate. Expressed as a percentage of the negotiated rate amount.
attributes.references: IATA Commission Standards; AHLA Agency Commission Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA AP Commission Processing

attributes.name: committed_room_nights
attributes.description: Total number of room nights the account has committed to book under this negotiated rate agreement for the contract period. Basis for volume discount qualification and contract performance tracking.
attributes.references: AHLA Corporate Account Standards; Oracle OPERA PMS Production Tracking

attributes.name: consortia_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the travel consortia (e.g., Virtuoso, Signature, Ensemble, Internova) under which this negotiated rate is offered. Null for direct corporate accounts not affiliated with a consortia.
attributes.references: AHLA Consortia Rate Standards; Sabre SynXis CRS Consortia Configuration

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the negotiated rate agreement expires and the rate is no longer available for booking. Null for open-ended agreements. Aligns with the MASTER_AGREEMENT EFFECTIVE_UNTIL category.
attributes.references: USALI Contract Management; Oracle OPERA PMS Rate Expiry; IFRS/GAAP Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: contract_reference_number
attributes.description: External contract or agreement reference number assigned by the account, TMC, or legal department. Used for contract management, audit, and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SOX Contract Management Controls; SAP S/4HANA Contract Management; AHLA Contract Standards

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which the negotiated rate agreement becomes contractually binding and the rate is available for booking. Aligns with the MASTER_AGREEMENT EFFECTIVE_FROM category.
attributes.references: USALI Contract Management; Oracle OPERA PMS Rate Effective Date; IFRS/GAAP Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this negotiated rate record was first created in the source system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and GDPR/CCPA data lifecycle management.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity; SOX Audit Trail Requirements; CCPA

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the negotiated rate amount is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency property portfolios.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS/GAAP Multi-Currency Reporting

attributes.name: gds_chain_code
attributes.description: Two-letter GDS chain code used to identify the hotel brand/chain in Sabre, Amadeus, Galileo, and Worldspan for rate loading and distribution of this negotiated rate.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS GDS Configuration; HTNG GDS Standards; IATA GDS Chain Code Registry

attributes.name: iata_number
attributes.description: IATA-assigned numeric identifier for the Travel Management Company (TMC) or travel agency associated with this negotiated rate. Used for commission tracking and GDS rate access validation.
attributes.references: IATA Agency Identification Standards; Sabre SynXis CRS TMC Configuration

attributes.name: is_lra
attributes.description: Indicates whether this negotiated rate carries a Last Room Availability (LRA) obligation, requiring the property to honor the contracted rate as long as any room of the applicable type remains available, regardless of demand or yield management controls.
attributes.references: AHLA LRA Contract Standards; IDeaS G3 RMS LRA Configuration; Sabre SynXis CRS LRA Flag

attributes.name: is_non_refundable
attributes.description: Indicates whether reservations booked under this negotiated rate are non-refundable (NRR). Affects cancellation policy enforcement and revenue recognition timing.
attributes.references: AHLA Cancellation Policy Standards; Oracle OPERA PMS Cancellation Rules; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: max_los
attributes.description: Maximum number of consecutive nights allowed per reservation under this negotiated rate. Null if no upper limit is imposed.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS LOS Restrictions; Sabre SynXis CRS Stay Controls

attributes.name: min_los
attributes.description: Minimum number of consecutive nights required per reservation to qualify for this negotiated rate. Enforced at booking in Sabre SynXis CRS and Oracle OPERA PMS.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS LOS Restrictions; Sabre SynXis CRS Stay Controls; HTNG Rate Restriction Standards

attributes.name: min_night_commitment
attributes.description: Minimum number of room nights the account is contractually committed to consume during the contract period. Used for volume tracking and contract compliance reporting.
attributes.references: AHLA Corporate Account Contract Standards; Oracle OPERA PMS Volume Commitment

attributes.name: negotiation_owner
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the revenue manager or sales manager responsible for negotiating and managing this rate agreement. Used for accountability and performance tracking.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Owner; Oracle HCM Cloud Employee Reference

attributes.name: rate_bar_variance_pct
attributes.description: The percentage discount or premium of this negotiated rate relative to the Best Available Rate (BAR) at time of contract negotiation. Used by revenue management to assess rate competitiveness and yield impact.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS BAR Analysis; STR STAR Report ARI Benchmarking; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: rate_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric rate code used to identify and load this negotiated rate in Sabre SynXis CRS and Oracle OPERA PMS. This is the externally-known business identifier referenced in GDS/CRS rate loading and reservation transactions.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Rate Loading; Oracle OPERA PMS Rate Code Standards; HTNG Rate Distribution

attributes.name: rate_includes_tax
attributes.description: Indicates whether the negotiated rate amount is inclusive of applicable taxes. Critical for revenue recognition, financial reporting, and guest billing accuracy.
attributes.references: USALI Tax Accounting Standards; IFRS/GAAP Revenue Recognition; Oracle OPERA PMS Tax Configuration

attributes.name: rate_loaded_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the negotiated rate was successfully loaded into Sabre SynXis CRS and/or Oracle OPERA PMS for distribution. Null if loading has not yet occurred.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Audit Log; Oracle OPERA PMS Rate Loading Audit

attributes.name: rate_loading_status
attributes.description: Current status of the rate loading process in Sabre SynXis CRS and Oracle OPERA PMS. Indicates whether the negotiated rate has been successfully distributed to all applicable booking channels.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Rate Loading Workflow; Oracle OPERA PMS Rate Distribution

attributes.name: rate_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name describing the negotiated rate agreement, typically referencing the account or program name (e.g., 'Acme Corp 2025 Corporate Rate'). Used in reporting and rate management dashboards.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Rate Management; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: rate_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the negotiated rate agreement. Controls whether the rate is bookable and distributed through CRS/GDS channels.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Rate Status; Sabre SynXis CRS Distribution Status

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pricing structure for this negotiated rate. Fixed rates are static for the contract period; dynamic rates may fluctuate within agreed bounds; tiered rates vary by volume; per diem rates are government-mandated ceiling rates.
attributes.references: AHLA Rate Classification; IDeaS G3 RMS Rate Type Configuration; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: source_system_rate_reference
attributes.description: Native identifier of this negotiated rate record in the originating operational system (Oracle OPERA PMS, Sabre SynXis CRS, or Salesforce CRM). Enables traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse and source systems.
attributes.references: HTNG Data Integration Standards; Oracle OPERA PMS Rate ID; Sabre SynXis CRS Rate Reference

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this negotiated rate record was last modified in the source system. Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental ETL processing.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity; SOX Audit Trail Requirements; CCPA

products.name: strategy
products.description: Revenue strategy records documenting the approved pricing and inventory strategy for a property over a defined planning horizon. Captures strategy period, property, strategy type (transient, group, total revenue), target ADR, target occupancy, target RevPAR, key tactical actions, strategy status (draft, approved, active), and approving revenue director. Provides governance and audit trail for strategic revenue decisions.

attributes.name: strategy_id
attributes.description: Primary key for strategy

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Revenue strategies often incorporate specific marketing campaigns as tactical levers (e.g., deploy summer family campaign to drive weekend occupancy). Strategy owners need this link for execution trac

attributes.name: competitive_set_id
attributes.description: Reference to the competitive set definition used for benchmarking this strategy. The competitor set defines the peer properties against which RGI, MPI, and ARI targets are measured via STR STAR Report.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report; Infor EzRMS; AHLA

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Revenue strategies are implemented at cost center level for tactical execution, departmental accountability, and operational performance management.

attributes.name: demand_forecast_id
attributes.description: Reference to the demand forecast record that informed and underpins this revenue strategy. Links to the revenue.demand_forecast product to provide the analytical basis for strategy targets and tactical decisions.

attributes.name: finance_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_budget. Business justification: Revenue strategies are aligned with financial budgets for strategic planning, ensuring revenue tactics support approved financial targets and ownership expectations.

attributes.name: gss_score_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to experience.gss_score. Business justification: Revenue strategies explicitly target GSS improvement as a demand driver (experience-driven revenue strategy). Strategic plans link rate positioning to satisfaction goals—properties pursuing rate growt

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the hotel or resort property to which this revenue strategy applies. Links to the property master record in Oracle OPERA PMS.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; AHLA Property Standards

attributes.name: superseded_by_strategy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the newer revenue strategy record that replaced this one when status is 'superseded'. Enables lineage tracking of strategy evolution and supports audit trail for revenue governance.

attributes.name: activated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the strategy status transitioned to 'active' and began governing live pricing and inventory decisions. Distinct from approval timestamp — a strategy may be approved in advance and activated at a later point.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; USALI

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the Revenue Director or authorized revenue management leader who formally approved this strategy. Provides governance and audit trail for strategic revenue decisions per SOX internal controls requirements.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the revenue strategy was formally approved by the authorizing Revenue Director. Establishes the official approval event in the strategy lifecycle for governance and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: channel_focus
attributes.description: The primary distribution channel(s) this strategy targets for demand generation (e.g., 'Direct Web', 'GDS', 'OTA', 'Voice/CRS', 'Corporate Direct'). Informs channel mix optimization and OTA partnership management decisions. Aligns with Sabre SynXis CRS channel codes.

attributes.name: strategy_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this revenue strategy record within the Revenue Management System (RMS). Used for cross-system reference and audit trail. Sourced from IDeaS G3 RMS or Infor EzRMS strategy identifiers.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; USALI

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this revenue strategy record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation anchor for the strategy lifecycle.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary target values in this strategy record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Ensures consistent financial reporting across multi-currency property portfolios.

attributes.name: horizon_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the temporal scope of the strategy planning horizon. 'weekly' for short-term tactical adjustments, 'monthly' for rolling monthly plans, 'quarterly' for seasonal strategies, 'annual' for full-year budget-aligned strategies, 'event_based' for strategies tied to specific demand events.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; STR STAR Report

attributes.name: inventory_control_approach
attributes.description: The approved inventory management methodology for this strategy period. 'open' allows all bookings, 'hurdle_rate' applies minimum rate thresholds, 'length_of_stay' (LOS) enforces minimum/maximum stay restrictions, 'nested' uses tiered availability controls, 'closed' restricts availability for specific segments or channels.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Oracle OPERA PMS; AHLA

attributes.name: key_tactical_actions
attributes.description: Free-text narrative documenting the specific tactical actions approved as part of this strategy (e.g., 'Open BAR for all channels on shoulder nights', 'Apply 5-night minimum LOS restriction over peak weekend', 'Close OTA channels when occupancy exceeds 85%'). Provides governance documentation for revenue decisions.
attributes.references: USALI; SOX Section 302; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: strategy_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name describing the revenue strategy (e.g., 'Q3 2025 Transient Yield Push', 'Holiday Season Total Revenue Strategy'). Used for identification in reporting and governance workflows.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next formal performance review of this revenue strategy. Drives workflow triggers in the revenue management calendar and ensures timely strategy adjustments based on actual vs. target performance.
attributes.references: AHLA Revenue Management Standards; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text commentary, rationale, or contextual notes provided by the revenue management team regarding this strategy. May include market intelligence, competitive observations, or risk considerations not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: planning_horizon_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the planning period covered by this revenue strategy. Together with planning_horizon_start_date, defines the full strategy window for yield optimization and performance tracking.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; USALI

attributes.name: planning_horizon_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the planning period covered by this revenue strategy. Defines the beginning of the stay-date window over which the strategy governs pricing and inventory decisions.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; USALI

attributes.name: pricing_approach
attributes.description: The approved pricing methodology governing rate-setting for this strategy period. 'bar_based' uses Best Available Rate (BAR) as the anchor, 'dynamic' applies algorithmic Dynamic Rate Rules (DRR), 'fixed' uses static rate plans, 'hybrid' combines approaches, 'competitive_parity' aligns rates to competitive set benchmarks.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: primary_market_segment_focus
attributes.description: The primary guest market segment this strategy is designed to optimize (e.g., 'Corporate Transient', 'Leisure FIT', 'Group MICE', 'OTA Leisure', 'Government'). Aligns with market segment codes used in Oracle OPERA PMS and IDeaS G3 RMS segmentation.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; IDeaS G3 RMS; AHLA

attributes.name: review_frequency
attributes.description: The approved cadence at which this strategy is scheduled for performance review and potential revision by the revenue management team. Governs the operational rhythm of the revenue management process.
attributes.references: AHLA Revenue Management Standards; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: rms_strategy_reference_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Revenue Management System (RMS) Strategy Reference ID
attributes.description: The native strategy or scenario identifier from the source Revenue Management System (IDeaS G3 RMS or Infor EzRMS). Enables traceability back to the originating RMS record for reconciliation and system-of-record alignment.

tag_set.value: Revenue Management System (RMS) Strategy Reference ID

attributes.name: special_event_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this strategy was created in response to a specific demand-driving special event (e.g., major conference, sporting event, concert, holiday period). When True, the strategy may include event-specific pricing premiums and inventory controls.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; AHLA

attributes.name: special_event_name
attributes.description: Name of the demand-driving special event associated with this strategy when special_event_flag is True (e.g., 'Super Bowl LX', 'Annual Medical Conference', 'New Year Holiday Period'). Provides context for strategy rationale and post-event performance analysis.

attributes.name: strategy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the revenue strategy record. 'draft' indicates work-in-progress, 'pending_approval' awaits revenue director sign-off, 'approved' is authorized but not yet in effect, 'active' is currently governing pricing decisions, 'superseded' has been replaced by a newer strategy, 'archived' is retained for historical audit.
attributes.references: USALI; SOX Section 302 — internal controls documentation; AHLA

attributes.name: strategy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the revenue strategy by business segment. 'transient' covers individual guest pricing, 'group' covers group block strategies, 'total_revenue' encompasses all revenue streams (TRevPAR focus), 'food_and_beverage' targets F&B revenue optimization, 'events' covers MICE and event revenue. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: transient|group|total_revenue|food_and_beverage|events|loyalty — promote to reference product if additional types emerge]
attributes.references: USALI; STR STAR Report; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: target_adr
attributes.description: The approved target Average Daily Rate (ADR) in the property's operating currency for the strategy period. ADR is the primary pricing KPI representing average revenue earned per occupied room per night. Used to benchmark actual ADR performance against strategic intent.
attributes.references: USALI; STR STAR Report; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: target_ari
attributes.description: The approved target Average Rate Index (ARI) for the strategy period. ARI = Property ADR / Competitive Set ADR. Measures the property's rate positioning relative to its competitive set. Used alongside MPI and RGI for comprehensive competitive benchmarking.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report; AHLA; Infor EzRMS

attributes.name: target_goppar
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Gross Operating Profit Per Available Room (GOPPAR)
attributes.description: The approved target Gross Operating Profit Per Available Room (GOPPAR) for the strategy period. GOPPAR incorporates operating costs and provides a profitability-adjusted view of revenue performance, aligned with USALI GOP reporting standards.

tag_set.value: Target Gross Operating Profit Per Available Room (GOPPAR)

attributes.name: target_mpi
attributes.description: The approved target Market Penetration Index (MPI) for the strategy period. MPI = Property Occupancy / Competitive Set Occupancy. Measures the property's occupancy share relative to its competitive set as defined in STR STAR Report.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report; AHLA; Infor EzRMS

attributes.name: target_occupancy_pct
attributes.description: The approved target Occupancy Rate (OCC) expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00) for the strategy period. Represents the proportion of available rooms expected to be sold. Core input to RevPAR calculation and yield optimization decisions.

attributes.name: target_revpar
attributes.description: The approved target Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR) in the property's operating currency for the strategy period. RevPAR = ADR × Occupancy Rate. The primary composite KPI for hotel revenue performance and competitive benchmarking via STR STAR Report.
attributes.references: USALI; STR STAR Report; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: target_rgi
attributes.description: The approved target Revenue Generation Index (RGI) for the strategy period. RGI = Property RevPAR / Competitive Set RevPAR. An RGI above 1.0 indicates the property is outperforming its competitive set. Sourced from STR STAR Report benchmarking data.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report; AHLA; Infor EzRMS

attributes.name: target_trevpar
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Total Revenue Per Available Room (TRevPAR)
attributes.description: The approved target Total Revenue Per Available Room (TRevPAR) encompassing all revenue streams (rooms, F&B, spa, events, ancillary) per available room for the strategy period. Relevant for total revenue strategies beyond rooms-only yield optimization.
