attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the last person to modify this strategy record. Supports change management and audit trail for revenue governance.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this revenue strategy record was last modified. Tracks the most recent change event for audit trail and data lineage purposes in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Monotonically incrementing version number for this strategy record. Increments each time the strategy is revised and re-approved. Supports audit trail and change management for revenue governance workflows.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the revenue management professional who created this strategy record. Supports governance, accountability, and audit trail requirements.

products.name: wash_factor
products.description: Group block wash factor records defining the expected attrition (wash) percentage applied to group room blocks when forecasting net group pickup. Captures group type, booking lead time bucket, historical wash percentage, adjusted wash factor, effective date, and property. Used by IDeaS G3 RMS to constrain group demand in the forecast and avoid over-displacement of transient business.

attributes.name: wash_factor_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each wash factor record in the revenue domain Silver layer. Primary key for the wash_factor data product.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module; USALI Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry

attributes.name: market_segment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the market segment associated with this wash factor record (e.g., corporate group, association, SMERF, leisure group). Supports segment-level attrition analysis and Revenue Management System (RMS) demand segmentation.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation; Infor EzRMS — Demand Forecasting; USALI

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property for which this wash factor record applies. Enables property-level group demand forecasting and displacement analysis within IDeaS G3 RMS.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS — Property Configuration; IDeaS G3 RMS — Inventory Controls

attributes.name: room_type_id
attributes.description: Reference to the room type to which this wash factor applies. Allows wash factor differentiation by room category (e.g., standard, suite, accessible) for granular group block attrition modeling.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS — Room Type Configuration; IDeaS G3 RMS — Inventory Controls

attributes.name: adjusted_wash_pct
attributes.description: Revenue manager-adjusted wash factor applied to group block forecasting after applying business judgment, seasonal adjustments, or RMS recommendations on top of the historical wash percentage. This is the operative value consumed by IDeaS G3 RMS for net group pickup forecasting and transient displacement calculations.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation; Infor EzRMS — Revenue Strategy

attributes.name: adjustment_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by the revenue manager for any manual adjustment applied to the historical wash percentage to derive the adjusted wash percentage. Documents the business rationale for overrides (e.g., 'Adjusted upward due to new corporate account with unproven pickup history').
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation; Revenue Management audit trail standards

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or user identifier of the revenue manager or director who approved the adjusted wash percentage for use in RMS forecasting. Supports audit trail and governance requirements.
attributes.references: SOX — Internal Controls; USALI; Revenue Management governance standards

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the wash factor record was formally approved by the revenue manager for activation in the RMS. Provides a precise audit trail for governance and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX — Internal Controls; USALI; IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation

attributes.name: block_size_max_rooms
attributes.description: Maximum number of contracted group room nights that defines the upper bound of the block size tier. A null value indicates an open-ended upper bound (e.g., mega blocks with no ceiling).
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation; Delphi by Amadeus — Group Blocks

attributes.name: block_size_min_rooms
attributes.description: Minimum number of contracted group room nights that defines the lower bound of the block size tier for this wash factor record.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation; Delphi by Amadeus — Group Blocks

attributes.name: block_size_tier
attributes.description: Categorical tier representing the size of the group room block (e.g., small: 1–10 rooms, medium: 11–50 rooms, large: 51–200 rooms, mega: 200+ rooms). Block size is a significant predictor of wash behavior; larger blocks tend to exhibit higher attrition rates.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation; Delphi by Amadeus — Group Blocks; AHLA Group Business Standards

attributes.name: booking_lead_time_bucket
attributes.description: Categorical bucket representing the number of days between group block creation and the group arrival date. Lead time is a critical predictor of wash behavior; groups booked further in advance typically exhibit higher attrition rates. Used by IDeaS G3 RMS to apply the correct wash factor based on booking horizon.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation; Infor EzRMS — Demand Forecasting; STR STAR Report benchmarking standards

attributes.name: channel_code
attributes.description: Distribution channel code associated with this wash factor (e.g., GDS, direct, OTA, voice). Group blocks sourced through different channels may exhibit distinct attrition patterns, warranting channel-specific wash factors.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS — Channel Management; IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation; HTNG Channel Distribution Standards

attributes.name: wash_factor_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this wash factor configuration within the Revenue Management System (RMS). Used as the business key for integration with IDeaS G3 RMS and Infor EzRMS.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module; Infor EzRMS — Revenue Strategy

attributes.name: confidence_level_pct
attributes.description: Statistical confidence level associated with the historical wash percentage estimate, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 95.00 = 95%). Derived from the sample size and variance of historical group block attrition data. Informs revenue managers of the reliability of the wash factor.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation; Statistical confidence interval standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this wash factor record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation anchor for the record lifecycle in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver layer.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity; SOX — Audit Trail; USALI

attributes.name: day_of_week_pattern
attributes.description: Day-of-week pattern for which this wash factor applies. Group attrition rates can differ between weekday and weekend arrivals. Used to apply day-of-week-sensitive wash adjustments in the RMS forecast.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation; Infor EzRMS — Demand Forecasting

attributes.name: displacement_impact_pct
attributes.description: Estimated percentage of transient room revenue displaced by the group block after applying the wash factor. Quantifies the opportunity cost of accepting the group block versus holding inventory for transient demand. Used in group displacement analysis within IDeaS G3 RMS.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation; Revenue Management displacement analysis standards; USALI

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this wash factor record becomes active and is applied by the Revenue Management System (RMS) for group demand forecasting. Supports temporal versioning of wash factor configurations.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation; USALI; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this wash factor record ceases to be active. A null value indicates the record is open-ended and remains in effect until superseded. Enables temporal management of wash factor versioning.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation; USALI

attributes.name: factor_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the wash factor record. Controls whether the record is actively consumed by the RMS for forecasting. 'Superseded' indicates a newer version has replaced this record; 'pending_review' indicates the record requires revenue manager approval before activation.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation; Revenue Management governance standards

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: Classification of the group business type to which this wash factor applies. Group type is a primary driver of attrition behavior; corporate groups typically wash differently than SMERF (Social, Military, Educational, Religious, Fraternal) or association groups. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: corporate|association|smerf|leisure|government|sports|tour_operator — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation; Delphi by Amadeus — Group Blocks; AHLA Group Business Standards

attributes.name: historical_observation_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the historical data window used to calculate the historical wash percentage. Together with historical_observation_start_date, defines the precise lookback period for wash factor derivation.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation; Statistical data governance standards

attributes.name: historical_observation_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the historical data window used to calculate the historical wash percentage. Defines the lookback period for the statistical derivation of the wash factor.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation; Statistical data governance standards

attributes.name: historical_wash_pct
attributes.description: Observed historical attrition (wash) percentage derived from actual group block pickup data. Represents the proportion of contracted group room nights that were not consumed (i.e., rooms blocked but not picked up). Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 0.2500 = 25%). Source data from Oracle OPERA PMS group block history.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation; USALI; STR STAR Report — Group Demand Benchmarking

attributes.name: is_default_factor
attributes.description: Indicates whether this wash factor record serves as the default fallback when no more specific wash factor matches a group block's attributes (group type, lead time, block size, season). True = default factor; False = specific factor.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation; Revenue Management best practices

attributes.name: is_rms_active
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is Revenue Management System (RMS) Active Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this wash factor record is currently being consumed by the Revenue Management System (IDeaS G3 RMS or Infor EzRMS) for live group demand forecasting and transient displacement calculations. True = actively used in RMS; False = not currently applied.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation; Infor EzRMS — Demand Forecasting

tag_set.value: Is Revenue Management System (RMS) Active Flag

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date on which this wash factor record was most recently reviewed and validated by the revenue management team. Used to identify stale wash factors that may require recalibration.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation; Revenue Management governance standards

attributes.name: lead_time_max_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days before arrival that defines the upper bound of the booking lead time bucket. A null value indicates an open-ended upper bound (e.g., 365+ days). Together with lead_time_min_days, precisely defines the lead time window.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module

attributes.name: lead_time_min_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days before arrival that defines the lower bound of the booking lead time bucket. Together with lead_time_max_days, precisely defines the lead time window for this wash factor record.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module

attributes.name: wash_factor_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for this wash factor configuration (e.g., 'Corporate Group 30-Day Lead Time — High Season'). Used by revenue managers to identify and manage wash factor rules.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next review and recalibration of this wash factor record. Derived from last_reviewed_date and review_frequency. Supports proactive revenue management governance workflows.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional revenue manager commentary, special conditions, or contextual information relevant to this wash factor record. May include references to specific group accounts, market events, or RMS configuration notes.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation; Revenue Management operational standards

attributes.name: review_frequency
attributes.description: Prescribed frequency at which this wash factor record should be reviewed and recalibrated by the revenue management team. Ensures wash factors remain statistically current and reflective of evolving group booking behavior.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: rms_wash_factor_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Revenue Management System (RMS) Wash Factor ID
attributes.description: Native identifier for this wash factor record as stored in the source Revenue Management System (IDeaS G3 RMS or Infor EzRMS). Enables bidirectional traceability between the Silver layer data product and the operational RMS source system.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation Module; Infor EzRMS — Revenue Strategy

tag_set.value: Revenue Management System (RMS) Wash Factor ID

attributes.name: sample_size
attributes.description: Number of historical group block observations used to calculate the historical wash percentage. Indicates statistical reliability of the wash factor; low sample sizes may warrant wider confidence intervals or manual override.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation; Statistical sampling standards

attributes.name: season_type
attributes.description: Seasonal classification for which this wash factor is applicable. Wash behavior varies significantly by season; peak season groups may exhibit lower attrition due to higher demand, while off-peak groups may wash more aggressively.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Pricing and Forecasting; Infor EzRMS — Demand Forecasting; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this wash factor record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, incremental ETL processing, and audit trail requirements in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity; SOX — Audit Trail; USALI

attributes.name: wash_pct_variance
attributes.description: Difference between the adjusted wash percentage and the historical wash percentage (adjusted_wash_pct minus historical_wash_pct). Quantifies the degree of manual override applied by the revenue manager relative to historical norms. Positive values indicate a more conservative (higher attrition) assumption.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS — Group Evaluation; Revenue Management best practices

products.name: total_revenue_actuals
products.description: Daily total revenue actuals aggregated across all revenue streams (rooms, F&B, spa, parking, ancillary) at the property level, aligned to USALI departmental reporting. Captures stay date, property, rooms revenue, F&B revenue, other operated department revenue, miscellaneous income, total revenue, CPOR (Cost Per Occupied Room), GOP (Gross Operating Profit), and EBITDA contribution. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS and SAP S/4HANA. Supports TRevPAR and GOPPAR calculation.

attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each daily total revenue actuals record at the property level. Primary key for this Silver Layer data product.

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.name: finance_budget_id

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fiscal calendar period (month/quarter/year) under which this stay date falls, enabling USALI-aligned financial reporting in SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger. Business justification: Total revenue actuals post to GL accounts for financial statement preparation, revenue recognition, and external financial reporting compliance.

attributes.name: primary_fnb_outlet_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fnb.fnb_outlet. Business justification: Total revenue actuals aggregate outlet-level F&B for TRevPAR calculation and USALI reporting. Required for financial consolidation, total property performance reporting, outlet contribution analysis t

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Total revenue actuals roll up to profit centers for consolidated financial statements, ownership reporting, and portfolio-level performance analysis.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property for which total revenue actuals are recorded. Aligns with Oracle OPERA PMS property configuration.

attributes.name: reconciled_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Finance analysts reconcile total property revenue; employee attribution required for data quality accountability, GL posting workflow tracking, and performance evaluation of financial reporting accura

attributes.name: adjustment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this revenue actuals record contains a post-close adjustment or restatement to previously posted figures. When true, the adjustment_reason field provides context. Supports SOX audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX; USALI; SAP S/4HANA Finance GL

attributes.name: adjustment_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for any post-close adjustment or restatement applied to this revenue actuals record. Populated only when adjustment_flag is true. Required for SOX audit trail and USALI financial controls.
attributes.references: SOX; USALI; SAP S/4HANA Finance GL

attributes.name: adr
attributes.description: Average Daily Rate for the stay date, calculated as rooms revenue divided by rooms sold. Core KPI for revenue performance benchmarking against STR STAR Report and competitive set. Sourced from IDeaS G3 RMS daily actuals feed.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report; USALI; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: ari
attributes.description: Average Rate Index for the stay date, representing the property's ADR divided by the competitive set's ADR. Measures the property's pricing performance relative to its competitive set. Sourced from STR STAR Report.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report; Infor EzRMS; AHLA

attributes.name: complimentary_rooms
attributes.description: Number of rooms occupied on a complimentary basis (zero-rated) on the stay date. Tracked separately per USALI and STR reporting standards to distinguish from revenue-generating occupied rooms.

attributes.name: cpor
attributes.description: Total operating cost per occupied room for the stay date, calculated as total departmental operating expenses divided by rooms sold. Key efficiency metric per USALI and AHLA benchmarking standards. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA cost accounting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this revenue actuals record was first created in the Silver Layer data product, typically following the nightly ETL load from Oracle OPERA PMS and SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all monetary amounts on this record are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency property portfolios.

attributes.name: day_of_week
attributes.description: Day of the week corresponding to the stay date. Used for day-of-week revenue pattern analysis, demand segmentation, and yield optimization in IDeaS G3 RMS and Infor EzRMS. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Monday|Tuesday|Wednesday|Thursday|Friday|Saturday|Sunday — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: ebitda_contribution

attributes.description: EBITDA contribution for the stay date at the property level, representing GOP less management fees and other fixed charges but before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA. Required for SOX financial controls and IFRS/GAAP reporting.

attributes.references: USALI Food and Beverage Department; Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS; Delphi by Amadeus

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: Date on which the revenue figures were posted to the General Ledger in SAP S/4HANA. May differ from stay date due to night audit timing or period-end adjustments. Required for USALI and SOX financial controls.

attributes.name: gop_amount
attributes.description: Gross Operating Profit for the stay date, representing total revenue minus total departmental and undistributed operating expenses, before fixed charges. Core USALI profitability metric sourced from SAP S/4HANA GL.
attributes.references: USALI; SAP S/4HANA Finance GL; IFRS/GAAP; SOX

attributes.name: goppar
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Operating Profit Per Available Room (GOPPAR)
attributes.description: Gross Operating Profit Per Available Room for the stay date, calculated as GOP divided by rooms available. Measures overall property profitability efficiency per available room. Key executive KPI per USALI and AHLA standards.

attributes.name: house_use_rooms
attributes.description: Number of rooms occupied for internal hotel use (staff, management) on the stay date. Excluded from revenue-generating occupancy per USALI and STR standards.

attributes.name: is_holiday
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stay date falls on a public or bank holiday in the property's market. Used for holiday demand uplift analysis and dynamic pricing strategy in IDeaS G3 RMS.

attributes.name: is_special_event
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stay date coincides with a special event (e.g., convention, concert, sporting event) that materially impacts demand and pricing. Used in IDeaS G3 RMS demand forecasting and revenue strategy.

attributes.name: is_weekend
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stay date falls on a weekend (Friday or Saturday night per hospitality convention). Used for weekend vs. weekday revenue segmentation and pricing strategy analysis.

attributes.name: miscellaneous_income
attributes.description: Total net miscellaneous and non-operating income for the stay date, including rental income, cancellation fees, and other non-departmental revenue lines per USALI Non-Operating Income and Expenses.

attributes.name: mpi
attributes.description: Market Penetration Index for the stay date, representing the property's occupancy rate divided by the competitive set's occupancy rate. Measures the property's fair share of market demand. Sourced from STR STAR Report.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report; Infor EzRMS; AHLA

attributes.name: occupancy_pct
attributes.description: Occupancy percentage for the stay date, calculated as rooms sold divided by rooms available, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.8500 = 85%). Core KPI for yield optimization and STR STAR Report benchmarking.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report; USALI; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: other_operated_dept_revenue
attributes.description: Total net revenue from all other operated departments (e.g., golf, retail, recreation, business center) for the stay date, excluding rooms, F&B, spa, and parking. Aligns with USALI Other Operated Departments aggregate line.

attributes.name: out_of_order_rooms
attributes.description: Number of rooms designated as out-of-order (OOO) on the stay date due to maintenance, renovation, or damage. Deducted from available room count per STR and USALI standards.
attributes.references: USALI; STR STAR Report; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: parking_revenue
attributes.description: Total net parking and valet revenue for the stay date, classified under USALI Other Operated Departments.

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of the revenue actuals record indicating whether figures are preliminary, posted to the general ledger, adjusted, period-closed, or voided. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA GL posting workflow.

attributes.name: reporting_segment
attributes.description: Brand or service tier segment of the property for this revenue record (e.g., luxury, premium, select-service). Enables cross-segment revenue performance benchmarking and portfolio analytics aligned with AHLA and STR segmentation standards.

attributes.name: revpar
attributes.description: Revenue Per Available Room for the stay date, calculated as rooms revenue divided by rooms available (or ADR multiplied by occupancy rate). Primary yield optimization metric tracked in IDeaS G3 RMS and benchmarked via STR STAR Report.

attributes.name: rgi
attributes.description: Revenue Generation Index for the stay date, representing the property's RevPAR divided by the competitive set's RevPAR. An RGI above 1.0 indicates the property is outperforming its competitive set. Sourced from STR STAR Report and Infor EzRMS.

attributes.name: rooms_available
attributes.description: Total number of rooms available for sale on the stay date after deducting out-of-order and out-of-service rooms. Denominator for RevPAR and TRevPAR calculations. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS inventory.
attributes.references: STR (Smith Travel Research) STAR Report; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: rooms_revenue
attributes.description: Total net rooms revenue for the stay date at the property, sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS cashiering. Represents the primary revenue line under USALI Rooms Department. Used as the numerator in ADR and RevPAR calculations.
attributes.references: USALI Rooms Department; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: rooms_revenue_budget
attributes.description: Budgeted rooms revenue for the stay date as set in the annual operating plan. Enables variance analysis between actual and budgeted rooms revenue performance. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA budgeting module.

attributes.name: rooms_sold
attributes.description: Total number of rooms occupied (sold) on the stay date, excluding complimentary and house-use rooms unless otherwise configured. Used to compute ADR and Occupancy Rate (OCC). Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS.
attributes.references: STR STAR Report; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: source_system_record_reference
attributes.description: Native record identifier from the originating source system (e.g., OPERA PMS daily revenue summary ID or SAP S/4HANA document number). Enables traceability and reconciliation back to the system of record.

attributes.name: spa_revenue
attributes.description: Total net spa and wellness revenue for the stay date, classified under USALI Other Operated Departments. Includes treatments, retail, and membership fees.

attributes.name: stay_date
attributes.description: The calendar date for which revenue actuals are reported. Represents the business date (night) in Oracle OPERA PMS, used as the primary time dimension for ADR, RevPAR, TRevPAR, and GOPPAR calculations.

attributes.name: total_operating_expenses
attributes.description: Total departmental and undistributed operating expenses for the stay date, including labor, cost of goods sold, and other direct costs across all departments. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA cost accounting. Used to derive GOP.

attributes.name: total_revenue
attributes.description: Total net revenue across all revenue streams (rooms + F&B + spa + parking + other operated departments + miscellaneous income) for the stay date. Primary metric for TRevPAR calculation. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA daily revenue close.

attributes.name: total_revenue_budget
attributes.description: Budgeted total revenue for the stay date across all departments as set in the annual operating plan. Enables variance analysis between actual and budgeted total revenue. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA budgeting module.

attributes.name: trevpar
attributes.description: Total Revenue Per Available Room for the stay date, calculated as total revenue divided by rooms available. Captures full revenue contribution across all departments beyond rooms. Key metric for holistic revenue strategy.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

products.name: segment_program_eligibility
products.description: This association product represents the eligibility configuration between market segments and experience programs. It captures which market segments are eligible for which experience programs, along with segment-specific enrollment rules, discounts, and priority rankings. Each record links one market segment to one experience program with attributes that exist only in the context of this eligibility relationship.. Existence Justification: Experience programs are configured to target multiple market segments with segment-specific eligibility rules, discounts, and priority rankings. For example, a Romance Package program may be eligible for Leisure, Couples, and Transient segments, each with different discount percentages and priority levels. Conversely, a single market segment like Transient participates in multiple programs (Romance, Spa, Golf packages) with different eligibility criteria and effective dates for each program.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the experience program for which this market segment is eligible

attributes.name: program_discount_pct

domains.name: loyalty
domains.description: Guest loyalty program management including membership enrollment, tier management, points accrual and redemption, elite status benefits, partner integrations, and rewards fulfillment. Tracks member activity, lifetime value (LTV), engagement metrics, SALT (Satisfaction and Loyalty Tracking), and program economics. Supports personalized offers, tier upgrades, and retention campaigns.

products.name: member
products.description: Core master entity representing a guest enrolled in the loyalty program. Captures membership identity, enrollment date, current tier assignment (FK to tier), lifetime points balance, LTV metrics (total revenue, stays, nights), SALT scores, program opt-in preferences, communication consent, membership number, and account status (active, suspended, closed). This is the SSOT for loyalty membership identity and current member state — distinct from the guest profile in the guest domain, which owns PII and stay history. References guest_id as a foreign key to the guest domain. Also serves as the anchor for member segment assignments (segment memberships tracked temporally within member_segment).
products.reference: Loyalty Member / CRM Member Record (Salesforce CRM)

products.name: tier

Captures tier name, tier code, qualification thresholds (nights, stays, points, spend), benefit entitlements, upgrade/downgrade rules, tier validity period, and display order. Governs tier assignment logic and benefit eligibility across the program.

products.name: tier_history

Captures previous tier, new tier, effective date, expiry date, qualification basis (nights/stays/points/spend achieved), qualifying period, qualifying activity summary (total qualifying nights, stays, spend in period), change reason (earned upgrade, annual requalification, downgrade, manual override, status match), and the agent or system that triggered the change. This is the SSOT for tier progression audit trail and requalification decisions — replacing the need for a separate qualifying_activity entity.

products.name: points_ledger
products.description: Authoritative transactional ledger recording every points movement for a loyalty member — including accruals, redemptions, expirations, adjustments, and partner transfers. Each row is an immutable debit or credit entry capturing transaction type (earn, redeem, expire, adjust, transfer_out, transfer_in, bonus), points amount, balance after transaction, source activity (stay, F&B spend, partner purchase, promotion), activity date, posting date, expiry date, originating system reference. For transfer-type entries: partner program reference, transfer direction, conversion rate applied, partner confirmation number, transfer status, and fee charged. This is the SSOT for points balance, movement history, and partner transfer activity.

attributes.name: referral_code

attributes.name: requalification_requirement_flag

attributes.name: sms_consent_flag

attributes.name: source_program_name
attributes.description: Name of the competitor loyalty program from which status was matched. Populated only for status match enrollments.

attributes.name: source_tier_claimed
attributes.description: The tier level the member claimed to hold in the source competitor program. Populated only for status match enrollments.

attributes.name: status_match_flag

attributes.name: terms_accepted_flag

attributes.name: terms_version
attributes.description: Version number of the terms and conditions that the member accepted at enrollment. Used for audit and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: welcome_bonus_points
attributes.description: Number of loyalty points awarded as a welcome bonus upon enrollment. Zero if no welcome bonus was offered.

products.name: benefit_entitlement
products.description: Master record of the specific benefits a loyalty member is entitled to based on their current tier and any individually granted benefits. Captures benefit type (complimentary breakfast, room upgrade, late checkout, lounge access, welcome amenity, bonus points multiplier), entitlement source (tier standard, status match, manual grant, promotion), effective date, expiry date, usage limit, and remaining usage count. Enables benefit delivery and tracking at the property level.
products.reference: Elite Benefit Entitlement / Member Benefit Record

attributes.name: benefit_entitlement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the benefit entitlement record. Primary key.

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty program member who holds this benefit entitlement.

attributes.name: primary_benefit_employee_id
attributes.description: The system user ID or employee ID of the person who manually granted this benefit, if applicable. Null for system-generated entitlements.

attributes.name: tertiary_benefit_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: The system user ID or employee ID of the person who last modified this benefit entitlement record.

attributes.name: tier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty tier that grants this benefit as a standard entitlement. Null if the benefit is individually granted outside of tier benefits.

attributes.name: advance_booking_required_days
attributes.description: The minimum number of days in advance that a reservation must be made to redeem this benefit. Null if no advance booking requirement exists.

attributes.name: auto_apply_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this benefit is automatically applied to eligible reservations or requires manual member selection. True if auto-applied, False if opt-in required.

attributes.name: benefit_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the benefit, including terms, conditions, and any restrictions or exclusions.

attributes.name: benefit_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the benefit entitlement for display and communication purposes.

attributes.name: benefit_type_code
attributes.description: The category of benefit granted to the member. Examples include complimentary breakfast, room upgrade, late checkout, lounge access, welcome amenity, or bonus points multiplier.

attributes.name: blackout_dates
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of date ranges during which this benefit cannot be redeemed, typically during peak demand periods or special events.

attributes.name: brand_restriction
attributes.description: The brand code if this benefit is restricted to properties within a specific brand. Null if no brand restriction applies.

attributes.name: combinable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this benefit can be combined with other benefits or promotions during the same stay. True if combinable, False if mutually exclusive.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the monetary value of this benefit.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this benefit entitlement becomes valid and can be redeemed by the member.

attributes.name: eligible_property_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of property codes where this benefit can be redeemed. Populated only when property_restriction is SPECIFIC.

attributes.name: entitlement_source
attributes.description: The origin or reason for granting this benefit. Tier standard benefits are automatic based on member tier; status match benefits are granted when matching status from another program; manual grants are discretionary; promotion benefits are campaign-driven; compensation benefits are service recovery; partner benefits come from co-branded or partner integrations.

attributes.name: entitlement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the benefit entitlement. Active entitlements can be redeemed; suspended entitlements are temporarily unavailable; expired entitlements have passed their validity period; revoked entitlements have been withdrawn; pending entitlements are awaiting activation.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this benefit entitlement expires and can no longer be redeemed. Null for benefits with no expiration.

attributes.name: granted_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this benefit entitlement was created or granted to the member.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this benefit entitlement record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: maximum_stay_nights
attributes.description: The maximum length of stay (LOS) in nights for which this benefit can be applied. Null if no maximum stay restriction exists.

attributes.name: minimum_stay_nights
attributes.description: The minimum length of stay (LOS) in nights required to redeem this benefit. Null if no minimum stay requirement exists.

attributes.name: monetary_value
attributes.description: The estimated monetary value of this benefit in the property's base currency, used for program economics tracking and liability calculation.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special instructions, or contextual information about this benefit entitlement.

attributes.name: points_multiplier
attributes.description: The bonus points multiplier applied to eligible stays when this benefit is active. For example, 1.5 means the member earns 50% bonus points. Null if this benefit does not include a points multiplier.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: The priority order for applying this benefit when multiple benefits are available. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used to resolve conflicts when benefits cannot be combined.

attributes.name: property_restriction
attributes.description: Indicates whether this benefit can be redeemed at all properties, only at specific properties, within a specific brand, or within a specific geographic region.

attributes.name: region_restriction
attributes.description: The geographic region code if this benefit is restricted to properties within a specific region. Null if no region restriction applies.

attributes.name: remaining_usage
attributes.description: The number of redemptions remaining for this benefit. Calculated as usage_limit minus usage_count. Null if usage is unlimited.

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: The business reason or justification for revoking this benefit entitlement. Null if the benefit has not been revoked.

attributes.name: revoked_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this benefit entitlement was revoked. Null if the benefit has not been revoked.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this benefit entitlement in the source operational system.

attributes.name: transferable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this benefit can be transferred to another loyalty member. True if transferable, False if non-transferable.

attributes.name: usage_count
attributes.description: The number of times this benefit has been redeemed to date. Used to track remaining usage against the usage limit.

attributes.name: usage_limit
attributes.description: The maximum number of times this benefit can be redeemed during its validity period. Null indicates unlimited usage.

products.name: benefit_redemption
products.description: Unified lifecycle entity for loyalty member benefits — from entitlement through consumption or expiry. Captures benefit type (complimentary breakfast, room upgrade, late checkout, lounge access, welcome amenity, bonus points multiplier), entitlement source (tier standard, status match, manual grant, promotion), effective date, expiry date, usage limit, remaining usage count, and delivery records including delivery date, property, reservation reference, delivering staff, member acknowledgment, and exception notes. This is the SSOT for 'what benefits does this member have and which have been used' — enabling benefit fulfillment tracking, elite SLA compliance, and property-level benefit delivery operations.
products.reference: Benefit Delivery / Elite Benefit Fulfillment Record

attributes.name: benefit_redemption_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the benefit redemption record. Primary key for tracking the complete lifecycle of a loyalty member benefit from entitlement through consumption or expiry.
attributes.references: HTNG (Hotel Technology Next Generation) - Loyalty Data Standards

attributes.name: benefit_entitlement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.benefit_entitlement. Business justification: benefit_redemption tracks the consumption/usage of a benefit entitlement. Currently it duplicates benefit_type_code, benefit_name, benefit_description from the entitlement. Adding benefit_entitlement_

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member who fulfilled or delivered the benefit to the guest.

attributes.name: loyalty_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty program member who holds this benefit entitlement.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the hotel property where the benefit was delivered or redeemed.

attributes.name: reservation_booking_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reservation during which the benefit was redeemed. Null if benefit was redeemed outside of a reservation context.

attributes.name: spa_appointment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to spa.appointment. Business justification: Loyalty elite benefits include complimentary spa treatments redeemed at specific appointments. Critical for benefit entitlement validation, spa treatment delivery tracking, and elite member spa benefi

attributes.name: acknowledgment_method
attributes.description: Method by which the member acknowledged benefit receipt: digital signature, email confirmation, mobile app, verbal confirmation, or automatic system acknowledgment.

attributes.name: acknowledgment_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the member acknowledged receipt of the benefit. Null if not acknowledged.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_minutes
attributes.description: Actual time in minutes taken to deliver the benefit from the moment of request or check-in. Used for SLA compliance measurement.

attributes.name: benefit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the benefit: active (available for use), redeemed (fully consumed), expired (past validity date), cancelled (revoked), or pending (awaiting activation).

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Date when the benefit was cancelled or revoked. Null if benefit was not cancelled.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the benefit was cancelled (e.g., member downgrade, policy violation, program termination, member request).

attributes.name: confirmation_number
attributes.description: Reservation confirmation number associated with the benefit redemption. Used for cross-reference with PMS (Property Management System) records.

attributes.name: cost_to_property_amount
attributes.description: Actual cost incurred by the property to deliver this benefit. Used for GOP (Gross Operating Profit) and program ROI (Return on Investment) analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this benefit redemption record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the monetary value amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: delivery_location
attributes.description: Specific location within the property where the benefit was delivered (e.g., 'Front Desk', 'Executive Lounge', 'Room 1205', 'Restaurant - The Grill').

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: First date on which the benefit can be redeemed or used by the member.

attributes.name: entitlement_date
attributes.description: Date when the benefit was granted or became available to the member.

attributes.name: entitlement_source
attributes.description: Origin of the benefit entitlement: tier standard (automatic with membership level), status match (from competitor program), manual grant (by staff), promotion (campaign-driven), or compensation (service recovery).

attributes.name: exception_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an exception occurred during benefit fulfillment (True) or the benefit was delivered as standard (False).

attributes.name: exception_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes explaining the exception circumstances, substitution details, or any special handling required during benefit delivery.

attributes.name: exception_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the type of exception: benefit unavailable, substitution provided, upgrade given, downgrade applied, partial fulfillment, or member declined benefit.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Last date on which the benefit can be redeemed. After this date, the benefit becomes void and cannot be used.

attributes.name: external_reference_code
attributes.description: Identifier from the source system for cross-system reconciliation and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this benefit redemption record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: member_acknowledgment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member acknowledged receipt of the benefit (True) or not (False). Used for service quality tracking and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: monetary_value_amount
attributes.description: Estimated monetary value of the benefit in the property's local currency. Used for program economics tracking and LTV (Lifetime Value) calculations.

attributes.name: points_equivalent
attributes.description: Loyalty points value equivalent of this benefit. Used when members have the option to choose between benefits or points.

attributes.name: redemption_date
attributes.description: Date when the benefit was redeemed or consumed by the member. Null if not yet redeemed.

attributes.name: redemption_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the benefit was redeemed, including time zone. Used for operational tracking and SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance.

attributes.name: remaining_usage_count
attributes.description: Number of redemptions still available for this benefit. Decrements with each usage. Null indicates unlimited remaining usage.

attributes.name: sla_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the benefit was delivered within the program's SLA (Service Level Agreement) standards (True) or not (False). Used for elite service quality tracking.

attributes.name: sla_target_minutes
attributes.description: Target time in minutes within which the benefit should be delivered according to program SLA standards.

attributes.name: substitution_benefit_type
attributes.description: Type of benefit provided as a substitute when the original benefit was unavailable. Null if no substitution occurred.

attributes.name: usage_limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of times this benefit can be redeemed during its validity period. Null indicates unlimited usage within the validity window.

products.name: partner_program
products.description: Master entity representing an external loyalty partner integrated with the hotel loyalty program (airlines, car rental, credit card issuers, retail partners). Captures partner name, partner type, partnership tier (preferred, standard), points transfer ratio (hotel-to-partner and partner-to-hotel), earn eligibility, redemption eligibility, API integration endpoint, contract reference, effective date range, and active status. Governs all partner earn and transfer rules.

attributes.name: partner_program_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the loyalty partner program. Primary key.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: add column property_id (BIGINT) with FK to property.property.property_id - partner programs need property context for redemption eligibility and this table has zero outbound FKs

attributes.name: api_authentication_method
attributes.description: Authentication protocol used for secure API communication with the partner system.

attributes.name: api_integration_endpoint
attributes.description: URL endpoint for the partner's API used for real-time points transfer, balance inquiries, and transaction synchronization.
attributes.references: AHLA Technology Standards, HTNG Web Services Specifications

attributes.name: contract_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the partnership agreement becomes active and points transfer rules take effect.

attributes.name: contract_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the partnership agreement expires or is scheduled for renewal. Null indicates an evergreen or indefinite agreement.

attributes.name: contract_reference_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the legal partnership agreement governing the loyalty program integration, revenue sharing, and operational terms.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the partner program record was first created in the loyalty system.

attributes.name: data_sharing_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether member data can be shared with the partner for personalization and analytics purposes, subject to privacy regulations.

attributes.name: earn_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether loyalty members can earn hotel points through partner transactions (e.g., earning hotel points on partner airline flights).

attributes.name: hotel_to_partner_ratio
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hotel to Partner Points Transfer Ratio
attributes.description: Conversion ratio for transferring hotel loyalty points to partner points (e.g., 1.5000 means 1 hotel point converts to 1.5 partner points).

tag_set.value: Hotel to Partner Points Transfer Ratio

attributes.name: last_sync_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful API synchronization with the partner system for points balance reconciliation.

attributes.name: marketing_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the partner has consented to co-marketing activities and joint promotional campaigns with the hotel loyalty program.

attributes.name: maximum_transfer_amount
attributes.description: Maximum number of points allowed for a single transfer transaction between hotel and partner programs. Null indicates no cap.

attributes.name: minimum_transfer_amount
attributes.description: Minimum number of points required for a single transfer transaction between hotel and partner programs.

attributes.name: partner_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the partner in the loyalty system and API integrations.

attributes.name: partner_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary business contact at the partner organization for operational and technical communications.

attributes.name: partner_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact at the partner organization responsible for the loyalty program integration.

attributes.name: partner_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the primary business contact at the partner organization for urgent escalations and support.

attributes.name: partner_logo_url
attributes.description: URL to the partner's official logo image for display in loyalty program portals, mobile apps, and marketing communications.

attributes.name: partner_name
attributes.description: Official business name of the external loyalty partner organization (e.g., airline, car rental company, credit card issuer, retail partner).

attributes.name: partner_program_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the partner program indicating whether points transfers and earning/redemption activities are enabled.

attributes.name: partner_to_hotel_ratio
attributes.business_glossary_term: Partner to Hotel Points Transfer Ratio
attributes.description: Conversion ratio for transferring partner points to hotel loyalty points (e.g., 0.6667 means 1 partner point converts to 0.6667 hotel points).

tag_set.value: Partner to Hotel Points Transfer Ratio

attributes.name: partner_type
attributes.description: Category of the loyalty partner indicating the industry or service vertical they operate in.

attributes.name: partner_website_url
attributes.description: Official website URL of the partner organization for member reference and marketing materials.

attributes.name: partnership_tier
attributes.description: Classification of the partnership relationship indicating strategic importance and benefit levels (preferred partners receive priority marketing and enhanced transfer ratios).

attributes.name: redemption_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether loyalty members can redeem hotel points for partner rewards (e.g., redeeming hotel points for airline miles).

attributes.name: revenue_share_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of transaction value or points value shared with the partner as part of the commercial agreement.

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for suspending the partner program (e.g., contract dispute, technical integration issues, compliance violation). Populated only when status is suspended.

attributes.name: transfer_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether loyalty members can transfer points bidirectionally between hotel and partner programs.

attributes.name: transfer_processing_time_hours
attributes.description: Expected number of hours for points transfer transactions to complete and reflect in member accounts.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the partner program record was last modified, including changes to transfer ratios, contract terms, or status.

products.name: points_transfer
products.description: Transactional record of a loyalty points transfer between a hotel loyalty account and an external partner program (e.g., airline miles conversion, credit card points transfer). Captures transfer direction (outbound/inbound), partner program, hotel points debited, partner currency credited, conversion rate applied, transfer request date, processing date, partner confirmation number, transfer status (pending, completed, failed, reversed), and fee charged if applicable.

attributes.name: points_transfer_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the loyalty points transfer transaction. Primary key.

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the hotel loyalty program member initiating or receiving the points transfer.

attributes.name: partner_program_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the external partner loyalty program involved in the transfer (e.g., airline frequent flyer program, credit card rewards program).

attributes.name: api_transaction_reference
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier from the partner program API integration, used for technical reconciliation and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the points transfer was successfully completed and confirmed by both systems.

attributes.name: conversion_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate applied to convert hotel points to partner currency or vice versa. Expressed as partner currency units per hotel point.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this transfer record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: failure_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for transfer failure, if status is failed. Null if transfer succeeded.

attributes.name: failure_reason_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of why the transfer failed, providing additional context beyond the failure code.

attributes.name: hotel_points_amount
attributes.description: Number of hotel loyalty points debited (outbound) or credited (inbound) in this transfer transaction.

attributes.name: member_tier_at_transfer
attributes.description: Loyalty program tier status of the member at the time the transfer was requested (e.g., Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to the transfer, such as special handling instructions or customer service remarks.

attributes.name: partner_confirmation_number
attributes.description: Confirmation or transaction reference number provided by the partner program system upon successful transfer completion.

attributes.name: partner_currency_amount
attributes.description: Number of partner program points or miles credited (outbound) or debited (inbound) in this transfer transaction.

attributes.name: partner_member_account_number
attributes.description: Member account number or identifier in the partner loyalty program where points were transferred to or from.

attributes.name: processing_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the system began processing the transfer request.

attributes.name: processing_time_seconds
attributes.description: Total time in seconds taken to process the transfer from request to completion or failure.

attributes.name: promotion_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the promotional campaign under which bonus points were awarded, if applicable.

attributes.name: promotional_bonus_points
attributes.description: Additional bonus points awarded as part of a promotional campaign for completing this transfer. Zero if no promotion applies.

attributes.name: request_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the member submitted the points transfer request.

attributes.name: request_source_ip_address
attributes.description: IP address from which the transfer request originated, captured for security and fraud prevention purposes.
attributes.references: PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard)

attributes.name: request_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the member submitted the points transfer request.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transfer transaction has been reversed. True if reversed, False otherwise.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the transfer was reversed, such as member request, fraud detection, or partner system error.

attributes.name: reversal_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the transfer was reversed, if applicable. Null if not reversed.

attributes.name: tax_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transfer transaction must be reported for tax purposes based on jurisdiction and value thresholds.

attributes.name: transfer_confirmation_number
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric confirmation number assigned to this points transfer transaction, used for tracking and customer service inquiries.

attributes.name: transfer_direction
attributes.description: Direction of the points transfer relative to the hotel loyalty program. Inbound: partner points converted to hotel points. Outbound: hotel points converted to partner currency.

attributes.name: transfer_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee charged to the member for processing the points transfer, if applicable. Zero if no fee applies.

attributes.name: transfer_fee_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transfer fee amount.

attributes.name: transfer_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the points transfer transaction in its lifecycle.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this transfer record was last modified in the system.

products.name: promotion
products.description: Master entity defining loyalty program promotions and bonus offers, including member participation tracking. Captures promotion name, type (bonus points multiplier, double nights, targeted offer, welcome back, birthday bonus, spend challenge), target segment or tier, qualifying criteria (minimum nights, minimum spend, specific properties, specific rate codes), bonus awarded, registration requirement, start/end dates, and budget cap. For member participation: enrollment date, enrollment channel, member promotion status (enrolled, in-progress, completed, expired, awarded), qualifying activity progress, bonus awarded flag, award date, and opt-out date. Drives personalized offer delivery, campaign economics, and promotion fulfillment tracking.
products.reference: Loyalty Promotion / Bonus Offer / Targeted Campaign Offer

attributes.name: promotion_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the loyalty promotion. Primary key.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_budget. Business justification: Promotions consume approved marketing budget. Promotion approval workflow validates budget_consumed_amount against allocated budget. Monthly variance reporting compares actual promotion spend to budge
