attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.member_segment. Business justification: promotion has target_segment (STRING) describing which member segment the promotion targets. Adding member_segment_id FK formalizes this relationship, enabling segment-level promotion management and t

attributes.name: program_config_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.program_config. Business justification: Promotions operate within a program configuration context. Adding program_config_id links each promotion to its governing program instance, enabling program-level promotion management and ensuring pro

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.property. Business justification: Property marketing teams analyze which promotions drive enrollment and stays at their property for campaign ROI measurement. Currently qualifying_property_list is text; FK enables property-level promo

attributes.name: target_guest_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.guest_segment. Business justification: Loyalty promotions target specific marketing guest segments (e.g., high-value leisure travelers, business frequent guests). Campaign design requires defining which guest segment qualifies for each loy

attributes.name: tier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty tier required to participate in this promotion. Null if promotion is open to all tiers. Used to restrict offers to specific membership levels (e.g., Gold, Platinum, Diamond).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this promotion was formally approved for launch. Null if promotion is still in draft or pending approval. Used for campaign governance and audit trail.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Username or employee ID of the manager or director who approved this promotion for launch. Null if promotion is still in draft status. Used for governance and approval workflow tracking.

attributes.name: award_fulfillment_date
attributes.description: Target date by which bonus points or nights will be posted to qualifying members' accounts after promotion completion. Used for member communication and fulfillment SLA (Service Level Agreement) tracking.

attributes.name: bonus_nights_credit
attributes.description: Number of bonus elite-qualifying nights awarded upon promotion completion. Used for tier progression acceleration. Null if promotion does not award night credits.

attributes.name: bonus_points_amount
attributes.description: Fixed number of bonus loyalty points awarded upon successful completion of promotion criteria. Null if bonus is not a fixed point amount (e.g., multiplier-based).

attributes.name: bonus_points_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to base points earned during the promotion period. Example: 2.0 for double points, 1.5 for 50% bonus. Null if promotion awards fixed points rather than a multiplier.

attributes.name: budget_cap_amount
attributes.description: Maximum financial budget allocated for this promotion (total cost of all bonuses awarded). Promotion may be paused or closed early if budget is exhausted. Measured in base currency (typically USD).

attributes.name: budget_consumed_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative financial cost of bonuses awarded to date under this promotion. Updated as members complete qualifying activity and bonuses are posted. Used for budget tracking and ROI (Return on Investment) analysis.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the promotion was cancelled or terminated early. Null if promotion completed normally or is still active. Examples: 'Budget exhausted', 'Low engagement', 'Business priority change', 'Legal compliance issue'.

attributes.name: promotion_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code for the promotion, used in marketing materials and member enrollment. Example: BONUS2024, WELCOME500.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this promotion record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when the promotion expires. Qualifying activity after this date does not count toward the promotion. Null for open-ended promotions.

attributes.name: exclusion_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of member IDs or segments explicitly excluded from this promotion (e.g., employees, test accounts, members who opted out). Null if no exclusions apply.

attributes.name: marketing_channel
attributes.description: Primary marketing channel used to promote this offer. Examples: 'Email', 'Mobile App Push', 'Website Banner', 'Direct Mail', 'Social Media', 'In-Property Signage'. Used for channel attribution and ROI analysis.

attributes.name: minimum_nights
attributes.description: Minimum number of qualifying nights required to earn the promotion bonus. Null if nights are not a qualifying criterion.

attributes.name: minimum_spend_amount
attributes.description: Minimum total spend (in base currency) required to qualify for the promotion. Null if spend is not a qualifying criterion. Typically measured in USD or property local currency.

attributes.name: promotion_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the promotion displayed to members and in marketing channels. Example: 'Double Points Summer Getaway', 'Elite Status Fast Track'.

attributes.name: promotion_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the promotion. Values: draft (being designed), scheduled (approved, not yet live), active (currently running), paused (temporarily suspended), completed (ended successfully), cancelled (terminated early).

attributes.name: promotion_type
attributes.description: Classification of the promotion mechanism. Values: bonus_points_multiplier (earn extra points per dollar), double_nights (accelerate tier qualification), targeted_offer (personalized to segment), welcome_back (re-engagement), birthday_bonus (member birthday reward), spend_challenge (gamified spending goal).

attributes.name: qualifying_criteria_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative of the requirements a member must meet to earn the promotion bonus. Examples: 'Complete 3 stays between June 1 and August 31', 'Spend minimum $500 on F&B (Food and Beverage) during stay', 'Book via mobile app using rate code MOBILE2024'.

attributes.name: qualifying_property_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of property IDs or property codes where stays qualify for this promotion. Null or 'ALL' if promotion applies to all properties. Example: 'PROP001,PROP045,PROP102' or 'ALL'.

attributes.name: qualifying_rate_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of rate codes (BAR - Best Available Rate, corporate codes, promotional codes) that qualify for this promotion. Null or 'ALL' if all rate codes qualify. Example: 'BAR,CORP,PROMO2024'.

attributes.name: registration_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members must explicitly register or opt-in to participate in this promotion. True = registration required before qualifying activity counts; False = automatic enrollment for eligible members.

attributes.name: stackable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotion can be combined with other active promotions. True = member can earn bonuses from multiple promotions simultaneously; False = this promotion cannot be stacked with others.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date when the promotion becomes active and members can begin earning toward the bonus. Qualifying activity before this date does not count.

attributes.name: terms_and_conditions_url
attributes.description: Web link to the full legal terms and conditions document for this promotion. Displayed to members during enrollment and in promotional materials.

attributes.name: total_completions
attributes.description: Count of members who have successfully completed all qualifying criteria and earned the promotion bonus. Used for conversion rate and campaign effectiveness analysis.

attributes.name: total_enrollments
attributes.description: Count of unique members who have enrolled or been auto-enrolled in this promotion. Used for campaign reach and engagement metrics.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this promotion record was last modified. Updated whenever any attribute changes. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or employee ID of the marketing or loyalty team member who created this promotion record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

products.name: promotion_enrollment
products.description: Transactional association record capturing a loyalty member registering or being enrolled in a specific promotion. Captures enrollment date, enrollment channel, promotion status for the member (enrolled, in-progress, completed, expired, awarded), qualifying activity progress (nights completed, spend accumulated), bonus awarded flag, award date, and opt-out date if applicable. Enables promotion fulfillment tracking and member communication triggers.

attributes.name: promotion_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the promotion enrollment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: campaign_execution_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign_execution. Business justification: Tracks which specific marketing campaign execution (email send, paid ad, social post) drove a member to enroll in a loyalty promotion. Critical for marketing attribution and campaign ROI measurement.

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel. Business justification: Promotion enrollments must link to distribution channel for campaign channel attribution analysis, measuring which channels drive highest promotion participation rates, and calculating channel-specifi

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty member who enrolled in the promotion.

attributes.name: promotion_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific promotion the member enrolled in.

attributes.name: award_date
attributes.description: Date when the promotion bonus was awarded to the member's account.

attributes.name: award_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number or transaction ID for the bonus award, used for reconciliation and member inquiries.

attributes.name: award_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the bonus was posted to the member's loyalty account.

attributes.name: bonus_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the bonus awarded (e.g., account credit, voucher value).

attributes.name: bonus_awarded_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the promotion bonus has been awarded to the member (True/False).

attributes.name: bonus_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the bonus amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: bonus_points
attributes.description: Number of bonus loyalty points awarded to the member upon promotion completion.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Date when the enrollment was cancelled by the system or staff.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason for cancellation of the enrollment (e.g., member ineligibility, promotion terminated, fraud detection).

attributes.name: communication_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether enrollment confirmation communication was sent to the member (True/False).

attributes.name: communication_sent_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the enrollment confirmation communication was sent to the member.

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the member completed the qualifying activity requirements for the promotion.

attributes.name: completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the promotion requirements were completed.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this enrollment record was first created in the data platform.

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date when the member enrolled or was enrolled in the promotion.

attributes.name: enrollment_method
attributes.description: Method by which the enrollment occurred (opt-in by member, auto-enrolled by system, staff-enrolled, imported from external source).

attributes.name: enrollment_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for this promotion enrollment, used for member communication and tracking.

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current status of the member's participation in the promotion (enrolled, in-progress, completed, expired, awarded, cancelled, opted-out). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: enrolled|in_progress|completed|expired|awarded|cancelled|opted_out — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: enrollment_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the enrollment was recorded in the system.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the enrollment expires if the member has not completed the promotion requirements.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the enrollment, used for special circumstances or staff annotations.

attributes.name: opt_out_date
attributes.description: Date when the member opted out of the promotion, if applicable.

attributes.name: opt_out_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided by the member or system for opting out of the promotion.

attributes.name: progress_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of qualifying activity completed toward the promotion threshold (0.00 to 100.00).

attributes.name: progress_value
attributes.description: Current progress value toward the qualifying threshold (e.g., 3 nights completed out of 5 required).

attributes.name: property_code
attributes.description: Property code where the enrollment occurred, if applicable (e.g., front desk enrollment).

attributes.name: qualifying_activity_type
attributes.description: Type of activity required to complete the promotion (nights stayed, number of stays, revenue spent, points earned, transactions, referrals).

attributes.name: qualifying_threshold
attributes.description: Target threshold value the member must achieve to complete the promotion (e.g., 5 nights, 1000 points, 500 USD revenue).

attributes.name: qualifying_threshold_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the qualifying threshold (nights, stays, points, currency, transactions, referrals).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this enrollment record in the source system, used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: tier_at_enrollment
attributes.description: Loyalty tier of the member at the time of enrollment, used for tier-specific promotion eligibility and tracking.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this enrollment record was last modified in the data platform.

products.name: member_preference
products.description: Master record of a loyalty member's stated and inferred preferences used to personalize the hospitality experience. Captures preference category (room type, pillow type, floor preference, amenity preferences, dietary restrictions, communication channel, language, newspaper, housekeeping schedule), preference source (stated at enrollment, updated via app, inferred from stay history), confidence level, and last updated date. Distinct from guest domain preferences as this is loyalty-program-managed personalization data.
products.reference: Member Preference Profile / Guest Preference Record

attributes.name: member_preference_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member preference record. Primary key.

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty member who holds this preference. Links to the loyalty member master record.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.property. Business justification: Property guest services teams honor member preferences (e.g., 'never book me at this property', 'preferred property for business travel') during reservation and check-in. Currently restricted_property

attributes.name: brand_restriction
attributes.description: The brand code if this preference is restricted to a specific brand within the portfolio. Nullable if preference applies across all brands.

attributes.name: confidence_level
attributes.description: The confidence or reliability level of this preference. Stated preferences have highest confidence; inferred preferences are scored based on frequency and recency of observed behavior.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this preference record was first created in the loyalty system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this preference becomes active and should be applied to member experiences.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date after which this preference is no longer valid or should no longer be applied. Nullable for preferences with no expiration.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: last_confirmed_date
attributes.description: The date when the member explicitly confirmed or reaffirmed this preference. Distinct from last_updated_date which may include system-inferred updates.

attributes.name: last_observed_date
attributes.description: The most recent date when this preference was observed in a stay or interaction. Used for recency scoring in confidence calculations.

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: The date when this preference was last modified or confirmed by the member or system. Used to track recency for confidence scoring.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or additional context about this preference. May include special instructions, member comments, or operational guidance.

attributes.name: observation_count
attributes.description: The number of times this preference has been observed in the member's stay history or interactions. Used to calculate confidence level for inferred preferences.

attributes.name: override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this preference can be overridden by operational constraints or property-level decisions. True if override is allowed; false if preference must be honored.

attributes.name: preference_category
attributes.description: The category or domain of the preference (e.g., room type, pillow type, floor preference, amenity preferences, dietary restrictions, communication channel, language, newspaper, housekeeping schedule). Classifies the type of personalization being captured. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: room_type|pillow_type|floor_preference|amenity|dietary_restriction|communication_channel|language|newspaper|housekeeping_schedule — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: preference_source
attributes.description: The origin or channel through which this preference was captured (e.g., stated at enrollment, updated via mobile app, updated via website, captured by call center, inferred from stay history, imported from PMS profile).

attributes.name: preference_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this preference record. Active preferences are used for personalization; inactive or expired preferences are retained for historical analysis.

attributes.name: preference_value
attributes.description: The specific value or selection for this preference (e.g., 'King Bed', 'Hypoallergenic Pillow', 'High Floor', 'Vegetarian', 'Email'). Free-text or structured value depending on category.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: The priority or importance ranking of this preference relative to other preferences for the same member. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used when preferences conflict.

attributes.name: property_restriction
attributes.description: Indicates whether this preference applies to all properties, a specific property, a brand, or a region. Supports property-specific personalization.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this preference record in the source system. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this preference record was last modified. Audit trail for record updates.

products.name: program_config
products.description: Reference master storing the global configuration parameters of the loyalty program. Captures program name, program version, currency name (points, miles, credits), points-to-currency conversion rate, tier year definition (calendar vs. rolling 12-month), minimum redemption threshold, maximum earn per stay, points expiry policy (inactivity period, rolling expiry window), program terms version, GDPR/CCPA data retention policy, breakage assumption rate, and active status. Single configuration record governing program-wide business rules and program economics assumptions.

attributes.name: program_config_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the loyalty program configuration record. Primary key. This is the single source of truth configuration governing program-wide business rules and economics.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user or administrator who last modified this configuration record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: api_integration_enabled_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: API (Application Programming Interface) Integration Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether external systems can integrate with this loyalty program via API. True = API access available for partners and properties; False = manual integration only.

tag_set.value: API (Application Programming Interface) Integration Enabled Flag

attributes.name: breakage_assumption_rate
attributes.description: Estimated percentage of earned points that will never be redeemed (e.g., 0.1500 = 15%). Used for USALI-compliant revenue recognition and liability estimation. Based on historical redemption patterns.

attributes.name: cash_plus_points_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members can combine cash and points for redemptions. True = hybrid payment allowed; False = points-only or cash-only redemptions.

attributes.name: ccpa_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this program configuration meets CCPA requirements for California resident data. True = CCPA controls implemented; False = non-California program or pending compliance.

tag_set.value: CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act) Compliant Flag

attributes.name: configuration_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this specific configuration version became effective. Used for time-based rule application and member communication of program changes.

attributes.name: configuration_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when this configuration version expires and is replaced by a new version. Null if currently active with no planned end date.

attributes.name: contact_center_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for member inquiries and loyalty program support. Used for member communication and published on program website.

attributes.name: contact_center_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number for member services and loyalty program support. Used for member communication materials and website display.

attributes.name: conversion_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the points-to-currency conversion rate (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). Defines the monetary unit for program economics.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this configuration record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_name
attributes.description: Name of the loyalty currency unit (e.g., 'Points', 'Miles', 'Credits', 'Stars'). This is the term displayed to members for their balance.

attributes.name: data_retention_policy_months
attributes.description: Number of months member data is retained after account closure, per GDPR and CCPA requirements. After this period, PII is purged per right-to-erasure regulations.

attributes.name: family_pooling_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members can pool points with family members into a shared account. True = pooling allowed; False = pooling disabled.

attributes.name: gdpr_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this program configuration meets GDPR requirements for EU member data. True = GDPR controls implemented; False = non-EU program or pending compliance.

tag_set.value: GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) Compliant Flag

attributes.name: gifting_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members can gift points to other members. True = gifting allowed; False = gifting disabled. Subject to anti-fraud controls.

attributes.name: inactivity_period_months
attributes.description: Number of months of account inactivity (no earn or redeem transactions) before points expire, if points_expiry_policy is 'inactivity_based'. Null otherwise.

attributes.name: liability_estimation_method
attributes.description: Accounting method for estimating loyalty program liability. incremental_cost = cost to fulfill; fair_value = market value of rewards; redemption_value = points * conversion rate. Must align with USALI and ASC 606.

attributes.name: lifetime_status_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the program offers lifetime elite status after achieving cumulative thresholds. True = lifetime tiers available; False = annual re-qualification required.

attributes.name: maximum_earn_per_stay
attributes.description: Maximum number of points a member can earn from a single stay, regardless of spend. Null if no cap applies. Used to manage program liability.

attributes.name: minimum_redemption_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum number of points required to initiate any redemption transaction. Prevents micro-redemptions and reduces operational costs.

attributes.name: mobile_app_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a dedicated mobile application is available for this loyalty program. True = mobile app available; False = web-only access.

attributes.name: partner_transfer_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members can transfer points to partner programs (airlines, car rentals, etc.). True = transfers allowed; False = transfers disabled.

attributes.name: points_expiry_policy
attributes.description: Rule governing when points expire. no_expiry = points never expire; inactivity_based = expire after N months of no activity; fixed_period = expire after N months from earn date; rolling_expiry = expire on a rolling window.

attributes.name: points_purchase_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members can purchase additional points with cash. True = purchase allowed; False = earn-only program. Subject to regulatory limits in some jurisdictions.

attributes.name: points_to_currency_conversion_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate for converting loyalty points to monetary value (e.g., 0.0100 means 100 points = 1 USD). Used for redemption valuation and breakage accounting per USALI standards.

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this loyalty program in operational systems (e.g., 'HNRS', 'ELITE01'). Used for system integration and reporting.

attributes.name: program_launch_date
attributes.description: Date when the loyalty program was originally launched. Used for program anniversary communications and historical analysis.

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Official marketing name of the loyalty program (e.g., 'Honors Rewards', 'Elite Guest Club'). This is the customer-facing brand name.

attributes.name: program_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the loyalty program. Active programs accept enrollments and transactions; suspended programs are temporarily paused; sunset programs are being phased out.

attributes.name: program_terms_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the legal terms and conditions document governing this program configuration. Links to the published T&C document for member consent and compliance.

attributes.name: program_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the program configuration (e.g., '2.1', '3.0.1'). Incremented when program rules or economics change materially.

attributes.name: program_website_url
attributes.description: Primary website URL for the loyalty program where members can view terms, check balances, and redeem rewards. Used for marketing and member self-service.

attributes.name: program_year_start_month
attributes.description: Month number (1-12) when the program year begins if tier_year_definition is 'program_year'. Null for calendar or rolling definitions. 1=January, 12=December.

attributes.name: rolling_expiry_window_months
attributes.description: Number of months from earn date after which points expire, if points_expiry_policy is 'rolling_expiry'. Null otherwise. Example: 24 means points earned on Jan 1, 2023 expire Jan 1, 2025.

attributes.name: status_match_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the program offers status matching from competitor loyalty programs. True = status match campaigns allowed; False = earn-only tier qualification.

attributes.name: terms_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the current program terms and conditions became effective. Used for member communication and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: tier_rollover_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether qualifying nights/stays can roll over to the next qualification period if a member exceeds their tier threshold. True = rollover allowed; False = no rollover.

attributes.name: tier_year_definition
attributes.description: Method for calculating the qualification period for tier status. Calendar = Jan 1 - Dec 31; rolling_12_month = trailing 12 months from any date; program_year = custom fiscal period.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this configuration record was last modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data synchronization.

products.name: member_segment
products.description: Master entity defining loyalty member segments used for targeted marketing, personalized offers, and retention campaigns. Captures segment name, segment code, segmentation basis (tier, LTV band, recency-frequency-monetary, geographic, behavioral), inclusion criteria, segment owner (marketing or loyalty operations), effective date, active status, and temporal member assignment records (member_id, assignment_date, assignment_method, confidence_score, effective/expiry dates). This product owns both segment definitions AND the versioned member-to-segment mappings, enabling campaign targeting with historical segment attribution. Distinct from guest domain segmentation — this is loyalty-program-specific segmentation for program economics and CRM targeting.
products.reference: Loyalty Segment / Member Segment / CRM Segment

attributes.name: member_segment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the loyalty member segment definition. Primary key.

attributes.name: loyalty_member_id
attributes.description: add column loyalty_member_id (BIGINT) with FK to loyalty.member.member_id - member segments should link to actual members for segment assignment

attributes.name: marketing_guest_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.guest_segment. Business justification: Loyalty member segments often map to broader marketing guest segments for unified targeting across loyalty and marketing campaigns. Enables coordinated segmentation strategy and prevents conflicting a

attributes.name: primary_member_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system account that created this segment definition. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: allow_overlap_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members can belong to this segment simultaneously with other segments (true) or if this segment is mutually exclusive with others (false).

attributes.name: brand_restriction
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of brand codes (luxury, premium, select-service) that limit segment membership. Empty if no brand restriction applies.

attributes.name: campaign_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members in this segment are eligible for targeted marketing campaigns (true) or if this is an analytical-only segment (false).

attributes.name: confidence_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum confidence score (0.0000-1.0000) required for model-driven segment assignment. Null if not model-driven. Used to control precision vs. recall trade-off.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this segment definition record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: current_member_count
attributes.description: Actual number of members currently assigned to this segment as of the last refresh or calculation run. Updated periodically based on refresh frequency.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this segment definition becomes active and available for use in campaigns and targeting. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: engagement_score_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum engagement score (0-100 scale) required for segment membership. Null if engagement score is not a criterion. Used for behavioral segmentation.

attributes.name: exclusion_criteria
attributes.description: Business rules defining conditions that disqualify a member from this segment even if inclusion criteria are met (e.g., account_closure_date IS NOT NULL, communication_opt_in=false).

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this segment definition is no longer valid or active. Null for segments with no planned end date. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: geographic_restriction
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of country codes (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3) or region codes that limit segment membership. Empty if no geographic restriction applies.

attributes.name: inclusion_criteria
attributes.description: Detailed business rules and conditions that define member eligibility for this segment (e.g., tier=Platinum AND ytd_nights>=50 AND last_stay_date<=90 days). Stored as human-readable text or structured expression.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this segment definition record was last updated. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: last_refresh_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when member assignments to this segment were last recalculated and updated. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: maximum_ltv
attributes.description: Maximum lifetime value threshold for segment membership. Null if no upper LTV bound applies. Used to define LTV bands or exclude ultra-high-value guests.

attributes.name: maximum_nights
attributes.description: Maximum number of lifetime or qualifying-period nights for segment membership. Null if no upper nights bound applies.

attributes.name: minimum_ltv
attributes.description: Minimum lifetime value threshold required for segment membership. Null if LTV is not a criterion for this segment. Used for high-value guest targeting.

attributes.name: minimum_nights
attributes.description: Minimum number of lifetime or qualifying-period nights required for segment membership. Null if nights are not a criterion.

attributes.name: minimum_stays
attributes.description: Minimum number of lifetime or qualifying-period stays required for segment membership. Null if stays are not a criterion.

attributes.name: model_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the predictive model used for this segment. Null if not model-driven. Enables model lineage and reproducibility.

attributes.name: next_refresh_timestamp
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time for the next recalculation of member assignments to this segment. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional comments, business context, or operational notes about this segment definition. Used for documentation and knowledge transfer.

attributes.name: nps_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum NPS score required for segment membership. Null if NPS is not a criterion. Used to segment promoters, passives, and detractors.

attributes.name: personalization_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether personalized offers and content should be generated for members in this segment (true) or if standard communications apply (false).

attributes.name: predictive_model_name
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the machine learning or predictive model used to assign members to this segment (e.g., Churn_Risk_Model_v2, Upsell_Propensity_RF). Null if not model-driven.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric ranking used to resolve conflicts when a member qualifies for multiple segments. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used for campaign targeting hierarchy.

attributes.name: property_restriction
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of property codes that limit segment membership to guests of specific hotels or resorts. Empty if no property restriction applies.

attributes.name: recency_days
attributes.description: Number of days since last stay used as a criterion for segment membership (e.g., lapsed guests with no stay in last 90 days). Null if recency is not a criterion.

attributes.name: refresh_frequency
attributes.description: How often member assignments to this segment are recalculated and updated (e.g., real-time, daily batch, weekly, monthly, quarterly, on-demand, event-driven upon specific triggers). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: real_time|daily|weekly|monthly|quarterly|on_demand|event_driven — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: salt_score_threshold
attributes.business_glossary_term: Satisfaction and Loyalty Tracking (SALT) Score Threshold
attributes.description: Minimum SALT score required for segment membership. Null if SALT score is not a criterion. Used for satisfaction-based segmentation.

tag_set.value: Satisfaction and Loyalty Tracking (SALT) Score Threshold

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the segment for operational use and system integration (e.g., HVG_PLAT, LAPSED_90D, RFM_TOP10).

attributes.name: segment_description
attributes.description: Detailed business description of the segment purpose, target audience characteristics, and intended use cases for marketing and retention campaigns.

attributes.name: segment_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the loyalty member segment used in marketing campaigns and reporting (e.g., High-Value Gold Members, Lapsed 90-Day Guests).

attributes.name: segment_owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the business unit, team, or individual responsible for managing this segment (e.g., Loyalty Marketing, CRM Operations, Regional Marketing EMEA).

attributes.name: segment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the segment definition: active (in use), inactive (not currently used), draft (under development), archived (historical reference), suspended (temporarily disabled).

attributes.name: segment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the segment by its business purpose: strategic (long-term program design), tactical (short-term campaigns), campaign-specific, operational (day-to-day targeting), analytical (reporting/insights), or regulatory (compliance-driven).

attributes.name: segmentation_basis
attributes.description: The primary methodology or dimension used to define this segment (e.g., tier-based, LTV band, RFM analysis, geographic region, behavioral patterns, engagement score, spend level, recency, frequency, predictive model, custom criteria). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tier|ltv_band|rfm|geographic|behavioral|engagement|spend|recency|frequency|predictive|custom — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: target_population_size
attributes.description: Expected or target number of members that should fall into this segment based on historical data or business planning. Used for campaign sizing and resource allocation.

attributes.name: tier_restriction
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of loyalty tier codes that are eligible for this segment. Empty if no tier restriction applies. Used to limit segment membership by tier level.

products.name: certificate
products.description: Master entity representing a loyalty certificate or voucher issued to a member as a reward, compensation, or promotional benefit. Captures certificate type (free night award, room upgrade certificate, F&B credit, spa voucher, airline miles certificate), face value, points cost or complimentary basis, issue date, expiry date, redemption status (issued, redeemed, expired, voided), associated reservation on redemption, and issuing channel. Distinct from the redemption transaction — this is the instrument itself.
products.reference: Loyalty Certificate / Free Night Award / Reward Voucher

attributes.name: certificate_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the loyalty certificate or voucher. Primary key.
attributes.references: HTNG (Hotel Technology Next Generation) - Loyalty Data Standards

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier that voided the certificate. Null if not voided.

products.name: fraud_alert
products.description: Transactional record of suspected or confirmed fraudulent activity on a loyalty member account. Captures alert type (account takeover, unauthorized redemption, points theft, manufactured spending, velocity abuse, credential stuffing), detection method (rule-based, ML model, manual report, partner notification), alert severity, member account affected, triggering transaction references, investigation status (open, investigating, confirmed_fraud, false_positive, closed), resolution action taken (account freeze, points reversal, password reset, account closure), investigating agent, and resolution date. Enables fraud operations team workflow and supports regulatory reporting on loyalty program abuse.

attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty member account affected by the suspected or confirmed fraudulent activity.

attributes.name: partner_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the partner program if the fraud alert involves partner points transfer or partner-originated activity. Null if fraud is internal to hotel loyalty program.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.privacy_incident. attributes.name: account_frozen_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member account was frozen as a result of this fraud alert. True if account is currently frozen; false otherwise.

attributes.name: account_frozen_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the member account was frozen due to fraud alert. Null if account was not frozen.

attributes.name: alert_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique business identifier for the fraud alert, formatted as FA- followed by 10 digits.

attributes.name: alert_severity
attributes.description: Severity level of the fraud alert based on potential financial impact, member risk, and program integrity threat. Critical indicates immediate action required with significant financial or reputational risk; high indicates substantial risk requiring urgent investigation; medium indicates moderate risk requiring timely review; low indicates minor risk for routine investigation.

attributes.name: alert_status
attributes.description: Current status of the fraud alert in the investigation workflow. Open indicates alert created and awaiting assignment; investigating indicates active investigation in progress; confirmed_fraud indicates fraud validated and resolution actions taken; false_positive indicates alert determined to be legitimate activity; closed indicates investigation completed and case archived.

attributes.name: alert_type
attributes.description: Classification of the suspected or confirmed fraudulent activity type. Account takeover indicates unauthorized access to member account; unauthorized redemption indicates points redeemed without member consent; points theft indicates fraudulent points accrual or transfer; manufactured spending indicates artificial transaction generation to earn points; velocity abuse indicates abnormal transaction frequency or volume; credential stuffing indicates automated login attempts using stolen credentials.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the fraud alert record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the monetary value involved in the fraud alert.

attributes.name: detection_method
attributes.description: Method by which the fraudulent activity was detected. Rule-based indicates detection by predefined business rules; ML model indicates detection by machine learning algorithm; manual report indicates detection by fraud analyst review; partner notification indicates alert received from partner program; member report indicates member-initiated fraud report.

attributes.name: detection_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the fraudulent activity was first detected by the system or reported. Represents the business event time of fraud discovery.

attributes.name: false_positive_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the fraud alert was determined to be a false positive. Documents legitimate business activity that triggered the alert. Null if alert was not classified as false positive.

attributes.name: geolocation_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code derived from source IP address geolocation. Used to identify suspicious cross-border activity.

attributes.name: investigation_assigned_to
attributes.description: User identifier of the fraud analyst or investigator assigned to review and resolve the alert. Null if alert is unassigned.

attributes.name: investigation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the investigation process, findings, evidence reviewed, and analyst observations. Confidential operational information.

attributes.name: investigation_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when investigation of the fraud alert was initiated by an analyst. Null if investigation has not yet started.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the fraud alert record was last updated. Audit trail for data lineage and change tracking.

attributes.name: law_enforcement_case_number
attributes.description: Case or reference number provided by law enforcement agency if fraud was reported. Null if not reported to authorities.

attributes.name: law_enforcement_notified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether law enforcement authorities were notified of the confirmed fraud. True if notification occurred; false otherwise.

attributes.name: member_notification_channel
attributes.description: Communication channel used to notify the member of the fraud alert. Email indicates electronic mail; SMS indicates text message; phone indicates voice call; mail indicates postal mail; in_app indicates mobile application notification.

attributes.name: member_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the loyalty member was notified of the fraud alert. Null if member was not notified.

attributes.name: member_notified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the loyalty member was notified of the fraud alert and investigation. True if member was contacted; false otherwise.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 33, CCPA, Internal Member Communication Standard

attributes.name: model_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the fraud detection model or rule set that generated the alert. Enables tracking of model performance and alert quality over time.

attributes.name: monetary_value_involved
attributes.description: Estimated monetary value of the fraudulent activity in the program's base currency. Calculated based on points value, cash redemptions, or other financial impact.

attributes.name: points_amount_involved
attributes.description: Total number of loyalty points involved in the suspected or confirmed fraudulent activity. Null if fraud does not involve points movement.

attributes.name: points_reversed_amount
attributes.description: Number of loyalty points reversed or clawed back from the member account as part of fraud resolution. Null if no points reversal occurred.

attributes.name: regulatory_report_submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when regulatory report was submitted to authorities. Null if no regulatory reporting was required or report not yet submitted.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fraud alert meets thresholds requiring regulatory reporting to authorities or industry bodies. True if reporting is required; false otherwise.
attributes.references: PCI DSS, SOX, Internal Compliance Standard

attributes.name: resolution_action
attributes.description: Action taken to resolve the fraud alert. Account freeze indicates temporary suspension of account activity; points reversal indicates fraudulent points removed from account; password reset indicates forced credential change; account closure indicates permanent account termination; no action indicates alert closed without intervention; member notification indicates member contacted regarding suspicious activity.

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the resolution decision, actions taken, and final outcome. Confidential operational information.

attributes.name: resolution_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the fraud alert was resolved and final action taken. Null if alert remains open or under investigation.

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Numerical risk score assigned by fraud detection system, typically ranging from 0.00 to 100.00, with higher scores indicating greater fraud likelihood. Generated by rule-based engine or ML model.

attributes.name: source_channel
attributes.description: Business channel through which the triggering transaction or activity occurred. Web indicates website; mobile_app indicates mobile application; call_center indicates phone reservation or service; property indicates on-property transaction; partner indicates partner program; API indicates system-to-system integration.

attributes.name: source_device_type
attributes.description: Type of device used for the triggering transaction or activity. Desktop indicates web browser on computer; mobile indicates smartphone; tablet indicates tablet device; API indicates programmatic access; unknown indicates device type could not be determined.

attributes.name: source_ip_address
attributes.description: Internet Protocol address associated with the triggering transaction or suspicious activity. Used for fraud pattern analysis and geolocation. May be considered PII in some jurisdictions.

attributes.name: triggering_transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of loyalty program transaction or activity that triggered the fraud alert. Identifies the specific action that raised suspicion.

products.name: package_purchase
products.description: This association product represents the transactional event of a loyalty member purchasing or redeeming a spa package. It captures purchase-specific data including purchase date, expiration, sessions tracking, redemption method, and pricing that exists only in the context of this specific purchase transaction. Each record links one member to one spa package purchase instance with temporal and financial attributes.. Existence Justification: In travel hospitality loyalty programs, members purchase or redeem spa packages multiple times over their membership lifecycle, and each spa package catalog item is purchased by many different members. The business actively manages these purchase transactions as distinct operational records, tracking purchase-specific data such as purchase date, expiration, sessions remaining, redemption method (points vs. cash), and purchase price. This is not a reference relationship but a transactional event that creates an entitlement record.

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the loyalty member who purchased or redeemed the spa package

attributes.name: package_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the spa package catalog item that was purchased

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the hotel or resort property where this package was purchased or is valid for use. May differ from member's home property.

attributes.name: confirmation_number
attributes.description: Unique confirmation code provided to the member for this package purchase. Used for lookup and verification at spa reception.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this package purchase record was created. Used for audit and operational tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the purchase price. Supports multi-currency operations.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when this package purchase expires and can no longer be used. Calculated based on package validity rules and purchase date.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this package purchase record was last updated. Tracks status changes and session usage updates.

attributes.name: package_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this package purchase. Tracks whether the entitlement is active, in use, exhausted, or no longer valid.

attributes.name: points_redeemed
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points redeemed by the member to purchase or partially pay for this package. Zero if purchased with cash only.

attributes.name: purchase_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the member purchased this spa package. Used for channel attribution and member behavior analysis.

attributes.name: purchase_date
attributes.description: Date when the member purchased or redeemed this spa package. Marks the beginning of the entitlement period.

attributes.name: purchase_price
attributes.description: Actual price paid by the member for this package purchase. May differ from rack rate due to promotions, member discounts, or dynamic pricing.

attributes.name: sessions_included
attributes.description: Total number of spa sessions or treatments included in this package purchase. Defines the entitlement quantity.

attributes.name: sessions_used
attributes.description: Number of sessions or treatments from this package that the member has already consumed. Used to track remaining entitlement.

products.name: promotion_distribution
products.description: This association product represents the distribution contract between loyalty promotions and distribution channels. It captures channel-specific promotion configuration, budget allocation, performance targets, and rate adjustments that exist only when a specific promotion is made available through a specific channel. Each record links one promotion to one distribution channel with attributes governing how that promotion is presented, priced, and tracked in that channel.. Existence Justification: In travel hospitality operations, loyalty promotions are strategically distributed across multiple channels with channel-specific configurations. A single promotion (e.g., 'Double Points Summer') is simultaneously available through direct web, mobile app, OTA partners, and GDS with different rate multipliers, budget allocations, and display priorities per channel. Conversely, each distribution channel carries multiple concurrent promotions targeting different segments and travel periods. Marketing teams actively manage these promotion-channel distributions as operational records with performance tracking, budget monitoring, and channel-specific start/end dates.

attributes.name: promotion_distribution_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this promotion-channel distribution record. Primary key.

attributes.name: distribution_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the distribution channel carrying this promotion

attributes.name: promotion_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the loyalty promotion being distributed through this channel

attributes.description: add column property_id (BIGINT) with FK to property.property.property_id - promotion distributions target specific properties

attributes.name: actual_bookings

attributes.name: budget_allocation_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the total promotion budget allocated specifically to this distribution channel. Sum of all channel allocations should not exceed promotion.budget_cap_amount. Identified in detection phase.

attributes.name: budget_consumed_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative amount of the channel-specific budget consumed by bonuses awarded through this channel. Tracks against budget_allocation_amount.

attributes.name: channel_priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric rank controlling the display priority of this promotion within this channel when multiple promotions are active. Lower numbers = higher priority. Identified in detection phase.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this promotion-channel distribution record was created in the system.

attributes.name: distribution_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this promotion distribution in this channel. Values: scheduled (configured but not yet live), active (currently available), paused (temporarily suspended), completed (ended normally), cancelled (terminated early).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this promotion becomes available for booking through this specific channel. May differ from promotion.start_date to support phased rollout strategies. Identified in detection phase.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when this promotion is no longer available through this channel. May differ from promotion.end_date to support channel-specific campaign windows. Identified in detection phase.

attributes.name: performance_target_bookings
attributes.description: Target number of qualifying bookings expected from this promotion through this channel. Used for channel performance tracking and ROI analysis. Identified in detection phase.

attributes.name: promotion_rate_multiplier
attributes.description: Channel-specific adjustment multiplier applied to the base promotion bonus for this distribution channel. Allows different bonus rates by channel (e.g., 2.0x for direct web, 1.5x for OTA). Identified in detection phase.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or employee ID of the marketing team member who configured this promotion for distribution through this channel.

products.name: promotion_treatment_rule
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between promotion and treatment. It captures the specific terms under which a loyalty promotion applies to a spa treatment, including bonus multipliers, discounts, spend thresholds, and redemption limits. Each record links one promotion to one treatment with attributes that exist only in the context of this relationship. This enables the business to configure promotion-specific treatment rules that are neither promotion-global nor treatment-intrinsic.. Existence Justification: In the travel hospitality loyalty business, promotions are frequently designed to incentivize specific service categories, including spa treatments. A single promotion (e.g., 'Summer Wellness Bonus') applies to multiple spa treatments (massage, facial, body wrap), and a single treatment can be included in multiple concurrent or overlapping promotions (e.g., 'Double Points on Spa', 'Birthday Month 20% Off', 'Elite Member Spa Discount'). The business actively manages promotion-treatment rules with treatment-specific terms such as bonus multipliers, discount percentages, spend thresholds, and redemption caps that are neither global to the promotion nor intrinsic to the treatment.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the loyalty promotion offering the bonus or discount

attributes.name: bonus_points_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to base loyalty points earned when this treatment is purchased under this promotion. Example: 2.0 means double points. This is promotion-treatment specific and may differ from the promotion's global multiplier.

attributes.description: Timestamp when this promotion-treatment rule was created in the system.

attributes.name: current_redemptions
attributes.description: Running count of how many times this promotion-treatment combination has been redeemed to date. Updated at point-of-sale.

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to the treatment price when purchased under this promotion. Example: 15.00 means 15% off. This is specific to the promotion-treatment combination.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this specific promotion-treatment rule expires. May differ from the promotion's overall end date if treatments are removed early.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this specific promotion-treatment rule becomes active. May differ from the promotion's overall start date if treatments are added mid-campaign.

attributes.name: maximum_redemptions
attributes.description: Maximum number of times this promotion can be applied to this treatment across all members. Used to cap exposure on high-value treatments within a broader promotion.

attributes.name: minimum_spend

attributes.name: rule_status
