attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Inventory Controls; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: lift_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the restriction was lifted or removed, re-opening inventory on the affected channel. Null if the restriction is still active or has not yet been lifted.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Inventory Control Lift; IDeaS G3 RMS Inventory Controls

attributes.name: lifted_by_user
attributes.description: Username or employee identifier of the user who lifted or removed this restriction. Null if the restriction has not been lifted or was lifted automatically by the system.

attributes.name: market_segment_code
attributes.description: Market segment code (e.g., TRANSIENT, GROUP, CORPORATE, LEISURE, MICE) to which this restriction is scoped. Null if the restriction applies across all market segments. Aligns with USALI market segmentation standards.
attributes.references: USALI Market Segmentation; IDeaS G3 RMS Market Segment Configuration; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: max_los
attributes.description: Maximum number of nights a guest is permitted to stay when booking on this channel during the restricted date range. Applicable when restriction_type is max_los. Null for non-LOS restriction types.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS LOS Controls; Sabre SynXis CRS LOS Restrictions; HTNG Inventory Control Standards

attributes.name: min_los
attributes.description: Minimum number of nights a guest must stay to be eligible for booking on this channel during the restricted date range. Applicable when restriction_type is min_los. Null for non-LOS restriction types.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS LOS Controls; Sabre SynXis CRS LOS Restrictions; HTNG Inventory Control Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or comments entered by the revenue manager or channel manager regarding this restriction. May include context about competitive positioning, demand events, or channel negotiation details.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: occupancy_at_apply
attributes.description: Property or room-type occupancy percentage at the time the restriction was applied. Provides context for the revenue management decision and supports post-hoc analysis of restriction effectiveness. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 85.50 = 85.50%).
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Occupancy Metrics; STR STAR Report OCC Benchmarking; USALI

attributes.name: rate_parity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this stop-sell action was triggered by a rate parity breach on the affected channel. True when the restriction is applied to enforce rate parity compliance across distribution channels.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Rate Parity Monitoring; HTNG Channel Distribution Standards; OTA Rate Parity Agreements

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the business reason for applying the stop-sell or restriction. Examples include: HIGH_DEMAND, RATE_PARITY_BREACH, CHANNEL_PERFORMANCE, OVERBOOKING_PROTECTION, RENOVATION, ALLOTMENT_EXHAUSTED. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: HIGH_DEMAND|RATE_PARITY_BREACH|CHANNEL_PERFORMANCE|OVERBOOKING_PROTECTION|RENOVATION|ALLOTMENT_EXHAUSTED|SYSTEM_AUTO — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Inventory Controls; Sabre SynXis CRS Restriction Reason Codes

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative providing additional context or justification for the restriction beyond the standardized reason code. Entered by the revenue manager or channel manager at the time of action.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Inventory Controls; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: restriction_duration_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days spanned by the restriction date range (stay_date_to minus stay_date_from + 1). Supports analysis of restriction scope and revenue impact assessment.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Inventory Controls; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: restriction_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this stop-sell or restriction control action, as generated by the CRS (Sabre SynXis) or channel manager. Used for cross-system traceability and audit reconciliation.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Inventory Control Reference; HTNG Inventory Control Standards

attributes.name: restriction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the stop-sell or restriction control record. active: restriction is currently enforced; lifted: restriction has been removed; pending: restriction is queued for activation; cancelled: restriction was voided before activation; expired: restriction passed its scheduled end without explicit lift.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Inventory Control Lifecycle; IDeaS G3 RMS Inventory Controls

attributes.name: restriction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the inventory restriction being applied to the channel. stop_sell: no new bookings accepted; closed_to_arrival (CTA): no check-ins on the stay date; closed_to_departure (CTD): no check-outs on the stay date; min_los: minimum Length of Stay (LOS) required; max_los: maximum LOS allowed; close_out: full inventory closure.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Inventory Controls; Sabre SynXis CRS Restriction Types; HTNG Inventory Control Standards

attributes.name: revpar_at_apply
attributes.business_glossary_term: Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR) at Apply
attributes.description: Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR) for the affected property or room type at the time the restriction was applied. Key revenue management KPI used to contextualize the stop-sell decision and evaluate channel mix optimization outcomes.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS RevPAR Metrics; STR STAR Report RevPAR Benchmarking; USALI

tag_set.value: Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR) at Apply

attributes.name: stay_date_from
attributes.description: First stay date (inclusive) in the date range to which this restriction applies. Represents the beginning of the affected inventory window in the property calendar.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Date Range Controls; IDeaS G3 RMS Inventory Controls

attributes.name: stay_date_to
attributes.description: Last stay date (inclusive) in the date range to which this restriction applies. Represents the end of the affected inventory window in the property calendar.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Date Range Controls; IDeaS G3 RMS Inventory Controls

attributes.name: transmission_status
attributes.description: Status of the restriction transmission to the distribution channel via the CRS or channel manager. pending: queued for transmission; transmitted: sent to channel; confirmed: acknowledged by channel; failed: transmission error; retrying: re-attempting after failure. Critical for ensuring inventory control actions are successfully propagated.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS API Integration; HTNG Channel Connectivity Standards; SLA Compliance

attributes.name: transmission_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the restriction was successfully transmitted to the distribution channel via the CRS or channel manager. Null if transmission is pending or failed. Supports SLA monitoring for inventory control propagation.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS API Integration; HTNG Channel Connectivity Standards; SLA Compliance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording the most recent modification to this restriction record, such as a status change, date range extension, or reason code update.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (data integrity); SOX Section 404 (audit trail)

products.name: metasearch_listing
products.description: Master records for property listings on metasearch platforms (Google Hotel Ads, TripAdvisor, Trivago, Kayak, Skyscanner). Captures listing status, bid strategy (CPC, CPA, commission-based), bid amounts by market and device, property display rank, click-through and conversion rates, cost metrics, and direct booking attribution. Supports metasearch investment optimization, bid management, and measurement of metasearch contribution to direct booking revenue.

attributes.name: metasearch_listing_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each metasearch listing record in the silver layer. Primary key for this data product. Entity role: MASTER_RESOURCE — represents a managed digital listing asset on a metasearch platform.
attributes.references: HTNG Data Standards; Internal Data Governance

attributes.name: booking_source_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.booking_source. Business justification: Metasearch listings (Google Hotel Ads, TripAdvisor, Trivago) drive traffic that converts to bookings. Each metasearch platform should have an associated booking_source code for attribution tracking. T

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Metasearch advertising (Google Hotel Ads, TripAdvisor) is campaign-driven; each listing/bid strategy belongs to a specific marketing campaign for budget tracking, performance attribution, and ROI meas

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution channel record representing the metasearch platform (e.g., Google Hotel Ads, TripAdvisor, Trivago, Kayak, Skyscanner) through which this listing is managed.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS; HTNG Channel Distribution Standards

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Metasearch advertising spend (Google Hotel Ads, TripAdvisor) is a marketing expense requiring cost center allocation for budget tracking, ROI analysis, and departmental P&L reporting.

attributes.name: event_account_id
attributes.description: Event Account Id for metasearch listing

attributes.name: last_bid_updated_by_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Last Bid Updated By Employee Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Metasearch bid updates by employees require tracking for operational accountability and performance analysis. Essential for understanding who manages metasearch campaigns and optimizing bid strategies

tag_set.value: Last Bid Updated By Employee Id (Foreign Key)

attributes.name: platform_account_id
attributes.description: The account or hotel ID assigned by the metasearch platform (e.g., Google Hotel Center property ID, TripAdvisor hotel ID) to identify this property on the platform. Used for API authentication, platform-side reporting reconciliation, and connectivity management.
attributes.references: Google Hotel Ads Hotel Center Documentation; TripAdvisor Connectivity Standards; HTNG Channel Distribution Standards

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the hotel or resort property associated with this metasearch listing. Links the listing to the property master record for performance attribution and bid management.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; HTNG Property Data Standards

attributes.name: bid_amount
attributes.description: The monetary bid amount configured for this listing under the active bid strategy. For CPC, represents the maximum cost-per-click in the listing currency. For CPA, represents the target cost-per-acquisition. For commission-based, this field is null (see commission_rate_pct). Serves as the principal quantitative fact (MEASUREMENT_OR_VALUE) for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: AHLA Technology (HTNG); Google Hotel Ads API; Internal Revenue Management Policy

attributes.name: bid_multiplier
attributes.description: A multiplier applied to the base bid amount for specific market or device segments (e.g., 1.20 = 20% bid increase for mobile). Enables granular bid adjustment strategies without changing the base bid. Used in conjunction with bid_amount for effective bid calculation.
attributes.references: Google Hotel Ads Bid Adjustment Documentation; HTNG Channel Distribution Standards

attributes.name: bid_strategy_type
attributes.description: The bidding model applied to this metasearch listing. CPC (Cost Per Click) charges per user click; CPA (Cost Per Acquisition) charges per completed booking; commission-based charges a percentage of booking revenue; target_ROAS optimizes for return on ad spend; manual allows direct bid amount control. Drives cost-of-acquisition modeling and channel investment decisions.
attributes.references: AHLA Technology (HTNG); Google Hotel Ads Bidding Documentation; TripAdvisor Connectivity Standards

attributes.name: booking_count
attributes.description: Total number of direct bookings attributed to this metasearch listing within the reporting period. Used to calculate conversion rate, cost-per-acquisition (CPA), and metasearch contribution to direct booking revenue. Attribution follows the platform's last-click or assisted-conversion model.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Booking Attribution; Google Hotel Ads Conversion Tracking; HTNG Channel Distribution Standards

attributes.name: booking_revenue
attributes.description: Total gross booking revenue (in listing currency) attributed to direct bookings generated by this metasearch listing within the reporting period. Used to calculate return on ad spend (ROAS), channel contribution to revenue, and cost-of-acquisition metrics. Aligns with USALI revenue reporting.
attributes.references: USALI Revenue Reporting Standards; Sabre SynXis CRS; SAP S/4HANA Finance GL; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: click_count
attributes.description: Total number of user clicks on this property listing that directed traffic to the hotel's direct booking engine or landing page within the reporting period. Used to calculate click-through rate (CTR) and cost-per-click (CPC) actuals.
attributes.references: Google Hotel Ads Reporting API; TripAdvisor Connectivity Standards; HTNG Channel Distribution Standards

attributes.name: click_through_rate
attributes.description: The ratio of clicks to impressions for this listing within the reporting period, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0350 = 3.50% CTR). Sourced directly from platform reporting APIs to ensure consistency with platform-side optimization signals. Used to assess listing creative and bid competitiveness.
attributes.references: Google Hotel Ads Reporting API; TripAdvisor Connectivity Standards; HTNG Channel Distribution Standards

attributes.name: commission_rate_pct
attributes.description: The commission percentage charged by the metasearch platform per completed booking when the bid strategy type is commission-based. Expressed as a percentage of gross booking value (e.g., 12.00 = 12%). Null for CPC and CPA bid strategies. Critical for cost-of-acquisition and channel contribution analysis.
attributes.references: USALI Channel Cost Standards; AHLA Technology (HTNG); Internal Finance Policy

attributes.name: connectivity_type
attributes.description: The technical integration method used to feed rate and availability data to this metasearch listing. 'direct_api' = direct platform API integration; 'gds_feed' = rates sourced via GDS (Global Distribution System); 'crs_feed' = rates sourced via Sabre SynXis CRS; 'third_party_aggregator' = via a connectivity partner. Impacts data freshness and rate accuracy.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS; HTNG Connectivity Standards; GDS (Global Distribution System) Standards

attributes.name: conversion_rate
attributes.description: The ratio of bookings to clicks for this listing within the reporting period, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0250 = 2.50% conversion rate). Sourced from platform reporting. Measures the effectiveness of the direct booking engine in converting metasearch traffic. Key input for bid optimization and landing page performance analysis.
attributes.references: Google Hotel Ads Reporting API; Sabre SynXis CRS; HTNG Channel Distribution Standards

attributes.name: cpa_actual
attributes.description: The actual average cost per acquisition (CPA) realized for this listing within the reporting period, in listing currency. Calculated as total_spend divided by booking_count. Stored as a raw field sourced from platform reporting. Null for non-CPA bid strategies. Key metric for channel cost-of-acquisition benchmarking.
attributes.references: Google Hotel Ads Reporting API; HTNG Channel Distribution Standards; Internal Revenue Management Policy

attributes.name: cpc_actual
attributes.description: The actual average cost per click (CPC) realized for this listing within the reporting period, in listing currency. Calculated as total_spend divided by click_count. Stored as a raw field sourced from platform reporting to avoid recalculation discrepancies. Null for non-CPC bid strategies.
attributes.references: Google Hotel Ads Reporting API; HTNG Channel Distribution Standards; Internal Revenue Management Policy

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this metasearch listing record was first created in the data platform. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity. Used for data lineage, audit compliance, and tracking the onboarding of new metasearch platform listings.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); SOX Financial Controls; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this listing record (bid_amount, daily_budget_cap, monthly_budget_cap, cpc_actual, cpa_actual). Ensures consistent financial reporting across multi-currency property portfolios.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; USALI Financial Reporting Standards; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: daily_budget_cap
attributes.description: Maximum daily spend limit configured for this metasearch listing in the listing currency. Controls total metasearch investment exposure per day. Null if no daily cap is set. Used for budget pacing and channel investment governance.
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Management Policy; AHLA Technology (HTNG); Google Hotel Ads Budget Controls

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: The device category for which this bid configuration applies. Metasearch platforms support device-level bid adjustments. 'all' indicates a unified bid across all devices. Enables device-level performance analysis and bid optimization for direct booking conversion.
attributes.references: Google Hotel Ads Device Bidding Documentation; HTNG Channel Distribution Standards

attributes.name: direct_booking_url
attributes.description: The landing page URL to which users are directed when clicking on this metasearch listing. Points to the hotel's direct booking engine (typically Sabre SynXis CRS-powered). Used for link validation, UTM parameter tracking, and ensuring correct booking attribution.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS; HTNG Channel Distribution Standards; Internal Digital Marketing Policy

attributes.name: display_rank
attributes.description: The average position at which this property listing is displayed on the metasearch platform results page (e.g., rank 1 = top position). Lower rank numbers indicate higher visibility. Used to assess bid competitiveness and correlate rank with click-through and conversion performance.
attributes.references: STR (Smith Travel Research) Benchmarking; Google Hotel Ads Rank Reporting; HTNG Channel Distribution Standards

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The date from which this listing configuration (bid strategy, bid amount, budget caps, device targeting) became active on the metasearch platform. Supports historical bid strategy analysis and change management auditing. Serves as the EFFECTIVE_FROM category for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: HTNG Channel Distribution Standards; Internal Channel Distribution Policy

attributes.name: effective_to
attributes.description: The date on which this listing configuration ceases to be active. Null for currently active configurations. Enables slowly changing dimension (SCD) tracking of bid strategy and configuration changes over time. Serves as the EFFECTIVE_UNTIL category for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: HTNG Channel Distribution Standards; Internal Channel Distribution Policy

attributes.name: impression_count
attributes.description: Total number of times this property listing was displayed to users on the metasearch platform within the reporting period. Foundational metric for calculating click-through rate (CTR) and measuring listing visibility. Sourced from platform reporting APIs.
attributes.references: Google Hotel Ads Reporting API; TripAdvisor Connectivity Standards; HTNG Channel Distribution Standards

attributes.name: is_direct_booking_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this listing is configured to drive direct bookings through the hotel's own booking engine (True) versus redirecting to an OTA or third-party booking path (False). Key flag for measuring direct booking channel contribution and loyalty program integration.
attributes.references: AHLA Direct Booking Best Practices; Sabre SynXis CRS; Internal Channel Strategy Policy

attributes.name: is_rate_parity_monitored
attributes.description: Indicates whether automated rate parity monitoring is enabled for this metasearch listing. When True, the system actively checks for rate disparities between this listing and the direct booking channel. Supports compliance with AHLA rate parity guidelines and OTA contract obligations.
attributes.references: AHLA Rate Parity Guidelines; Internal Channel Distribution Policy; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: last_bid_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the bid amount, bid strategy, or budget configuration for this listing was last modified. Enables audit trail of bid management changes and supports analysis of bid adjustment impact on performance metrics. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: HTNG Channel Distribution Standards; Internal Data Governance Policy; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: listing_reference_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique code or identifier assigned to this property listing on the metasearch platform. Used for reconciliation with platform-side reporting APIs and bid management systems. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS; Google Hotel Ads API; TripAdvisor Connectivity Standards

attributes.name: listing_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the metasearch listing. Controls whether the property is actively bidding and displaying on the platform. Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity. 'active' = live and bidding; 'paused' = temporarily stopped; 'suspended' = platform-enforced stop; 'pending_review' = awaiting platform approval; 'inactive' = deactivated; 'archived' = historical record.
attributes.references: HTNG Channel Distribution Standards; Google Hotel Ads Policy

attributes.name: listing_type
attributes.description: Classification of the metasearch listing placement type. 'standard' = organic/paid standard placement; 'sponsored' = premium paid placement; 'featured' = highlighted featured listing; 'free_booking_links' = Google's commission-free direct booking link program. Determines cost structure and visibility tier.
attributes.references: Google Hotel Ads Product Documentation; HTNG Channel Distribution Standards; Internal Channel Strategy Policy

attributes.name: monthly_budget_cap
attributes.description: Maximum monthly spend limit configured for this metasearch listing in the listing currency. Governs total monthly metasearch investment for the property-platform combination. Null if no monthly cap is set. Supports channel mix optimization and CapEx/OpEx planning.
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Management Policy; USALI Financial Reporting Standards; SAP S/4HANA Budget Controls

attributes.name: platform_name
attributes.description: Name of the metasearch platform on which this listing is active. Identifies the specific metasearch engine for bid strategy configuration, performance benchmarking, and cost-of-acquisition analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Google Hotel Ads|TripAdvisor|Trivago|Kayak|Skyscanner|Wego|HotelsCombined — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AHLA Technology (HTNG) Channel Distribution Standards; OTA/Metasearch Industry Taxonomy

attributes.name: rate_parity_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the rates displayed on this metasearch listing are in parity with the Best Available Rate (BAR) across all channels. 'parity' = rates match; 'disparity_detected' = rates differ from direct channel; 'under_review' = parity check in progress; 'exempt' = contractual exemption applies. Critical for OTA contract compliance and direct booking channel protection.
attributes.references: AHLA Rate Parity Guidelines; Sabre SynXis CRS Rate Distribution; Internal Channel Distribution Policy

attributes.name: reporting_period_end
attributes.description: The end date of the performance reporting period for which metrics on this record apply. Used in conjunction with reporting_period_start to define the measurement window for all performance KPIs on this listing record.
attributes.references: STR (Smith Travel Research) Reporting Standards; Internal Revenue Management Reporting Policy

attributes.name: reporting_period_start
attributes.description: The start date of the performance reporting period for which impression, click, booking, spend, and rate metrics on this record apply. Enables time-series analysis of metasearch performance and aligns with STR benchmarking reporting cycles.
attributes.references: STR (Smith Travel Research) Reporting Standards; Internal Revenue Management Reporting Policy

attributes.name: return_on_ad_spend
attributes.description: The ratio of booking revenue to total spend for this listing within the reporting period (e.g., 8.50 = $8.50 revenue per $1.00 spent). Sourced from platform reporting or CRS attribution data. Primary KPI for metasearch investment optimization and bid strategy evaluation.
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Management Policy; USALI Channel Cost Standards; HTNG Channel Distribution Standards

attributes.name: target_market
attributes.description: The geographic market or audience segment this listing bid configuration targets (e.g., US, UK, DE, APAC). Enables market-level bid differentiation and performance analysis. Aligns with Sabre SynXis CRS market segmentation and IDeaS G3 RMS demand forecasting by market.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS; IDeaS G3 RMS; WTTC Market Segmentation Standards

attributes.name: total_spend
attributes.description: Total monetary amount spent on this metasearch listing (in listing currency) within the reporting period, including all click charges, acquisition fees, or commission payments depending on bid strategy. Core input for cost-of-acquisition (COA) and channel ROI calculations.
attributes.references: USALI Channel Cost Standards; SAP S/4HANA Finance AP; IFRS/GAAP; Internal Revenue Management Policy

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this metasearch listing record was last updated in the data platform. Supports incremental ETL processing, data freshness monitoring, and audit trail requirements for channel distribution data governance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); SOX Financial Controls; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: utm_campaign_code
attributes.description: The UTM campaign parameter appended to the direct booking URL for this listing, enabling attribution tracking in web analytics and CRM systems. Used to measure metasearch-sourced traffic and bookings in Salesforce CRM and digital analytics platforms.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Campaign Attribution; Internal Digital Marketing Policy; Google Analytics UTM Standards

products.name: wholesale_allotment
products.description: Master and transactional records for room allotments contracted with wholesale partners (tour operators, bed banks, travel consortia). Captures wholesaler identity, property, room type, contracted allotment block size, release period, contracted net rate, allotment consumption, and remaining availability. Distinct from OTA channel records — wholesale allotments operate on pre-contracted net rate models with release-back provisions.

attributes.name: wholesale_allotment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the wholesale allotment record in the lakehouse Silver layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: booking_source_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.booking_source. Business justification: Wholesale allotments are contracted with wholesaler partners who are represented as booking sources in the attribution model. Adding booking_source_id FK links the allotment to the specific wholesaler

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Wholesale allotments are sold through targeted marketing campaigns to tour operators and travel agencies; tracking campaign attribution for wholesale block sales enables campaign ROI measurement, whol

attributes.name: channel_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master wholesale contract agreement under which this allotment is governed, including commercial terms and SLA obligations.

attributes.name: distribution_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel. Business justification: Wholesale allotments may be distributed through specific channels (e.g., a tour operator allotment sold via a specific distribution channel). Many allotments per channel. Removes redundant channel_cod

attributes.name: gds_connection_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.gds_connection. Business justification: Wholesale allotments may be distributed via GDS networks (e.g., tour operator allotments loaded into Sabre for travel agent booking). Many allotments per GDS connection. Removes redundant gds_code whi

attributes.name: ota_partner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the wholesale partner (tour operator, bed bank, or travel consortium) with whom this allotment is contracted.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the hotel or resort property to which this allotment block applies, as managed in Oracle OPERA PMS.

attributes.name: room_type_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific room type (e.g., Deluxe King, Standard Double) included in this wholesale allotment block.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Room Type Configuration

attributes.name: allotment_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference code assigned to this allotment block, used in communications with the wholesale partner and in the Central Reservation System (CRS) via Sabre SynXis.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Channel Management Standards

attributes.name: allotment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the wholesale allotment block. 'active' indicates rooms are available for the wholesaler to sell; 'released' indicates the release period has passed and unsold rooms have been returned to general inventory; 'suspended' indicates temporarily blocked by revenue management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|suspended|released|expired|cancelled|pending — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Inventory Controls; HTNG Channel Distribution Standards

attributes.name: allotment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the allotment commitment model. 'hard_block' means rooms are guaranteed and held regardless of demand; 'soft_block' means rooms are held but can be reclaimed by the property; 'free_sale' means the wholesaler can sell without prior confirmation; 'on_request' means each booking requires property confirmation.
attributes.references: AHLA Wholesale Distribution Standards; HTNG Channel Distribution Standards

attributes.name: booking_deadline_date
attributes.description: Last date by which the wholesale partner must confirm bookings against this allotment block. After this date, unconfirmed allotment rooms may be released or renegotiated.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Allotment Management; SAP S/4HANA Contract Terms

attributes.name: cancellation_count
attributes.description: Number of reservations cancelled against this allotment block by the wholesale partner. Used to monitor wholesaler booking behaviour and assess wash factor for future allotment sizing.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Cancellation Tracking; Infor EzRMS Wash Factor

attributes.name: commission_rate
attributes.description: Commission percentage payable to the wholesale partner or intermediary on consumed allotment bookings, where applicable. Expressed as a percentage of the contracted net rate. Some wholesale models are net-rate only with no commission.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AP Commission Management; USALI

attributes.name: connectivity_type
attributes.description: Technical connectivity method used by the wholesale partner to access and consume this allotment. Determines how allotment updates and booking confirmations are exchanged.
attributes.references: HTNG Technology Standards; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: consumed_units
attributes.description: Number of room-nights from the allotment block that have been picked up (booked) by the wholesale partner to date. Updated in near-real-time from the CRS and PMS.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Allotment Pickup; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: contract_effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the wholesale allotment agreement becomes commercially binding. Aligns with the master contract effective date in SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: contract_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the wholesale allotment agreement expires and the wholesaler's right to sell rooms under this block terminates. Nullable for evergreen agreements.

attributes.name: contracted_allotment_size
attributes.description: Total number of room-nights contracted with the wholesale partner for the defined stay period and room type. This is the original block size as agreed in the wholesale contract.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Allotment Management; AHLA Wholesale Standards

attributes.name: contracted_net_rate
attributes.description: The pre-agreed net rate (exclusive of markup) payable by the wholesale partner per room per night under this allotment contract. This is the wholesale net rate model — the wholesaler adds their own markup before selling to the end consumer. Expressed in the contract currency.
attributes.references: USALI Net Rate Definition; SAP S/4HANA Contract Pricing; AHLA Wholesale Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this wholesale allotment record was first created in the source system or lakehouse Silver layer. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the contracted net rate and any financial terms in this allotment (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Aligns with the contract currency in SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: daily_allotment_size
attributes.description: Number of rooms allocated per night within the stay period. Used when the allotment is expressed as a per-night room count rather than a total room-night block.

attributes.name: is_closed_to_arrival
attributes.description: Indicates whether arrivals are blocked on the stay_date_from under this allotment. A Closed to Arrival (CTA) restriction prevents new check-ins on specific dates while allowing through-stays.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Inventory Controls; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: is_stop_sell
attributes.description: Indicates whether the allotment has been closed to new bookings by the revenue management team, overriding remaining availability. When True, the wholesaler cannot make new reservations against this block regardless of remaining units.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Inventory Controls; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: last_room_availability
attributes.description: Indicates whether this wholesale allotment is subject to Last Room Availability (LRA) obligations, meaning the wholesaler must be offered the last available room at the contracted rate. A key commercial term in premium wholesale contracts.
attributes.references: AHLA Wholesale Distribution Standards; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this wholesale allotment record, whether from a source system update or a manual override by the revenue management team.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); HTNG Data Standards

attributes.name: market_segment_code
attributes.description: Revenue management market segment code assigned to bookings originating from this wholesale allotment (e.g., WHOLE, TOUR, CONSOR). Used for USALI-compliant revenue segmentation and STR benchmarking.
attributes.references: USALI Market Segmentation; IDeaS G3 RMS Market Segment; STR Benchmarking Standards

attributes.name: max_los
attributes.description: Maximum number of nights permitted for a single booking under this wholesale allotment. Used to prevent excessively long stays at contracted net rates during peak demand periods.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS LOS Restrictions; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: min_los
attributes.description: Minimum number of nights a guest must stay for a booking to be accepted under this wholesale allotment. A Length of Stay (LOS) restriction applied at the allotment level to protect revenue during high-demand periods.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS LOS Restrictions; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes entered by the revenue management or channel distribution team regarding special conditions, exceptions, or commercial context for this allotment block.

attributes.name: pickup_count
attributes.description: Number of individual reservations booked against this allotment block by the wholesale partner. Distinct from consumed_units (room-nights) — a single multi-night booking increments pickup_count by 1 but consumed_units by the number of nights.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Allotment Pickup; IDeaS G3 RMS Pickup Report

attributes.name: rack_rate
attributes.description: Published Best Available Rate (BAR) or rack rate for the room type at the property, used as the reference rate for calculating the wholesale discount depth and monitoring rate parity obligations.

attributes.name: rate_parity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allotment's contracted net rate (after wholesaler markup) is expected to comply with rate parity obligations. True means parity monitoring is active for this allotment. Used in channel distribution compliance reporting.

attributes.name: release_date

attributes.name: release_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days prior to the arrival date by which unsold allotment rooms must be released back to the property's general inventory. A key commercial term in wholesale contracts — e.g., a 21-day release means rooms not sold 21 days before check-in revert to the hotel.

attributes.name: stay_date_from
attributes.description: First date of the stay period covered by this allotment block. Defines the start of the contracted inventory window during which the wholesaler may sell rooms.

attributes.name: stay_date_to
attributes.description: Last date of the stay period covered by this allotment block. Defines the end of the contracted inventory window. Inclusive of this date.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Allotment Management; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: wash_factor_pct
attributes.description: Historical cancellation and no-show rate expressed as a percentage of contracted allotment, used to adjust effective allotment sizing in revenue forecasting. Derived from historical performance of this wholesaler-property-room type combination.

products.name: package_rate
products.description: This association product represents the distribution agreement between a distribution channel and a spa package. It captures channel-specific pricing, commission structures, booking rules, and availability controls that exist only in the context of offering a specific package through a specific channel. Each record links one distribution channel to one spa package with rate loading, promotional pricing, and channel-specific restrictions that revenue management actively maintains.. Existence Justification: In travel hospitality revenue management, spa packages are actively distributed through multiple channels (OTA platforms, GDS, direct web, corporate) with channel-specific pricing, commission structures, and booking rules. Each spa package can be offered through many distribution channels simultaneously, and each channel offers many spa packages. Revenue management teams actively maintain channel-specific rates, promotional pricing, and availability controls for each channel-package combination.

products.name: ota_campaign_participation
products.description: This association product represents the participation contract between OTA partners and marketing campaigns. It captures co-operative marketing agreements where OTA partners participate in hotel-led campaigns with negotiated budget contributions, performance incentives, and content requirements. Each record links one OTA partner to one campaign with financial terms, performance tracking, and partnership-specific campaign execution details that exist only in the context of this co-marketing relationship.. Existence Justification: In travel hospitality, OTA co-marketing campaigns are a standard operational practice where hotels negotiate participation agreements with multiple OTA partners (Expedia, Booking.com, Agoda) for seasonal promotions, new property launches, and loyalty tie-ins. Each OTA partner participates in multiple campaigns throughout the year, and each campaign involves multiple OTA partners with partner-specific budget contributions, performance targets, content requirements, and promotional placements. Marketing teams actively manage these participation agreements as distinct business entities with negotiated terms, financial tracking, and performance measurement.

products.name: channel_inventory_control
products.description: This association product represents the inventory allocation contract between room types and distribution channels. It captures channel-specific inventory controls, sell limits, rate parity enforcement, and allocation rules that exist only in the context of a specific room-type-channel pairing. Each record links one room type to one distribution channel with operational controls that govern how that room type is sold through that specific channel.. Existence Justification: In hotel revenue management operations, each room type is distributed across multiple channels (OTA, GDS, direct, wholesale) with channel-specific inventory controls, and each channel sells multiple room types with distinct allocation rules. Revenue management teams actively manage these allocations by setting sell limits, LRA flags, rate parity enforcement, and allocation percentages for each room-type-channel pair. This is a core operational relationship with substantial relationship-specific data.

Enables event revenue performance tracking, group ADR contribution analysis, and TRevPAR impact assessment. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS and SAP S/4HANA GL.

products.description: This association product represents the enrollment event between an event attendee and a fitness class session. It captures the registration, attendance tracking, and billing relationship when event attendees sign up for fitness or wellness classes during their event stay. Each record links one attendee to one fitness class session with attributes that exist only in the context of this enrollment relationship, including enrollment status, attendance confirmation, and whether the class is included in the event package or charged separately.. Existence Justification: In travel hospitality event operations, event attendees routinely enroll in multiple fitness and wellness class sessions during their event stay (e.g., morning yoga, afternoon spin class, evening meditation), and each fitness class session hosts multiple event attendees from potentially different event bookings. The enrollment relationship is actively managed by event coordinators and spa staff, tracking registration status, attendance confirmation, and billing treatment (whether included in event package or charged separately).

products.name: beo_attendant_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the operational assignment of housekeeping attendants to specific Banquet Event Orders (BEOs). Each record captures a single attendant's assignment to a BEO function, including their role in the event (setup, service, breakdown), assignment timestamp, completion status, hours worked, and quality score. This is a core operational entity used for labor costing, performance management, and event execution tracking.. Existence Justification: In hotel event operations, a single BEO (banquet event order) requires multiple attendants working in different roles (setup crew, service staff, breakdown crew, supervisors), and each attendant executes multiple BEOs per shift or per day. The business actively manages these assignments as operational entities, tracking role, hours worked, completion status, and quality scores for each attendant-BEO combination for labor costing, payroll, and performance management.

products.name: experience_enrollment
products.description: This association product represents the enrollment of a specific experience program within an event booking. It captures the operational assignment of curated guest experience programs (SALT programs, VIP welcomes, wellness journeys, culinary experiences) to MICE event bookings. Each record links one event_booking to one experience_program with attributes that track enrollment timing, participant counts, fulfillment progress, program-specific costs, and operational status for that specific event-program pairing.. Existence Justification: In MICE event operations, corporate event bookings routinely include multiple curated experience programs (welcome receptions, team building activities, spa packages, culinary experiences, SALT programs) to enhance attendee satisfaction and differentiate the event offering. Conversely, each experience program definition (e.g., 'Executive Wellness Journey' or 'Team Building Challenge') is enrolled across many different event bookings throughout the year. Event coordinators actively manage these enrollments as operational entities, tracking participant counts, delivery schedules, fulfillment progress, and event-specific costs for each program within each event.

products.name: fnb_supply_agreement
products.description: This association product represents the contractual supply relationship between F&B inventory items and vendors. It captures vendor-specific sourcing terms, pricing, lead times, and purchase history for each item-vendor combination. Each record links one inventory item to one vendor with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific supply relationship, enabling multi-sourcing strategies, cost optimization, and supply continuity management.. Existence Justification: In hotel F&B operations, inventory items are routinely sourced from multiple vendors to ensure supply continuity, optimize costs, and manage risk. A single item (e.g., olive oil) may have a primary supplier, a backup supplier, and spot market vendors, each with different pricing, lead times, and minimum order quantities. Conversely, each vendor supplies hundreds of different F&B items. This is an operational multi-sourcing strategy actively managed by procurement teams.

products.name: hk_schedule
products.description: Master record of housekeeping operational scheduling at the property level, defining daily shift structures (AM/PM/overnight with start/end times and break windows), weekly section-to-attendant assignments (based on seniority bidding or rotation), and staffing levels calibrated to occupancy forecast tiers. Captures planned headcount per shift, section configurations (floor/zone groupings with room counts and credit values), turndown service windows, and shift-level labor budgets aligned to CPOR targets. Used for labor planning, union CBA scheduling compliance (consecutive days, overtime thresholds), and PIP staffing requirements. Deep clean rotation scheduling is managed separately in deep_clean_plan.

products.name: housekeeping_training_completion
products.description: This association product represents the enrollment and completion tracking between housekeeping attendants and learning courses. It captures the operational training lifecycle including enrollment, completion status, assessment scores, certification issuance, and expiry tracking. Each record links one attendant to one learning course with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific training enrollment. Supports OSHA compliance reporting, certification tracking for suite/VIP qualifications, chemical handling and bloodborne pathogen protocol compliance, and scheduling of qualified staff to appropriate assignments.. Existence Justification: In hotel housekeeping operations, attendants must complete multiple training courses throughout their employment (chemical handling, bloodborne pathogen protocols, suite service certification, VIP certification, ongoing compliance refreshers), and each course is delivered to many attendants across the property and enterprise. The business actively manages training enrollments as operational records with enrollment dates, completion tracking, assessment scores, certification expiry dates, and recertification cycles. This is not an analytical correlation but an operational business process called 'training completion' or 'course enrollment' that HR and housekeeping managers actively create, monitor, and use for compliance reporting and qualified staff scheduling.

domains.name: finance
domains.description: Financial management including GL, AP, AR, budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting per USALI standards and GAAP/IFRS. products.name: ledger
products.description: General Ledger (GL) master entity representing the chart of accounts structure per USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry) standards. Each ledger account defines an account number, account name, account type (asset, liability, equity, revenue, expense), account group, normal balance indicator, and currency. Serves as the authoritative financial record backbone for all property-level and consolidated financial reporting including income statements, balance sheets, cash flow statements, GOP, EBITDA, NOI, and GOPPAR calculations. Supports period-end financial statement generation and multi-property consolidation with intercompany elimination. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA GL module.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA General Ledger / USALI Chart of Accounts

products.name: cost_center

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cost center. Primary key.

attributes.name: parent_cost_center_id

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property to which this cost center belongs.

attributes.name: annual_budget_amount
attributes.description: The total annual budgeted amount allocated to this cost center for the current fiscal year, used for variance analysis and financial control.

attributes.name: audit_trail_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all financial transactions posted to this cost center must maintain a full audit trail for compliance and internal control purposes (True) or standard logging is sufficient (False).

attributes.name: budget_allocation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center has a dedicated budget allocation and is subject to budget control and variance reporting (True) or operates without a formal budget (False).

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The externally-known unique alphanumeric code identifying the cost center within the property and financial system. Used in GL postings and financial reports.

attributes.name: company_code

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: The SAP controlling area under which this cost center is managed, representing the organizational unit for internal cost accounting and management reporting.

attributes.name: cost_allocation_method
attributes.description: The method used to allocate shared costs or overhead to this cost center: direct assignment, activity-based costing, percentage allocation, headcount-based, or square footage-based.

attributes.name: cost_center_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost center: active (operational and accepting postings), inactive (temporarily not in use), suspended (blocked for new postings), or closed (permanently retired).

attributes.name: cost_center_type

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The username or employee identifier of the user who created this cost center record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cost center record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which this cost center's financial transactions are recorded (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: department_category
attributes.description: High-level USALI category: Operated Departments (revenue-generating), Undistributed Operating Expenses (support), or Fixed Charges (property-level overhead).

attributes.name: cost_center_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the cost center's purpose, scope, and operational responsibilities.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this cost center ceased operations or was closed. Null for currently active cost centers.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this cost center became active and began accepting financial postings.

attributes.name: external_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center's financial results are included in external financial statements and regulatory filings (True) or used only for internal management reporting (False).

attributes.name: headcount_allocation
attributes.description: The number of full-time equivalent (FTE) employees allocated to this cost center, used for labor cost analysis and productivity metrics.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: The depth of this cost center in the organizational hierarchy (1=top-level, 2=sub-department, etc.), used for roll-up aggregation and reporting.

attributes.name: labor_cost_tracking_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether labor costs (payroll, benefits, overtime) are tracked and allocated to this cost center (True) or excluded from labor cost analysis (False).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Activity-Based Costing, USALI Labor Cost Reporting

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: The username or employee identifier of the user who last modified this cost center record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cost center record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: cost_center_name
attributes.description: The full business name of the cost center (e.g., Rooms Division, Food and Beverage, Spa Operations, Administration).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special instructions, or contextual information about the cost center's operations, budget constraints, or reporting requirements.

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: The profit center code to which this cost center's expenses and revenues are allocated for segment reporting and profitability analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Profit Center Accounting

attributes.name: revenue_posting_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether revenue transactions can be posted to this cost center (True for revenue-generating departments) or only expense postings are allowed (False for support/administrative centers).

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center is subject to SOX financial controls and audit requirements (True for publicly traded entities) or exempt (False).

attributes.name: square_footage
attributes.description: The total square footage of physical space occupied by this cost center, used for space-based cost allocation and facility management analysis.

attributes.name: usali_department_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry (USALI) Department Code
attributes.description: The standard USALI departmental code aligning this cost center to the industry-standard chart of accounts for lodging P&L reporting (e.g., 10=Rooms, 20=Food, 30=Beverage, 40=Other Operated Departments, 50=Administrative & General).

products.name: profit_center

Enables property-level P&L reporting, RevPAR contribution analysis, and GOPPAR tracking. Supports consolidated financial statements across the portfolio. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Profit Center Accounting.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the profit center. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the primary cost center associated with this profit center for expense allocation and departmental accounting per USALI standards.

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the employee responsible for managing this profit center. Used for accountability reporting and performance evaluation.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud, SAP S/4HANA HCM

attributes.name: ownership_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the legal ownership entity responsible for this profit center. Supports consolidated financial statements across the portfolio and inter-company eliminations.

attributes.name: parent_profit_center_id

attributes.name: property_id

attributes.name: revenue_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the primary revenue center for this profit center. Used for revenue recognition and departmental revenue reporting per USALI.

attributes.name: address_line_1

attributes.name: address_line_2

attributes.name: brand_code
attributes.description: Brand or franchise affiliation code for the profit center (e.g., Marriott, Hilton, Hyatt, independent). Used for brand-level performance reporting and franchise fee calculations.

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: SAP Business Area code for -code segment reporting. Enables consolidated reporting across multiple legal entities within the same business segment (e.g., luxury hotels, select-service properties).

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the profit center is located.

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: The date the profit center was permanently closed. Used for historical analysis and asset disposition reporting.

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: The externally-known unique business identifier for the profit center used in financial reporting and consolidation. Typically alphanumeric code assigned per SAP S/4HANA Profit Center Accounting standards.

attributes.name: company_code

attributes.name: controlling_area_code
attributes.description: SAP Controlling Area code to which this profit center is assigned. Defines the organizational boundary for internal cost and revenue accounting.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the profit center's location. Used for multi-country consolidation and compliance with local regulatory reporting requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this profit center record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking per SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) compliance requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the profit center's local currency. Used for multi-currency consolidation and foreign exchange translation per IFRS/GAAP.

attributes.name: profit_center_description
attributes.description: Detailed business description of the profit center, including its purpose, services offered, and unique characteristics. Used for internal documentation and reporting context.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this profit center ceased operations or was closed. Null for currently active profit centers. Used for historical reporting and closed property analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Profit Center Accounting, USALI

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this profit center became active and began contributing to financial statements. Used for time-based reporting and historical analysis.

attributes.name: email_address

attributes.name: hierarchy_level

attributes.name: is_consolidated
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this profit center's financial results are included in consolidated financial statements. Used for inter-company elimination and segment reporting per IFRS/GAAP.
attributes.references: IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements, GAAP ASC 810

attributes.name: is_revenue_generating
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this profit center directly generates guest-facing revenue (true) or is a support/overhead center (false). Used for GOP (Gross Operating Profit) and departmental profit analysis per USALI.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this profit center record. Used for change tracking and audit compliance per SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act).

attributes.name: profit_center_name
attributes.description: The full business name of the profit center (e.g., 'Grand Plaza Hotel Downtown', 'Rooftop Bar & Lounge', 'Convention Center Ballroom A').
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Profit Center Accounting, USALI

attributes.name: opening_date
attributes.description: The original opening or launch date of the profit center. Used for property age analysis and lifecycle reporting.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the profit center. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the profit center's address.

attributes.name: profit_center_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the profit center. Active centers contribute to consolidated financial statements; inactive or closed centers are excluded from operational reporting.

attributes.name: room_count
attributes.description: Total number of guest rooms or keys available at this profit center (applicable only to property-level profit centers). Used for RevPAR (Revenue Per Available Room), GOPPAR (Gross Operating Profit Per Available Room), and occupancy calculations.

attributes.name: seating_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum seating capacity for F&B (Food and Beverage) outlets or event venues. Used for revenue per seat analysis and capacity utilization reporting.

attributes.name: short_name

attributes.name: star_rating

attributes.name: state_province_code

products.name: journal_entry
products.description: General Ledger journal entry transactional record capturing all financial postings including accruals, adjustments, intercompany transfers, expense allocations, and period-end closing entries. Each entry carries debit/credit totals, posting date, fiscal period, document type (standard, allocation, intercompany, recurring), reference to source transaction, and full audit trail (created by, approved by, posting timestamp). Supports SOX audit trail requirements, intercompany elimination tracking, and GAAP/IFRS compliance. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA GL.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA Journal Entry / GAAP General Ledger Posting

attributes.description: Unique identifier for the journal entry record. Primary key for the journal entry transaction.

attributes.name: allocation_run_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the cost allocation or expense distribution run that generated this journal entry, if applicable. Null for non-allocation entries. Used to track automated allocation postings.

attributes.name: ledger_id

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Journal entries are allocated to profit centers for revenue-generating business unit tracking. The profit_center STRING attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to profit_center.profit_center_id

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the hotel property or resort to which this journal entry is attributed. Enables property-level P&L and financial reporting.

attributes.name: quaternary_journal_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: User ID or employee identifier of the person who last modified this journal entry record. Part of the change tracking audit trail.

attributes.name: recurring_entry_template_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the recurring journal entry template from which this entry was generated, if applicable. Null for non-recurring entries. Used to track automated periodic postings.

attributes.name: revenue_center_id

attributes.description: User ID or employee identifier of the person who executed the final posting of this journal entry to the general ledger. Null if not yet posted. Part of SOX segregation of duties controls.
attributes.references: SOX - Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404 Internal Controls

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this journal entry was approved for posting. Null if not yet approved. Part of the approval workflow audit trail.

attributes.name: audit_trail_notes
attributes.description: Additional audit trail notes or comments added by approvers, auditors, or system administrators for compliance and review purposes.

attributes.name: capex_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry relates to capital expenditure (CapEx) or furniture, fixtures, and equipment (FF&E) investments. True for CapEx/FF&E entries, False for operating expenditure (OpEx).

attributes.name: company_code

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Company Code Structure, IFRS Consolidated Financial Statements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this journal entry record was first created in the general ledger system. Part of the complete audit trail for SOX compliance.

attributes.name: credit_amount
attributes.description: The total credit amount for this journal entry in the functional currency. Must balance with debit amount per double-entry accounting principles.

attributes.name: debit_amount
attributes.description: The total debit amount for this journal entry in the functional currency. Must balance with credit amount per double-entry accounting principles.
attributes.references: GAAP - Generally Accepted Accounting Principles Double-Entry Bookkeeping

attributes.name: journal_entry_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the business purpose and nature of this journal entry. Provides context for auditors and financial analysts.

attributes.name: document_type

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The exchange rate applied to convert transaction currency to functional currency at the time of posting. Null if transaction and functional currencies are the same.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this journal entry is posted, derived from the posting date and the organization's fiscal calendar.

attributes.name: functional_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the functional currency in which this journal entry is recorded (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: intercompany_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry represents an intercompany transaction between legal entities within the enterprise. True for intercompany entries requiring elimination in consolidated reporting.

attributes.name: intercompany_partner_code
attributes.description: The company code of the intercompany partner entity for intercompany transactions. Used for intercompany reconciliation and elimination entries in consolidated financial statements.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this journal entry record was last modified. Tracks all changes for audit and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: SOX - Sarbanes-Oxley Act Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: posted_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this journal entry was posted to the general ledger. Null if not yet posted. This is the system processing time, distinct from the posting_date which is the accounting date.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting date when this journal entry is posted to the general ledger. This is the business event date that determines which fiscal period the entry impacts, distinct from the creation or approval timestamps.

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the journal entry in the approval and posting workflow. Tracks progression from draft creation through approval to final posting in the general ledger.

attributes.name: reference_text
attributes.description: Additional reference information or notes related to this journal entry, such as supporting documentation references, approval notes, or special instructions.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator

attributes.name: source_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the originating source transaction document (e.g., invoice number, payment document, POS check number) that triggered this journal entry.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The tax code or tax jurisdiction code applicable to this journal entry, if the entry involves tax-related postings (sales tax, VAT, occupancy tax, etc.).

attributes.name: transaction_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code of the original transaction currency if different from functional currency. Used for foreign exchange tracking.

products.name: budget
products.description: Annual and periodic financial budget master representing planned and forecasted financial targets at both header and line-item granularity. Each budget contains line items by GL account, cost center, profit center, and fiscal period combination. Supports approved annual budgets, rolling forecasts, and reforecasts (distinguished by budget type/version). Captures budgeted revenue (rooms, F&B, events), budgeted expenses (labor, CPOR, FF&E reserve contributions), and budgeted KPIs (ADR, OCC, RevPAR, GOP, EBITDA, NOI). Enables granular budget-vs-actual and forecast-vs-actual variance analysis at the account, department, and property level. Supports USALI departmental budget reporting and management review. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Planning and Budgeting module.

products.name: vendor
products.description: Master record for all suppliers and vendors providing goods and services to hotel and resort properties. Captures vendor identity, classification (F&B supplier, FF&E vendor, housekeeping supplier, maintenance contractor), tax registration, payment terms, preferred currency, remittance details, diversity certification, contact persons (account managers, sales reps, escalation contacts), and SAP S/4HANA vendor master integration. Serves as the SSOT for vendor identity and vendor contacts across procurement. Includes vendor tier, risk rating, compliance status, bank/payment details, and communication preferences.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor. Primary key for the vendor master record.

attributes.name: property_id

attributes.name: address_line1

attributes.name: address_line2

attributes.name: annual_spend_amount

attributes.name: bank_account_number
attributes.description: Vendors bank account number for electronic payment remittance. Highly sensitive financial information requiring restricted access and encryption.

attributes.name: bank_name

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the vendors primary business location.

attributes.name: classification
attributes.description: Primary business classification of the vendor based on goods or services provided. Categories include Food and Beverage (F&B) supplier, housekeeping supplier, Furniture Fixtures and Equipment (FF&E) vendor, maintenance contractor, technology provider, and professional services.

attributes.name: vendor_code
attributes.description: External business identifier for the vendor used in procurement documents and SAP S/4HANA MM module. Unique alphanumeric code assigned to each supplier.

attributes.name: compliance_status

attributes.name: contract_end_date

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: Effective start date of the current master service agreement or supply contract with the vendor. Used for contract lifecycle management and renewal tracking.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the vendors primary business location. Examples: USA (United States), CAN (Canada), GBR (United Kingdom).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor master record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: dba_name

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.name: vendor_name

attributes.name: next_review_date

attributes.name: onboarding_date

attributes.name: tier

products.name: vendor_performance

Supports vendor qualification, preferred vendor designation, and contract renewal decisions. Aligned with USALI cost management standards and SAP MM vendor evaluation (ME61).

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who conducted or approved this vendor performance evaluation.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property where vendor performance is being evaluated. Supports property-level vendor scorecarding.

attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor performance evaluation was approved and published. Marks the official completion of the evaluation cycle.

attributes.name: average_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Average number of days between purchase order issuance and goods receipt during the evaluation period. Measures vendor fulfillment speed.

attributes.name: contract_compliance_score
attributes.description: Composite score measuring vendor adherence to contract terms including pricing, delivery terms, payment terms, and service level agreements. Scored 0-100.

attributes.name: contract_renewal_recommendation
attributes.description: Recommendation for contract action based on performance evaluation results. Supports contract lifecycle management decisions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor performance evaluation record was first created in the system.
